title: Customer Support Specialist
description:
[IMPORTANT] To apply, please fill in the application form here: 
 



About Crafti



Crafti is a matcha brand selling in USA and Singapore. We are a small and fast team that prioritises output and growth; with over 5 remote employees.



The Role



We're looking for a part-time Customer Support Specialist to handle customer escalations in the evenings and on weekends.



Our AI handles the first reply to most customer questions. You step in where a human is needed: approving refunds and replacements, solving issues the AI can't, and making sure every customer leaves happy. You'll also help the AI improve by flagging wrong answers and suggesting better ones. This is a focused, part-time role.



You're the right person if:



- Enjoy solving customer problems and turning an unhappy customer into a loyal one

- Can work through a queue quickly without losing accuracy

- Notice when something is wrong (a bad AI answer, a pattern of complaints) and raise it without being asked

- Want to learn how AI customer support works, and help shape it



This is not for you if:



- You want a full-time role. This is about 14 hours a week

- You are uncomfortable learning new software tools and AI on your own

- You cannot reliably work evenings (10pm–12am PHT) and weekends

- Your written English is not natural and professional, since most of our customers are in the US.



What you will do:



- Escalation handling: resolve customer conversations the AI has passed to a human, across
, Instagram, WhatsApp, Messenger and TikTok Shop

- Approvals: review and approve refunds, replacements and other resolutions, following our authority framework

- Order look-ups: check orders, tracking and subscriptions in Shopify, Amazon and our subscription app

- AI quality review: check AI replies, flag errors

- Handover: leave clear notes for the morning team on anything still open



What We Are Looking For:



- at least 1+ years in customer support for an e-commerce or consumer brand (US customers a plus)

- Experience with a helpdesk tool (Richpanel, Gorgias, Zendesk or similar)

- Familiarity with Shopify is a plus



Traits (these matter more than your CV):



- Ownership: when I close my shift, the queue is clear or handed over properly

- Good judgment: I know when to follow the rule and when to escalate

- Curious: I want to understand why customers write in, not just answer them

- Has opinions: I want to suggest a better way



Details



This is a part-time remote role based in the Philippines.



Remuneration: PHP
per hour



Commitment: about 14 hours a week:

- 4 weeknights, 10:00pm–12:00am Philippines Time (2 hours each)

- Saturday and Sunday, 3 hours each (time to be agreed)

title: ecom video editor (must have experience)
description:
We are a fast-growing eCommerce brand that produces high-volume Meta ads and is seeking an exceptionally skilled Paid Social Creative Editor who can produce AI-enhanced video ads and static creatives at scale. This role is for someone who understands direct-response marketing, fast-paced iteration, and AI generation workflows, not basic aesthetic editing. What you will do: 

Create high-volume paid social videos (UGC-style, product demos, problem–solution, voiceover visuals, testimonial edits). 

Generate AI-powered visuals using tools like: 

Google VEO 3 

Higgsfield 

Google Gemini 

AI UGC avatar tools 

AI image generators 

Build static ads using a mix of AI visuals + our existing asset library. 

Receive a creative brief (concept, angle, script) and independently produce: 

3–10 video variations 

5–20 static image variations 

Rapid iterations based on feedback and performance data 

Add engaging on-screen text, captions, VFX, and sound design. 

Incorporate our pre-existing footage + newly generated AI elements. 

Help conceptualize ideas that improve CTR, hook rate, thumbstop ratio, and ROAS. 

Deliver creatives in a Meta-native format (short form, mobile-first, bold text, fast pacing). 



Required Skills + Experience (please do not apply if you don't meet the criteria):



Direct-Response Creative Editing 

Knowledge of high-performing Meta ads formats 

Strong understanding of: Hooks, Pacing, Retention strategy, CTA placement AI Video & Image Generation (Advanced) 

Strong prompting abilities 

Ability to generate:, AI actors/UGC avatars, AI B-roll, AI product shots *

Workflow experience (storyboarding, prompt crafting, refining, upscaling) 

Technical Editing Software Skills 

Adobe Premiere Pro 

CapCut Desktop 

DaVinci Resolve

Final Cut Pro 

Photoshop, Canva, or Figma for static ads 

Ability to sync voiceovers and maintain pacing 

Paid Social Creative Knowledge 

Understanding of creative testing 

Ability to interpret creative performance metrics like: Hook rate, Thumbstop percentage, CTR, Watch-time dropoff 

Work Speed 

MUST be able to produce high-volume output daily 

Must be able to turn around creative requests within 24–48 hours 

English Proficiency 

Must be able to communicate verbally and over text proficiently in English



(SAY YEAH)



### Additional Requirements



* **High-Level Editing Skills**



 * Strong professional editing skills beyond basic cuts and captions.

 * Excellent pacing, retention editing, sound design, motion graphics, VFX, transitions, and visual storytelling.



* **AI UGC**



 * Ability to generate realistic AI UGC, including AI actors, customer-style testimonials, expert-style videos, lifestyle scenes, and product-use footage.



* **AI Animation**



 * Experience creating AI-generated animations such as:



 * Medical/scientific animation

 * Motion graphics

 * 2D/3D-style animation

 * Cartoon/stylized animation

 * Mechanism/explainer visuals



* **AI-Generated B-Roll**



 * Ability to read a script and generate high-quality B-roll that directly matches each section of the script.

 * Must understand what visual should appear on screen to support the voiceover instead of using random filler footage.



* **Advanced Prompting**



 * Strong prompting skills for AI image and video generation.

 * Must understand start-frame/reference-image workflows, especially for Higgsfield.

 * Able to prompt for camera movement, character consistency, actions, environment, lighting, realism, product interaction, and scene continuity.

title: Part-Time Full-Stack Developer — Next.js, Supabase & AI-Assisted Coding
description:
Next Gen Success needs a dependable, hands-on full-stack developer to improve our custom client portal and internal agency software. This is ongoing development, not a one-off website, page-builder position, or prompt-only AI role. Excellent spoken and written English and genuine technical ability are essential.



Our stack: Next.js, React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Supabase/PostgreSQL, Vercel, and GitHub.



WHAT YOU WILL DO

- Build and improve dashboards, client onboarding, content/training libraries, call-recording workflows, and internal tools.

- Diagnose frontend/backend bugs, fix root causes, and improve performance and usability.

- Work on databases, authentication, authorization, and API integrations. Slack, Google Drive, and Shopify integration experience is a plus, not a requirement to know every service.

- Write appropriate tests, explain your changes in GitHub pull requests, and deploy safely with rollback awareness.

- Protect client data and secrets; never paste sensitive information into unapproved AI tools.



WHAT WE NEED

- Proven experience shipping and maintaining full-stack applications; show work you personally built.

- Strong Next.js/React/TypeScript, SQL, API, and debugging fundamentals.

- Practical Supabase experience and sound server-side authorization and row-level security practices, not just hiding UI buttons.

- Ability to inherit an existing codebase and independently deliver small, safe improvements.

- Clear English for calls, clarifying requirements, and short daily updates.

- Reliable internet and consistent weekday availability.



Cursor and Claude/Claude Code are welcome and preferred; other effective coding tools are fine. You must understand, review, test, and own everything you submit, including AI-generated code.



SCHEDULE

20 hours/week, generally across Monday–Friday. Most work is flexible, with a consistent two-hour overlap within 8 a.m.–noon America/Chicago; agree the exact window before starting. Chicago observes daylight saving time, so Philippine overlap changes seasonally. This is not 24/7 on-call work. Daily updates should cover completed work, next steps, blockers, and PR links.



PAY AND SELECTION

US$1,000/month for the stated part-time hours. We prioritize a capable developer in a focused part-time role, not senior full-time coverage at a bargain salary. Hours or pay may grow with responsibilities, but no increase is guaranteed.



Shortlisted applicants will have an English/technical conversation and may be offered a paid 3–5 hour sandbox trial at US$12/hour, with scope and payment agreed in advance. No unpaid production work, no hiring commitment before the trial, and no unsupervised production/client-data access for it.



TO APPLY THROUGH ONLINEJOBS.PH

Start your application with “Portal Developer” and include:

1. A short introduction and your relevant Next.js/Supabase experience.

2. Two relevant projects, with public demos/code where permitted. Explain what you personally built, a difficult bug you fixed, and how you tested it. Do not disclose former employers’ private code.

3. Your start date, weekly availability, proposed Chicago overlap, and confirmation the compensation works for you.

4. A short answer: A client can access another client's record by changing an ID in a request. How would you investigate, fix, and test this?

5. Your AI coding workflow and how you catch incorrect or insecure generated code.



Individual developers only, not agencies. We value clear thinking, honest ability, and dependable delivery over buzzwords.

title: Customer Service Specialist – Strong Attention to Detail
description:

You'll work independently, with AI tools supporting a large share of your replies.



What you'll do

This role sits at the intersection of data, pricing, trade spend, and customer administration — keeping our sales operations accurate and organised as we grow.



If you’re analytical, love working with spreadsheets, and enjoy building structure behind a sales function, this role is for you.

🌏 Time Zone: PST (Pacific Standard Time)

💵 Compensation: $8 USD per hour



Key Responsibilities

Maintain accurate customer, product, pricing, and sales data across internal systems and spreadsheets

Complete data entry and regularly audit records for accuracy

Maintain customer master files and account information

Support new customer and retailer setup requirements

Manage retailer and distributor forms, portals, and administrative requirements

Support reconciliation of trade spend and flag discrepancies or missing deductions

Assist with compiling information for customer reviews and sales meetings



4. Reporting & Analysis



Prepare recurring sales and commercial reports

Analyse sales data and highlight trends, variances, or areas requiring attention

Support basic forecasting and customer performance tracking

Assist the sales team with ad hoc data pulls and analysis as required



5. General Sales Support



Support account managers and leadership with day-to-day sales administration

Prepare presentations, price lists, sell sheets, and customer-facing documents

Track open actions and follow up with internal and external stakeholders

Help improve sales admin processes and create simple SOPs for recurring tasks



Required Skills & Experience



⚠️ Sales Admin / Operations Experience: 2+ years in Sales Administration, Sales Operations, Commercial Support, or a similar role — required

⚠️ Spreadsheet Skills: Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills; comfortable working with large volumes of data while maintaining high accuracy

Pricing & Trade Spend: Experience managing pricing, product specifications, customer records, or trade spend strongly preferred

Analytical: Strong numerical skills with the ability to identify trends and flag variances

Attention to Detail: High accuracy across data entry, records management, and documentation

Communication: Strong written and spoken English; able to work with internal and external stakeholders

Independence: Proactive and able to manage multiple deadlines with limited supervision

Industry: Experience in CPG, retail, wholesale, packaging, or a physical product business preferred

title: Shopify Customer Support Specialist (Gorgias)
description:
We are looking for an experienced Customer Support Specialist to join our team! As the voice of our brand, you’ll help our customers with orders, shipping, returns and refunds, and find solutions that balance customer satisfaction with business needs.



We want 2+ years experience in Shopify Store
 CS support. The ideal candidate has prior experience in Shopify, Gorgias and supplier communication daily. Bonus points if experience with UK customers and pet/home-goods brands.



### Who are we?



We’re dedicated to making life easier for pet owners and busy mums, with products designed to keep homes comfortable, clean and stylish. Since our 2025 launch, we’ve grown rapidly through viral digital marketing, building a passionate community of customers across the US and UK.



We operate with a small but mighty team focused on speed and continuous improvement, and customer support is a big part of why people keep coming back. We’re excited to bring on a support specialist who’ll play a real role in scaling the brand.



### What is our culture like and who is a good fit?



Culture-fit is our #1 hiring factor. We have a genuine will-to-win, and no task is beneath us if it helps a customer. We live by these values:



- Think on your feet: You make good calls under pressure.

- Bring solutions, not just questions: Come with a recommendation and your reasoning.

- Own it: If a problem lands with you, you see it through.

- Quick, never sloppy: Fast replies that are still accurate and kind.

- Better every day: Every problem is a chance to improve.



You’re a great fit if you follow instructions carefully, stay calm with angry customers, and always think about how to solve the problem in front of you. When a case falls outside our policy, you check with us and bring your own recommendation. You’ll work directly with the founder, with no politics or red tape. If you want a job where you just follow a script, this isn’t it. If you want to be trusted, challenged and grow with a fast-moving company, you’ve come to the right place.



### Key Objectives



* Keep
 inboxes under control with fast, helpful replies

* Resolve
 tickets within our policies, flag with suggestion for unusual cases

* Bring down refunds and chargebacks through clear, kind communication

* Flag repeated customer problems and help improve our templates and processes



### Requirements



* Available Mon-Sat

* Excellent written English

* 2+ years of e-commerce CS support on Shopify and Gorgias

* Experience with return funnels

* Proficient in Google Sheets, 
 and Loom

* Bonus points: Experience with UK customers & pet/home-goods brands



### Accountabilities



* Handle
 tickets on Gorgias promptly, within our response-time target

* Process order changes/refunds in Shopify

* Coordinate with the fulfilment team on order issues

* Escalate and report unusual cases & patterns

* Send brief EOD reports: tickets closed, backlog, response time, refunds...



### How our hiring works



Our process: initial screening, a skill test, then a video interview. Shortlisted candidates are offered a paid trial week, then move to full-time if they meet the KPI targets.



### Salary



USD $900–1200 per month, based on experience, paid twice a month. Long-term role with the potential to grow into a CS Lead as the team grows.



### To apply



Use this subject line: “Gorgias CS - [colour of our logo]”, and answer the screening questions below in your message, with your CV attached:



1. How many years of Shopify stores CS experience do you have?

2. Have you worked with pet/home good brands?

3. Which markets (e.g., US, UK, AU, CA) have you supported before?

4. How many years of experience do you have in Gorgias?

5. What was your average hourly
 ticket volume in your last role?

title: Senior Personal Brand Video Editor (Long-Term)
description:
PLEASE NOTE: THIS IS NOT FOR BEGINNERS OR INTERMEDIATE EDITORS. WE ONLY WANT THE BEST.

Senior Personal Brand Video Editor (Long-Term)



Read This First



This is not a junior role.

This is not high-volume agency churn.

This is a long-term position for a senior editor who understands story, emotion, and pacing, not just cuts and captions.



If you take pride in your work, think like a storyteller, and want consistent high-quality projects, keep reading.



About the Role



We are hiring a Senior Video Editor to own all editing for a growing personal brand in the creative and business space.



Your job is to turn long-form conversations into clear, engaging YouTube videos, then extract the strongest moments into high-performing short-form content for Instagram.



You will not be micromanaged.

You will be trusted to think, suggest improvements, and protect quality.



Monthly Output



• 8-12 YouTube videos

• 40-60 Instagram Reels / short-form videos



This is a consistent monthly workload, not random one-off projects.



What You’ll Be Responsible For



Long-Form Editing

• Structure raw footage into compelling YouTube videos

• Maintain strong pacing and flow

• Clean audio and professional cuts

• Subtle motion graphics and on-screen text when needed



Short-Form Editing

• Identify strong hooks from long-form content

• Create short videos optimized for attention and retention

• Add captions, text emphasis, and clean visuals

• Maintain consistent brand style



Ownership & Workflow

• Organize project files cleanly

• Hit weekly deadlines reliably

• Apply feedback accurately and quickly

• Communicate clearly if something needs clarification



Minimum Requirements (Non-Negotiable)



Please do not apply unless you meet all of these:



• 5+ years of professional video editing experience

• 5+ years working with Adobe Premiere Pro

• Experience editing YouTube long-form content

• Experience editing short-form social videos

• Strong sense of storytelling and pacing

• Ability to work independently without constant direction



Tools & Skills



Required:

• Adobe Premiere Pro (expert level)

• Audio cleanup and balancing

• Caption and subtitle formatting

• Organized timelines and file management



Bonus:

• After Effects

• Motion graphics

• Experience editing personal brands or creators

• Understanding of Instagram and YouTube performance



What This Role Is (and Isn’t)



This role is:

• Long-term

• Quality focused

• Story driven

• Ownership based



This role is not:

• High-volume agency work

• A beginner role

• Micromanaged or rushed



Compensation



• Competitive monthly rate based on experience

• Performance based increases over time

• Long-term growth opportunity



Exact rate discussed during interview.



How to Apply



To apply, please send:

 1. A short introduction

 2. Your best portfolio (long-form + short-form)

 3. Confirmation of 5+ years Premiere Pro experience

 4. One sentence on what makes great personal brand content



Applications without a portfolio will not be considered.



Final Note



We are looking for one great editor, not many average ones.

If you care about quality, story, and long-term work, we’d love to see your application.

title: Accounting Assistant
description:
Accounting Assistant



We’re hiring an Accounting Assistant to support tracking, documenting, and reconciling

renovation and restart expenses for a heavy manufacturing business. This role will help ensure

that vendor invoices, purchase orders, receipts, payment records, and project cost reports are

accurate, complete, and organized. The Accounting Assistant will work closely with the lead

accountant, plant team, vendors, and contractors to keep project spending visible and records

ready for review and approval.



Why You’ll Love This Role



 Contribute directly to the renovation and restart of an industrial facility.

 Work closely with the lead accountant and plant team, with clear visibility into project

spending.

 Help maintain reliable cost records so the team can make informed decisions and

manage the project budget.

 Build experience in project accounting, accounts payable, and construction or industrial

facility cost tracking.

Your Typical Day

 Collect, review, code, and file invoices, receipts, purchase orders, and other expense

documentation.

 Enter expenses into spreadsheets or the accounting system and maintain an up-to-date

expense tracker.

 Match invoices to purchase orders, quotes, delivery records, and approvals when

available.

 Follow up with vendors, contractors, and internal team members to resolve missing

documentation or discrepancies.

 Assist the lead accountant with reconciling vendor statements, tracking payments, and

preparing cost summaries.



What You’ll Be Doing



1) Invoice and Expense Processing



 Receive and organize invoices and expense submissions related to the Clewiston facility

renovation, repairs, equipment, supplies, freight, and installation.

 Check invoices for basic accuracy, including vendor details, invoice dates and numbers,

descriptions, quantities, rates, extensions, and supporting documents.

 Code expenses to the appropriate project, cost category, vendor, or budget line using

guidance from the lead accountant.

 Flag duplicate invoices, unexpected charges, mathematical errors, missing approvals,

and other potential issues for review.

 Maintain a clear record of invoice status, approval, due date, and payment status; do not

release or authorize payments independently.



2) Project Budget and Cost Tracking



 Update the renovation expense tracker and compare recorded costs with the approved

budget or estimates.

 Track commitments and actual costs for contractors, roof repairs, equipment purchases,

dismantling, freight, installation, utilities, and other facility work as assigned.

 Maintain supporting records for purchase orders, quotes, change orders, work

authorizations, delivery tickets, and receipts.

 Help identify cost overruns, unbudgeted items, duplicate charges, and variances for the

lead accountant to investigate.

 Assist with monthly cost summaries and forecasts by compiling current spending,

outstanding invoices, and anticipated expenses



3) Vendor Coordination and Recordkeeping



 Contact vendors and contractors to obtain missing invoices, receipts, W-9s, statements,

lien waivers, or other required documentation, as applicable.

 Maintain organized digital files so each expense can be traced to its supporting

documentation and approval.

 Reconcile vendor statements to recorded invoices and payments, escalating

discrepancies to the lead accountant.

 Coordinate with the plant manager and project team to confirm that goods or services

were received before invoices are submitted for approval.

 Protect confidential financial and vendor information and follow established document-

retention and approval procedures.

What We’re Looking For

 2–4+ years in accounting support, accounts payable, bookkeeping, project

administration, or a related role.

 Strong attention to detail and the ability to organize a high volume of invoices and

supporting documents.

 Working proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including data entry, sorting, filters, and basic

formulas.

 Comfort communicating professionally with vendors, contractors, and internal team

members to resolve routine questions.

 Dependability, discretion, follow-through, and the ability to meet deadlines.

 Ability to work from invoices, quotes, receipts, purchase orders, and other source

documents without losing track of details.



Nice to Have



 Experience supporting construction, industrial, manufacturing, equipment, or facility

renovation projects.

 Familiarity with accounting software, accounts-payable workflows, purchase orders, and

vendor reconciliations.

 Experience maintaining project budgets, cost codes, or job-costing spreadsheets.

 Coursework, certificate, or degree in accounting, finance, business, or a related field.



To apply:



Send your resume

A vocaroo recording and answer this question: 

What's your experience in Heavy Industrial Manufacturing / Industrial Facility Operations? 

How many years in Accounting space?

title: Guest Experience Specialist – Evening Shift (No Graveyard!)
description:
Guest Experience Specialist – Evening Shift (No Graveyard!) | Remote, Philippines

MetaWise Property | Sydney, Australia



About us

MetaWise is a Sydney-based short-term rental management company, operating since 2009 (
). We look after apartments and homes across Sydney and host guests from Airbnb, 
 and other platforms. Our team is based in the Philippines and works on Sydney time.



The role

You'll be the voice of MetaWise for our guests during the evening shift. Guests arrive late, flights get delayed, things go wrong after hours, and you'll be the one who sorts it out calmly and quickly.



Because Sydney is 3 hours ahead, our evening shift falls in the afternoon to evening in the Philippines. No graveyard shift.



What you'll do

- Reply to guest messages across Airbnb, 
 and our PMS (Guesty)

- Handle check-in questions, late arrivals and access issues

- Answer and return calls through our Dialpad phone system

- Troubleshoot issues on the spot (Wi-Fi, appliances, lockboxes, parking)

- Coordinate with cleaners and maintenance when something needs fixing

- Log everything clearly in our CRM so the day team can pick it up

- Escalate urgent issues to management



What we're looking for

- Excellent written and spoken English

- At least 1 year in customer service, hospitality, or a BPO/virtual assistant role

- Airbnb, 
 or Guesty experience is a big plus

- Calm under pressure, with a real problem-solving attitude

- Strong attention to detail. Accuracy matters in our business.



Requirements

- Your own computer (laptop or desktop) with a webcam

- Stable internet (minimum 20 Mbps) plus a backup connection

- Backup power (UPS or generator) preferred

- A quiet place to work and take calls

- Must agree to our data security and confidentiality policy



Pay and terms

- AUD 4.00 per hour

- 3-month probation period

- A retention bond applies (details discussed at interview)

- Exact shift schedule discussed at interview

- Paid training provided

- Long-term role with a stable, growing team



How to apply

Apply through OnlineJobs.ph and include:

1. Your CV

2. A 1-minute voice recording introducing yourself in English

3. A short note (5–8 sentences) on why you'd be great at this role

4. Your answer to this: "A guest messages at 11 PM saying they can't open the lockbox and their phone is at 5%. What do you do?"

5. A screenshot of your internet speed test



Only shortlisted applicants will be contacted.

title: Video Editor | Premiere Pro, YouTube & Reels
description:
Remote, Philippines-based

A$300/week, paid A$600/fortnight



I’m Bernard, founder of Marcelo Productions, a small Perth agency helping founders and service businesses build trust through video.



We’re looking for an editor to work across client projects and my own personal-brand content.



What you’ll do

Edit long-form YouTube videos, Reels and ads. Find strong openings, shape a clear story and make thoughtful decisions about pacing, audio, captions and supporting visuals.



Keep project files organised, communicate clearly and apply feedback carefully. Workload and turnaround expectations will be agreed around the hours available and the complexity of each project.



What we’re looking for

- Strong Premiere Pro skills and demonstrated long-form editing experience.

- Fluent written and spoken English.

- Good storytelling judgement, supported by work you personally edited.

- Verifiable five-star client review history.

- Reliable internet and a computer suited to the work.



Software

You’ll need your own licensed Premiere Pro during the paid trial and onboarding. After successful onboarding, Marcelo Productions covers your Premiere Pro subscription.



How to apply

Please include:

1. Two long-form and two short-form examples, explaining your exact contribution.

2. A short explanation of one editing decision: what you chose and why it improved the video.

3. Evidence of your five-star review history.

4. Your availability, time zone, computer specifications and confirmation that the advertised rate suits you.



Shortlisted applicants will complete a paid trial edit. We’ll agree the fee, brief, deadline and revision scope before you begin. We won’t request free commercial work.

title: GoHighLevel Setup & Account Manager for US Contractor Clients (Long-Term)
description:
ABOUT US



Hard Hat Office is a small, growing US agency that runs the online side of contractor and home service businesses (builders, remodelers, roofers, concrete, landscaping). We set up and manage their website, Google Business Profile,
 and Instagram, booking calendar, AI receptionist and automatic follow-ups, all in GoHighLevel. You'll work directly with me, the owner.



We're looking for a reliable, detail-focused person who's confident on the phone, to help new clients sign up, set up their accounts and keep them running smoothly. This is a long-term role with room to grow as we add clients.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Lead consultations:

- Run discovery calls with interested contractors (by phone or Google Meet): learn about their business, explain what we do, and walk them through our plans

- Answer questions about pricing and what's included, using our call script

- Send the agreement to contractors who are ready to sign, and follow up with those who aren't

- Log every call and its outcome in GoHighLevel



Client onboarding:

- Welcome new clients and run their onboarding call

- Make sure their onboarding form, photos and logo are in

- Walk them through the steps only they can do (ID checks, Stripe verification, Google verification), without ever asking for their passwords or private details

- Run the handover call: show them how to use their account, send quotes and manage jobs from their phone



New client setup:

- Set up client GoHighLevel sub-accounts from our snapshot: business profile, branding, calendars, forms, pipelines and workflows

- Put client websites live in GHL (pasting in ready-made HTML pages) and connect their domains, including DNS records (cPanel, GoDaddy, Namecheap, etc.)

- Set up
 sending domains and branded link domains in GHL

- Connect Stripe to GHL, and set up branded estimate and invoice templates

- Set up Google Business Profiles,
 pages and Instagram business accounts, and connect them to GHL

- Prepare and submit A2P 10DLC texting registrations

- Set up Google Workspace business
 for clients who want it



Ongoing management:

- Check client accounts daily: conversations, bookings and workflow errors

- Make small updates (website text and photos, calendar hours, workflow
s)

- Track each client's monthly texting and AI usage

- Keep a simple setup checklist and status for every client



WHAT YOU NEED

- 1+ year of hands-on GoHighLevel experience (sub-accounts, workflows, calendars, forms, websites/funnels, snapshots)

- Confident, clear spoken and written English. You'll be on calls with US business owners.

- Comfortable on sales or client calls: friendly, patient, and good at explaining things simply to non-technical people

- Experience connecting domains and editing DNS records

- Experience with Meta Business Suite and Google Business Profile

- Organised: you finish what you start and report back without being chased

- Reliable internet, a good headset and a quiet place to take calls

- Able to overlap at least 3–4 hours with US Pacific time



NICE TO HAVE

- Sales, appointment-setting or customer success experience with US clients

- A2P 10DLC registration experience

- GHL Conversation AI / Voice AI agents

- Stripe, Zapier, or using AI tools like Claude or ChatGPT to work faster

- Experience with US home service or trades businesses



DETAILS

- Pay: $5–10 per hour, depending on experience

- Hours: part-time to start, growing to full-time as we add clients

- Long-term, with a raise after a 3-6 months  for strong performance

- Work from home, on your own schedule within the overlap hours



HOW TO APPLY

Please start your application with "HARD HAT" so I know you read this post. Include:

1. How long you've used GoHighLevel, and one or two setups you're proud of

2. A short screen recording (Loom is fine, 2–5 minutes) of any GHL workflow or sub-account you've built. Talk us through it, as if explaining it to a client, so we can hear your English too.

3. Any sales, client call or onboarding experience

4. Your available hours in Philippine time

5. Your expected hourly rate



Shortlisted applicants will have a short call with me and do a small paid test task in a sample GHL account.

title: 𝗛𝗘𝗔𝗟𝗧𝗛𝗖𝗔𝗥𝗘 𝗕𝗨𝗦𝗜𝗡𝗘𝗦𝗦 𝗗𝗘𝗩𝗘𝗟𝗢𝗣𝗠𝗘𝗡𝗧  & 𝗦𝗧𝗥𝗔𝗧𝗘𝗚𝗜𝗖 𝗣𝗔𝗥𝗧𝗡𝗘𝗥𝗦𝗛𝗜𝗣𝗦 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗔𝗚𝗘
description:
# 𝗛𝗘𝗔𝗟𝗧𝗛𝗖𝗔𝗥𝗘 𝗕𝗨𝗦𝗜𝗡𝗘𝗦𝗦 𝗗𝗘𝗩𝗘𝗟𝗢𝗣𝗠𝗘𝗡𝗧 (B2B) & 𝗦𝗧𝗥𝗔𝗧𝗘𝗚𝗜𝗖 𝗣𝗔𝗥𝗧𝗡𝗘𝗥𝗦𝗛𝗜𝗣𝗦 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗔𝗚𝗘𝗥

### U.S. Healthcare Market | Expert Level



**𝗦𝗰𝗵𝗲𝗱𝘂𝗹𝗲:** 20 Hours Per Week Initially  

**𝗪𝗼𝗿𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗛𝗼𝘂𝗿𝘀:** U.S. Eastern Time Business Hours  

**𝗚𝗿𝗼𝘄𝘁𝗵:** Potential to Increase to 30–40 Hours Weekly Based on Performance



## 𝗔𝗕𝗢𝗨𝗧 𝗧𝗛𝗘 𝗢𝗣𝗣𝗢𝗥𝗧𝗨𝗡𝗜𝗧𝗬



We are an established healthcare operations organization specializing in interventional pain management, spine, orthopedics, and ambulatory surgery centers (ASCs).



We are seeking an experienced Business Development & Strategic Partnerships Manager with a proven track record of developing executive relationships, advancing complex sales opportunities, and closing B2B service contracts within the U.S. healthcare market.



**𝗪𝗲 𝗮𝗹𝗿𝗲𝗮𝗱𝘆 𝗵𝗮𝘃𝗲 𝗮𝗻 𝗲𝘀𝘁𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗶𝘀𝗵𝗲𝗱 𝗯𝘂𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗲𝘀𝘀 𝗱𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗹𝗼𝗽𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗽𝗶𝗽𝗲𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲, 𝗲𝘅𝘁𝗲𝗻𝘀𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗽𝗿𝗼𝗳𝗲𝘀𝘀𝗶𝗼𝗻𝗮𝗹 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝘁𝗮𝗰𝘁𝘀, 𝗟𝗶𝗻𝗸𝗲𝗱𝗜𝗻 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗻𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀, 𝗰𝗼𝗻𝗳𝗲𝗿𝗲𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗹𝗲𝗮𝗱𝘀, 𝗮𝗻𝗱 𝗲𝘅𝗶𝘀𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗵𝗲𝗮𝗹𝘁𝗵𝗰𝗮𝗿𝗲 𝗲𝘅𝗲𝗰𝘂𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗿𝗲𝗹𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽𝘀.**



We are not looking for someone to build a prospect list from scratch.



We need a commercially sophisticated professional who can activate our existing pipeline, secure qualified executive meetings, develop strategic relationships, advance proposals, and convert opportunities into profitable, long-term contracts.



You will work directly with the Founder and CEO.



## 𝗠𝗔𝗡𝗗𝗔𝗧𝗢𝗥𝗬 𝗤𝗨𝗔𝗟𝗜𝗙𝗜𝗖𝗔𝗧𝗜𝗢𝗡𝗦



**𝗢𝗻𝗹𝘆 𝗾𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝗳𝗶𝗲𝗱 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝗶𝗰𝗮𝗻𝘁𝘀 𝘀𝗵𝗼𝘂𝗹𝗱 𝗮𝗽𝗽𝗹𝘆.**



1. Minimum 5 years of B2B business development, enterprise sales, or strategic partnerships experience.

2. At least 3 years of direct experience selling services to U.S. healthcare organizations.

3. Proven experience personally closing or materially contributing to signed B2B service contracts.

4. Experience engaging physician owners, healthcare executives, practice administrators, ASC leaders, and economic decision makers.

5. Proven ability to convert existing sales pipelines into qualified meetings, proposals, negotiations, and contracts.

6. Understanding of recurring revenue, contract economics, commercial negotiations, and complex B2B sales cycles.

7. Exceptional written and spoken English with executive-level communication skills.

8. Proficiency with CRM systems, LinkedIn, Microsoft Excel, and pipeline reporting.

9. Ability to commit 20 hours weekly with availability during designated U.S. Eastern Time business hours.

10. Willingness to provide professional references and verifiable deal-closing examples.



Applicants experienced only in cold calling, appointment setting, data entry, or basic lead generation without demonstrated deal advancement will not qualify.



## 𝗞𝗘𝗬 𝗥𝗘𝗦𝗣𝗢𝗡𝗦𝗜𝗕𝗜𝗟𝗜𝗧𝗜𝗘𝗦



### 𝗣𝗶𝗽𝗲𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗲 𝗔𝗰𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻 & 𝗥𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗻𝘂𝗲 𝗗𝗲𝘃𝗲𝗹𝗼𝗽𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁



- Review, qualify, prioritize, and activate our established business development pipeline.

- Identify high-value opportunities with physician practices, pain management organizations, spine and orthopedic groups, and ASCs.

- Research organizational needs, executive decision-makers, and economic buyers.

- Develop strategic account engagement and conversion plans.

- Advance qualified prospects through discovery, meetings, proposals, negotiations, and contracts.



### 𝗘𝘅𝗲𝗰𝘂𝘁𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗥𝗲𝗹𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗵𝗶𝗽 𝗠𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁



- Support existing relationships with physicians, healthcare executives, and strategic partners.

- Prepare personalized executive introductions, meeting requests, and follow-ups for approval.

- Coordinate qualified executive meetings.

- Maintain consistent, professional follow-up communication.

- Develop trust and long-term partnerships through credibility and measurable business value.



### 𝗗𝗲𝗮𝗹 𝗠𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁 & 𝗖𝗹𝗼𝘀𝗶𝗻𝗴 𝗦𝘂𝗽𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁



- Participate in authorized discovery and commercial discussions.

- Identify client operational challenges and potential financial value.

- Support executive proposals and partnership presentations.

- Coordinate proposal follow-ups and negotiation milestones.

- Track objections, purchasing requirements, and next actions.

- Work directly with the CEO to advance opportunities toward signed agreements.



### 𝗖𝗥𝗠 & 𝗣𝗲𝗿𝗳𝗼𝗿𝗺𝗮𝗻𝗰𝗲 𝗥𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁𝗶𝗻𝗴



- Maintain accurate records in our existing CRM and prospect database.

- Track lead ownership, relationship history, sales stages, opportunity values, and follow-up deadlines.

- Identify stalled opportunities and recommend corrective actions.

- Prepare weekly executive pipeline reports.

- Monitor qualified meetings, proposals, negotiations, signed contracts, and attributable revenue.



## 𝗥𝗘𝗤𝗨𝗜𝗥𝗘𝗗 𝗣𝗥𝗢𝗢𝗙 𝗢𝗙 𝗗𝗘𝗔𝗟-𝗖𝗟𝗢𝗦𝗜𝗡𝗚 𝗘𝗫𝗣𝗘𝗥𝗜𝗘𝗡𝗖𝗘



Applicants must provide **three examples of actual B2B contracts** personally closed or materially helped secure with U.S. clients.



For each example, include:



1. Industry and client type.

2. Approximate contract value or annual recurring revenue.

3. Personal responsibility in originating, advancing, negotiating, or closing the opportunity.

4. Approximate sales cycle.

5. Final outcome and measurable contribution.



Anonymized examples are acceptable. Confidential client information is not required.

title: Canadian Sales Manager - Zip Hinges
description:
Canadian Sales Manager – Zip Hinges



Full-time remote opportunity | Canadian territory | Canadian business hours



Job Description



Advance Building Supplies is hiring an experienced sales professional to lead the growth of Zip Hinge and other assigned exterior products across Canada. This is a hands-on selling role with responsibility for developing new accounts, closing orders and building repeat business—not simply responding to incoming inquiries.



You will sell through distributors, contractors, homeowners, retail suppliers, online channels and Amazon. Your product portfolio will expand as additional exterior products join the business. Working directly with the owner, marketing and the wider sales team, you will combine incoming leads with proactive outreach and consistent follow-up.



We will train you on our products. You should already have a developed sales approach and the ability to put it to work.





Company Description



Advance Building Supplies supplies specialty exterior products to customers across Canada. Zip Hinge is a downspout-hinge product sold to contractors, dealers, suppliers and homeowners. Rapid growth in this newer Canadian product line has created the need for a dedicated person to develop its national sales.



Our marketing person manages campaigns and digital lead generation, while product sales representatives handle customer relationships and closing. Gutter-machine inquiries go to our dedicated machine sales representative. We want to build a lucrative, meaningful long-term career with someone whose contribution is visible.

Product information: 





Compensation



Compensation will be performance-based. Our ambition is to offer meaningful responsibility, room to grow and earning potential well above typical pay for comparable roles—a potentially life-changing opportunity for the right high performer.



A minimum draw will be provided to help maintain consistent pay during slower periods. Expected monthly earnings, commission rates, the draw amount and how the draw is reconciled will be explained during hiring and agreed in writing before you accept.



Expected salary for sales commissions if hitting all required metrics would be 100,000 PHP+ per month.  We expect this to be a truly life changing career, but it comes with hard work.





Job Expectations and Performance Metrics



The manager will be expected to meet and work to exceed agreed weekly communication, sales, follow-up and quotation targets. Responsibilities and measures include:



1. Prospecting: Make outbound calls, reach decision-makers and develop new accounts; track calls and meaningful 

customer conversations.



2. Sales and follow-up: Respond to inquiries, explain approved pricing, handle objections, prepare quotes and close orders; track follow-ups due and completed, quotes, orders and sales value.



3. Account development: Maintain customer relationships and identify repeat-order opportunities; track new customers, repeat business and overall Canadian product sales growth.



4. Accountability: Keep CRM records and next steps current, attend the daily team meeting and provide a concise weekly scorecard. Raise missed commitments and obstacles promptly.



Specific numerical targets will be agreed as part of the role’s performance expectations.





Who Is the Right Candidate?



You are an ambitious, disciplined seller who enjoys opening doors and earning repeat business. You can work independently, handle rejection constructively and keep following up without being chased. You welcome clear targets, communicate honestly and want to build a long-term career around results.





Prerequisites / Requirements



1. Demonstrated phone-sales experience, including outbound prospecting, objection handling and closing.



2. Strong spoken and written English, accurate CRM use and confidence speaking with business owners.



3. Reliable internet, a suitable computer and headset, and a professional calling environment.



4. Availability for a minimum of 40 hours per week during Canadian business hours. Working hours may vary to reach customers across Canadian time zones.



Experience with contractors, distributors or building products is an asset. Product training is provided; established selling ability is required.





Application Process / Requirements



Apply through this listing with all of the following:



1. Resume and availability: Include your current work situation and earliest start date.



2. Working-hours confirmation: Confirm that you can meet the 40-hour weekly commitment and work during Canadian 

business hours.



3. An account you won: Describe a business customer you personally acquired through outbound outreach. What did you sell, how many contacts did it take and what secured the order? State the result and currency, any repeat business, and how 

you tracked follow-up. Anonymize confidential details.



4. A follow-up scenario: An exterior contractor says, “We already have a supplier. Just
 me something.” Write your response, the next step you would seek and your follow-up plan for the next seven days. Include what you would record in the CRM. Do not invent discounts or product claims.



5. Introduction video: Provide a video of yourself, at least 30 seconds long, introducing your relevant experience and interest in the role.



6. AI disclosure: Add one line explaining whether and how you used AI in your application.



AI-assisted editing is welcome. AI-written answers are not. Start with your own answers, examples and reasoning. You may 

use AI to improve grammar, clarity or organization, but not to generate the substance of your responses or invent experience and results.



We will run written responses through an AI-content checker as part of our review. A checker result is not proof of authorship and will not, by itself, disqualify you. We will also review your evidence and may ask you to explain your answers live. We want your thinking, not a polished answer you cannot stand behind.



Applications missing any of the required items will not be reviewed.

title: YouTube Video Editor + Motion Graphics (work with a 1M+ sub creator & channel)
description:
WHO WE ARE



Compound One Studios makes long-form YouTube videos for different finance and investing channels. We are the team behind New Money, one of the biggest investing channels on YouTube with over 1 million subscribers. Our work is taking a complicated money topic and making it clear and easy to watch.



THE JOB



We're hiring one full-time YouTube editor who can make good motion graphics to own videos from first cut to final export. That's around 6+ long-form videos a month, usually 10 to 25 minutes each.



You'll:



- Shape raw footage into a video people want to keep watching: the hook, the pacing, the story.

- Work out what should be on screen so a complicated money idea becomes easy to understand.

- Build charts, numbers and explainer animations, using motion graphics you build, as well as some of our templates. We don't mind if you use AI tools too, as long as the quality is high, we don't mind how we get the best results.

- Check that every number on screen is right, and speak up when something doesn't add up.

- Finish sound, colour and export to our checklists.



WHAT YOU NEED



- At least 2 years editing long-form YouTube videos (8+ minutes) for clients.

- Premiere Pro and After Effects or similar.

- Examples of graphics you made that explain something, not just templated animations that decorate the screen.

- Good YouTube retention instincts. You know why someone keeps watching and why they leave.

- Clear written and spoken English.

- Great attention to detail.

- A computer with 16 GB+ of RAM and a dedicated graphics card, plus reliable internet.

- An ability to tell us early, and communicate well if you are likely to miss a deadline or something is going to slip.



You don't need a finance background but a basic understanding of investing concepts is a big bonus. We can teach you. Curiosity and care with numbers matter more.



THE HARD PARTS



- We give a lot of detailed feedback, and every video goes through a checklist.

- Our videos are graphics heavy and the standard is high.

- This is an exclusive, full-time role of 40 hours a week. Sydney is 3 hours ahead of Manila, and we need a few hours of overlap each day with Sydney business hours.



WHAT YOU GET



- PHP 54,000 to 96,000 a month as an independent contractor. Where you start depends on the quality of your work.

- One team and steady monthly pay, instead of chasing clients.

- Regular feedback from the people behind New Money.

- Room to move up and grow (in role and in salary) as you prove yourself.

- A world-class education in how to make high-quality YouTube content working directly with one of the top creators in finance and investing.



HOW TO APPLY



Please apply through this form only. It takes about 5 minutes, and you don't need a CV or cover letter: 



Messages sent without the form won't be read. Individuals only, no agencies.



WHAT HAPPENS NEXT



1. A short unpaid edit, a few hours.

2. A paid sample, about one working day.

3. A Google Meet call or interview.

4. A real paid project on a real client video working alongside our actual team.

5. An offer.



We review applications multiple times per week.

title: Full-Cycle Acquisitions Closer — US RE Wholesaling | Leads + Playbook Provided | US$6/hr + Up to 11% of Funded Fees
description:
This is a talk-time job. If you love being on the phone with US homeowners and investors, and you have the locked contracts to prove it, keep reading. If you need training, this is not your seat.



**Who we are**

A virtual real estate wholesaling operation. We put motivated sellers' houses under contract in US markets and assign those contracts to cash buyers. Assignment fees target US$10,000+. We only operate where we're cleared to: Oklahoma, Illinois and the City of Philadelphia are excluded, along with any other market we choose to exclude.



**The role: full cycle, first call to funding**

You run the deal end to end: call the seller, find the real reason they're selling, present the offer, handle objections, get the contract signed, line up the cash buyer, and quarterback it with title until it funds. The owner signs off on the key decisions (listed below). Everything else is yours.



**Why this seat is different**

- Leads arrive stacked from public distress data (tax-delinquent, code-violation, probate/estate) plus FSBO sellers.

- Every lead is pre-underwritten: ARV from sold comps, a repair estimate, and your offer band (opening offer, target, hard ceiling) on a deal sheet.

- A written closer playbook (call script, motivation questions, objection handling, follow-up cadence, closing checklists) is provided on day one.

- Our cash-buyer list is being built in each target market, and you'll help grow it. That's why you're paid extra when you bring the buyer.



**What you own**

- Seller calls: cold open, rapport, motivation, a below-ask cash offer, objections, verbal agreement.

- Sending our approved contract to the seller for signature once the owner approves the offer.

- Dispositions: building and maintaining our cash-buyer list per market (recent cash buyers, their criteria, how fast they close), marketing locked deals and collecting buyer offers.

- Closing coordination: documents, signatures and updates between seller, buyer and title until funding.

- Same-day CRM logging on every lead and buyer. Short pipeline report every Friday.



**What the owner approves, every time**

1. Any offer above the hard ceiling on the deal sheet.

2. Every contract before it's sent. You never sign on the company's behalf.

3. All money. You never handle earnest money, wires or wire instructions.

4. The final buyer and the assignment fee.

5. The title company we use.



**The daily standard**

- Cold lists: 120+ dials a day. Warm FSBO days: 50+ dials.

- 3+ hours of real talk time, 12+ live seller conversations a day.

- Offers presented daily: 3 on FSBO days, 1–2 on cold-list days.

- A 30-day follow-up cadence on every worked lead. Most contracts come from follow-ups, not first calls.

- 25+ active cash buyers with known criteria per target market within your first 30 days.

- First signed contract targeted within 45 days. Activity and pipeline reviewed at 30 days.



**How we call**

Every call is made by a person. No AI dialers, no bots, no spam texts. Numbers are scrubbed against federal and state Do Not Call lists before dialing. Calls only inside each seller's local legal hours (never before 8 AM or after 8 PM their time, stricter where required). Opt-outs honoured instantly. No texting without written consent. You follow the playbook's compliance lines word for word: sellers are told we may assign the contract, and we never promise a closing date or price the owner hasn't approved. Calls are recorded. They protect your commission as much as they protect us.



**Required, all of it**

1. Fluent spoken and written English that US homeowners understand easily. We screen this first; weak English is an automatic no.

2. 2+ years calling US sellers for a wholesaling or acquisitions company. Dispositions experience is a strong plus.

3. Contracts you personally locked in the last 12 months, with proof (see application).

4. You can run the full seller call without reading from a script, while keeping the required compliance lines.

5. You know MAO, assignments, earnest money, title-company closings and what cash buyers pay for.

6. Daily CRM + power-dialer fluency (GoHighLevel, Podio, REsimpli, XLeads or similar). We provide logins; we don't train CRM basics.

7. Quiet workspace, noise-cancelling headset, stable internet + backup connection.



**Schedule**

Full-time, Monday to Friday, 10 AM–6 PM US Eastern (40 hrs/week). That's overnight Philippines time, so only apply if that schedule genuinely works for you long-term.



**Pay, printed not hidden**

- US$6/hour, 40 hours a week (about US$1,040/month base).

- PLUS 8% of the assignment fee on every deal you lock that funds. Uncapped, paid when the title company funds, not when the seller signs.

- PLUS a 3% dispositions bonus when you also bring the cash buyer who closes it (11% total).

- After 90 days AND 2 funded deals, the acquisition commission rises to 10% on every deal after that (up to 13% with the buyer bonus).

- Example: on a US$15,000 fee where you locked the seller and brought the buyer, you earn US$1,650. These are examples, not a promise of earnings.

- You can see the closing statement on each of your deals to verify your commission.

- Pay lands the same day every cycle, your hours are protected (no off-shift expectations), and feedback runs both ways. Firm standards, straight dealing.



**How to apply (incomplete applications are deleted unread)**

Subject line: CLOSER | [# contracts locked in last 12 months] | [biggest assignment fee] | [Your Name]

Start your message with the word "MAO" so we know you read this far. Then include:

1. A 60-second voice recording: your cold open to a tax-delinquent homeowner in Ohio. Talk, don't read.

2. Written answers:

   a. How many wholesale contracts have you personally locked in the last 12 months?

   b. Your biggest assignment fee, and your exact role in that deal?

   c. Have you sold deals to cash buyers yourself? How many, and how did you find the buyers?

   d. Which CRM and dialer have you used most, and for how long?

3. Proof: a recorded seller call (seller details removed) OR a redacted signed purchase contract you locked, plus one reference we can call.



**Next step**

Shortlisted candidates do a paid, recorded live-call trial on approved leads at the same hourly rate plus commission. The trial is the interview.

title: Senior Amazon Brand & Growth Manager | Established 7-Figure Private Label Business

We already have dedicated team members managing PPC advertising and supply chain operations independently.



Our next step is to bring in someone who can lead brand growth, identify new opportunities, develop strategies, and ensure their successful execution.



This is not a traditional Amazon Virtual Assistant position.



We are looking for a strategic thinker and proactive problem-solver who can work independently, take ownership of projects, and deliver measurable business results without constant supervision.

 Amazon Listing Optimization & Conversion

- Audit existing product listings and identify opportunities for improvement.

- Develop compelling, conversion-focused titles, bullet points, and A+ Content strategies.

- Conduct keyword research and implement Amazon SEO best practices.

- Analyze competitors' listings, images, pricing, reviews, and positioning.

- Develop creative briefs and coordinate with designers to improve product imagery.

- Plan and evaluate A/B tests to improve conversion rates.



 Brand Growth & Strategy

- Develop and execute strategies to increase sales, market share, and profitability.

- Identify opportunities to improve existing products' competitive positioning.

- Analyze sales trends, customer behavior, and competitor activity.

- Recommend pricing strategies, product variations, bundles, and other growth opportunities.

- Identify underperforming products and develop actionable improvement plans.

- Prioritize projects based on potential business impact.



 New Product Launches

- Conduct market research and competitive analysis for new product opportunities.

- Evaluate market demand, pricing, competition, and profitability potential.

- Develop and coordinate go-to-market strategies.

- Work with the existing team to prepare and execute product launches.

- Monitor launch performance and implement improvements.



 Team Collaboration & Project Management

- Collaborate with our PPC Specialist and Supply Chain Manager.

- Coordinate designers, freelancers, and other external resources when necessary.

- Manage project timelines, priorities, and deliverables.

- Ensure projects move forward independently without constant direction from the business owner.

- Provide regular progress updates and actionable recommendations.



 Performance Analysis

- Monitor key metrics, including revenue, profit margins, TACOS, ACoS, conversion rates, organic sales, and average order value.

- Identify performance trends and areas for improvement.

- Develop data-driven growth strategies.

- Prepare concise weekly performance and project updates.



 Requirements



Must Have:

- Minimum 3 years of relevant experience with Amazon private label brands.

- Proven experience managing or growing established Amazon businesses.

- Strong knowledge of Amazon Seller Central, Amazon SEO, listing optimization, and product launches.

- Strong analytical skills and understanding of e-commerce profitability.

- Experience with competitor research and market positioning.

- Excellent English communication and copywriting skills.

- Ability to manage multiple projects and coordinate with team members.

- Highly proactive, independent, and results-oriented.



Nice to Have:

- Experience managing 7-figure Amazon brands.

- Experience using Helium 10, Amazon Brand Analytics, and Manage Your Experiments.

- Proven success improving conversion rates, organic rankings, or profitability.

- Experience coordinating creative teams and managing new product launches.

- Previous experience in a Brand Manager, Growth Manager, or E-commerce Manager role.



 Who We're Looking For



We want someone who thinks beyond assigned tasks.



Someone who notices when a product is losing market share, investigates why, develops a recovery strategy, and takes initiative to implement improvements.



Someone who understands that profitable growth matters more than revenue alone.



Most importantly, someone who can independently identify opportunities, make informed decisions, and take responsibility for delivering results.



We value demonstrated experience, problem-solving skills, initiative, and accountability over certifications or job titles.



What We Offer



- Competitive salary of $1,500–$2,000/month, depending on experience.

- Stable, long-term, full-time remote employment.

- Opportunity to play an important role in growing an established and profitable business.

- Significant autonomy and ownership of growth initiatives.

- An existing team supporting advertising and supply chain operations.

- Direct communication with the business owner.

- Potential for performance-based bonuses and career growth.



 How to Apply



Please include the following in your application:



1. Your Experience



Describe the Amazon private label brands you've worked with, their approximate annual revenue, and your specific responsibilities.



2. Your Achievements



Provide 2–3 concrete examples of how you contributed to improving sales, profitability, conversion rates, organic rankings, or product launches.



Please include measurable results wherever possible.



3. Strategic Thinking

4. Additional Information

- Your expected monthly salary.

- Your availability to start.



Important: Start your application with the words "Growth Mindset" to confirm that you've carefully read this job posting.

title: YouTube Video Editor - Police Bodycam Videos
description:
We're hiring a video editor for a new YouTube channel of police bodycam videos. For each video you'll receive the bodycam footage and a script with timestamps. You'll cut the footage to the script and make it entertaining to watch. We're looking for someone to work with us on an ongoing basis.



The story is already picked out. Your job is to make 15–20 minutes of bodycam footage hold attention, without changing what happened.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Cut the footage to the script's timestamps: a short cold open from the best moment, then the stop as one clear story.



- Add transitions, zooms, pictures, on-screen text, music and sound effects that keep it moving and make the funny moments land.



- Keep the bodycam audio clear: level the dialogue, keep music under it, and bleep strong swearing.



- Export to our settings and upload each finished video to our shared Google Drive.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Examples of YouTube videos 10 minutes or longer that you edited yourself, ideally bodycam, police, true crime or commentary.



- Confidence with Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve, CapCut or similar, including sound design and audio mixing.



- Comic timing: you know when a zoom, sound effect or pause makes a moment funnier, and when to leave it alone.



- Good English, for following the script and catching what's said on muffled bodycam audio.



- Reliable deadlines and clear communication.



Workload: To start, 2 videos a week, each 15–20 minutes long. Footage and scripts are supplied.



Turnaround: Within 48 hours of receiving the footage and script.



HOW TO APPLY



Start your application with the word "lemon" and include:



1. Your
 address



2. Your portfolio link



3. Links to 2–3 YouTube videos you edited that are 10 minutes or longer, and what you did on each



4. Links to any bodycam, police or true crime YouTube channels you've edited for, what you did and when (or "none yet")



5. Your current workload: how many videos you edit a week, and how many more you could take on for us



6. An edit idea for this imaginary moment: a boater tells the officer he's only had two beers while an empty case floats past behind him. What would you add to make it land, in 1–2 sentences?



7. The editing software you use, and where you get your music and sound effects



8. Your expected rate (per video or per month)



9. The hours you work (Philippine time)



10. Your 
 username
