title: Senior Property Data Engineer - Proptech & AI
description:
Help build the data infrastructure behind the future of real estate.



We're building an AI-powered real estate technology platform designed to connect property intelligence, agency CRM, buyer and seller activity, investment analytics and intelligent automation into one ecosystem.



We're now looking for a Senior Property Data Engineer with strong Australian real estate data experience to help us take our data infrastructure to the next level.



This is not a traditional data analyst or reporting role.



We need a hands on engineer who understands how real estate data works, how to bring multiple datasets together, and how to build reliable infrastructure that can power intelligent property products at scale.



What you'll be working on



1. Property Data Infrastructure



Integrate property information from multiple Australian real estate data sources.



Connect historical sales, listings, withdrawn properties, rental information, ownership-related records, land information and planning data.



Build on our existing Property Brain and master Property ID architecture.



Resolve inconsistent addresses, duplicate records, apartment/unit identification issues and conflicting property information.



Develop reliable links between properties, listing campaigns, contacts and property histories.



2. Data Integration & Engineering



Design, build and maintain scalable API integrations and automated data pipelines.



Work with structured, semi-structured and large-scale property datasets.



Improve data extraction, transformation, matching, validation and synchronisation.



Implement efficient caching, freshness monitoring, error handling and reconciliation.



Maintain accurate and consistent data across our CRM, buyer portal and AI applications.



3. Buyer, Seller & CRM Intelligence



Connect buyer activity, property views, saved properties, enquiries, inspections, offers and preferences.



Improve data quality for buyer matching and AI-generated real estate recommendations.



Ensure CRM contact and lead records remain accurate across connected systems.



Help transform property and consumer data into actionable opportunities for real estate agents.



Support reliable agent-performance, follow-up and sales-conversion analytics.



4. AI & Data Platform Development



Work closely with our AI and software engineering team to provide reliable information to AI-powered applications.



Improve the structure, availability and quality of data used for property intelligence and automated workflows.



Build reusable data services rather than separate integrations for every feature.



Establish robust data governance, monitoring, testing and documentation.



Ensure customer and agency data is appropriately separated, permission-controlled and handled in accordance with applicable privacy and data licensing requirements.



What we're looking for



Essential experience



Proven professional experience in data engineering, data platforms or backend data integration.



Practical experience working with real estate, property, land, geospatial or related datasets. Preferably Australian experience



Strong Python and SQL skills.



Experience with PostgreSQL and relational database architecture.



Experience building and maintaining production API integrations and ETL/ELT pipelines.



Strong ability to clean, normalise, deduplicate and reconcile large datasets.



Experience with entity resolution, record linkage and data quality validation.



Understanding of data architecture, source-of-truth design and automated monitoring.



Ability to investigate complex data problems independently and implement reliable solutions.



Strong communication skills and the ability to work alongside an existing development team.



Highly regarded



Experience with Australian property data providers or platforms such as CoreLogic/Cotality, Domain, REA Group, Pricefinder, Landchecker, Homer or similar.



Familiarity with G-NAF, Australian address matching, property identifiers, geospatial data, land parcels and cadastral information.



Experience with PostGIS, MongoDB, cloud infrastructure and scheduled data-processing systems.



Experience integrating CRM systems, listing feeds and real estate marketing platforms.



Knowledge of property sales histories, planning overlays, ownership information, rental markets and property transaction data.



Experience with event tracking, customer identity resolution, data warehouses or analytics engineering.



Experience supporting AI applications with structured, accurate and permission-controlled data.



Understanding of commercial data licensing, retention requirements and API cost management.



You don't need experience with every platform listed. We're most interested in someone with strong engineering fundamentals, genuine property-data knowledge and demonstrated ownership of complex integrations.



What success looks like



Within your first few months, we'd want you to:



Improve the accuracy and completeness of the data connecting our property platforms.



Strengthen the existing Property Brain and contact identity infrastructure.



Establish measurable data quality, freshness and integration monitoring.



Reduce duplicate, missing and incorrectly matched property and contact records.



Improve the reliability of buyer matching, seller intelligence and CRM activity data.



Help establish a scalable data foundation that can support additional Australian real estate agencies.



Why join us?



We're not building another standalone real estate application.



Our ambition is to create a connected property operating system that brings together the tools, intelligence and workflows used by agents, buyers, sellers, investors and property owners.



You'll work directly with the founder and our existing engineering team, with the opportunity to take meaningful ownership of an important part of the platform.



You'll be building infrastructure that supports real users and real property transactions.



This is an opportunity for someone who enjoys solving difficult data problems, wants responsibility for production systems and is excited about building technology with substantial long-term potential.



How to apply



Please submit your CV and a brief explanation of:



Your experience with Australian real estate or property datasets.



A complex data integration, entity-matching or data platform project you've personally built or owned.



The technologies you used and how you verified data accuracy and reliability.



We are particularly interested in candidates who can demonstrate practical work rather than simply list technologies on their CV.

title: Head of Retention Marketing | AI-Native | Multi-Brand Ecommerce
description:
**We're not looking for a good marketer. We're looking for one of the best in the industry.**



**TYPE OF WORK:** Full Time — Remote



**WAGE / SALARY:** Exceptional compensation for exceptional talent. We are prepared to pay at the level required to attract a truly world-class candidate.



**HOURS PER WEEK:** 40



## JOB OVERVIEW



### Before You Apply, Ask Yourself One Question.



**Are you genuinely one of the best retention marketers in the industry?**



Not the best person on your team.



Not one of the better marketers at your company.



Not someone who is pretty good at Klaviyo, can write compelling subject lines, and knows how to put together an
 calendar.



**We mean someone who could walk into a room filled with the industry's best retention marketers and confidently hold their own.**



If that's you, we'd love to meet you.



If you're average, good, or even very good, this probably isn't the right opportunity.



We're building something ambitious, and we're willing to compensate extraordinary talent accordingly.



### Who We Are



oCommerce is a growing portfolio of ecommerce businesses operating across completely different consumer markets.



Our brands currently include:



- **Agent84** — Fashion-forward athleisure and lifestyle apparel.

- **Skivys** — Comfort-focused women's fashion and loungewear.

- **Blossomdale** — Plants, gardening, and lifestyle products.

- **Shrimpy Business** — A leading online destination for freshwater aquarium shrimp, fish, plants, and supplies.



And we're just getting started.



We have additional brands launching and expanding, creating an opportunity to build a world-class retention marketing operation across an entire portfolio.



Each brand has a different customer, personality, buying journey, and opportunity.



We need someone who can master all of them.



### Your Mission: Build the Best Retention Marketing Operation in Ecommerce.



We're hiring a **Head of Retention Marketing** to own and transform customer retention across our portfolio.



You will lead an existing team of three:



- Two
 Marketing Strategists

- One
 Graphic Designer



You'll own the strategy, execution, performance, and continuous improvement of our retention marketing programs.



Today, that means
 marketing and SMS marketing.



Tomorrow, it could mean entirely new channels, customer experiences, AI-powered personalization, loyalty programs, predictive customer journeys, and opportunities we haven't even considered yet.



**We don't want someone who simply manages what we're already doing. We want someone who shows us what we should be doing that we've never thought of.**



We send multiple
 campaigns every week, typically at least 3–4, and operate across distinct brands with expanding marketing calendars.



Your job is to turn this operation into a sophisticated, efficient, AI-powered revenue engine.



Not just more
s.



**More revenue. More repeat customers. Higher lifetime value. Better customer relationships.**



And a marketing operation that gets smarter every month.



## KEY RESPONSIBILITIES



### 1. Own Retention Revenue — Not Just
 Campaigns



You are accountable for measurable business outcomes.



You'll develop and execute strategies to increase repeat purchase rates, customer lifetime value, retention revenue, and customer engagement.



You'll identify opportunities in segmentation, automation, lifecycle marketing, cross-selling, upselling, win-back campaigns, and customer reactivation.



You understand that sending
s is an activity.



**Generating incremental, profitable revenue is the objective.**



### 2. Be Truly AI-Native



This is non-negotiable.



We are not impressed by someone who uses ChatGPT to generate subject lines or rewrite marketing copy.



That's the starting line, not the finish line.



We want someone who understands how to build an AI-powered retention marketing department.



Someone who can:



- Train AI systems to deeply understand each brand's identity, voice, products, creative guidelines, and customers.

- Develop reusable brand knowledge bases and AI workflows that produce consistently on-brand marketing.

- Use AI to research customers, generate campaign ideas, build sophisticated marketing calendars, and plan customer journeys.

- Create systems capable of generating complete
 campaigns — from strategy and copy to creative direction, design assets, and potentially finished
 builds.

- Develop AI-powered processes for segmentation, personalization, experimentation, reporting, and performance analysis.

- Train your team to use AI in ways that multiply their output and elevate creative quality.

- Identify emerging AI technologies and turn them into practical, measurable competitive advantages.



We want you thinking about how to accomplish in one day what traditional marketing teams take a week to produce.



**AI should not merely make you faster. It should fundamentally change what your department is capable of accomplishing.**



### 3. Lead a High-Performance Creative and Marketing Team



You will directly manage two
 Strategists and one
 Graphic Designer.



You'll establish clear standards for strategy, creative quality, performance, and accountability.



You will develop your team, improve their processes, identify weaknesses, and continuously raise the bar.



We expect a leader who can execute personally when necessary but whose real talent lies in building systems and teams that perform brilliantly.



You should be capable of reviewing an
 and immediately understanding why it will or won't work — from the subject line to the creative hierarchy, customer psychology, offer, and call to action.



### 4. Master Multiple Brands Simultaneously



The person who buys luxury-feeling athleisure is not the same person shopping for aquarium shrimp.



Their motivations, emotions, purchase patterns, and relationships with the brand are completely different.



You'll need to build distinct retention strategies for Agent84, Skivys, Blossomdale, Shrimpy Business, and additional brands as our portfolio expands.



Each brand must retain its own personality.



We don't want generic marketing dressed up in different logos.



**We want exceptional marketing that feels like it could only have come from that particular brand.**



### 5. Build Beyond
 and SMS



The title is Retention Marketing, not
 Marketing.



We expect you to identify and develop opportunities beyond our existing channels.



That could include:



- Sophisticated customer lifecycle automations

- Loyalty and referral programs

- Predictive segmentation and AI personalization

- Customer reactivation and replenishment programs

- Push notifications and additional messaging channels

- Post-purchase experiences and customer education

- VIP programs and highly personalized customer journeys

- New technologies or retention strategies we haven't explored



We don't expect you to implement every possible channel.



We expect you to know which opportunities matter, prioritize intelligently, and execute the ones that will make a meaningful difference.



## WHAT MAKES YOU EXCEPTIONAL?



### We're Looking for Evidence, Not Confidence Alone.



**You understand consumer psychology.**



You can explain why customers buy, why they return, why they disengage, and how to influence those decisions without relying entirely on discounts.



**You understand the numbers.**



Revenue, conversion rates, click-through rates, segmentation performance, repeat purchase rates, customer lifetime value, and profitability are second nature to you.



You can distinguish between revenue that marketing genuinely created and revenue that would likely have occurred anyway.



**You have exceptional creative judgment.**



You recognize what makes an
 beautiful, compelling, authentic, and commercially effective. You can protect a brand's creative identity while continuously improving performance.



**You are technically sophisticated.**



You understand ecommerce marketing platforms, advanced flows, behavioral triggers, segmentation, deliverability, and automation architecture.



You can work comfortably with tools such as Klaviyo, Shopify, leading SMS platforms, analytics systems, and AI technologies.



**You think like an owner.**



You don't wait for someone to tell you that repeat purchase rates are declining or that a customer segment is underperforming.



You notice. You investigate. You make a plan. You execute.



**You are obsessed with improvement.**



You've never been satisfied with an
 performing well simply because it beat last month's results.



You want to know what would make it perform twice as well.



And then you test it.



## YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS



**First 30 Days — Understand and Challenge Everything**



Audit our existing retention marketing operations,
 and SMS performance, customer journeys, team capabilities, and technology.



Identify opportunities to improve revenue, customer engagement, efficiency, and creative execution.



Establish a clear performance baseline and prioritize the highest-impact improvements.



**Days 31–60 — Build a Better Machine**



Begin implementing your highest-priority improvements.



Upgrade campaign strategy and lifecycle automations.



Introduce AI-powered brand knowledge, campaign planning, and creative workflows.



Establish clear accountability and operating standards across the team.



**Days 61–90 — Show Us What's Possible**



Demonstrate measurable progress against the agreed baseline.



Show meaningful improvements in campaign quality, execution efficiency, customer experience, or retention performance.



Present a compelling roadmap for scaling a world-class retention department across our expanding portfolio.



We don't expect miracles overnight.



**We do expect to see the unmistakable difference between an ordinary manager and an extraordinary one.**



## WHAT WE OFFER



**Compensation worthy of exceptional talent.**



We are not trying to find the cheapest person who can perform this role.



We are looking for the best person we can find, and we understand that excellence commands a premium.



**Real ownership.**



This is not a position where you simply execute someone else's marketing calendar. You will have the opportunity to shape the retention strategy of multiple growing ecommerce businesses.



**An existing team.**



You won't be starting from zero. You'll have a team of three to lead, develop, and transform into an exceptional operation.



**An AI-first environment.**



We are actively investing in AI, automation, and systems that enable our people to achieve extraordinary results.



You will have the freedom to challenge conventional processes and introduce better ways of working.



**An opportunity to grow with the business.**



As our portfolio expands, so will the scale, sophistication, and potential impact of the retention marketing department you lead.



This is an opportunity to build something you can be genuinely proud of.



## HOW TO APPLY



We take this position seriously, and we're interested in demonstrated excellence rather than polished resumes. Please fill out the detailed application in this link here: 



### One Final Thought



There are thousands of people who can manage
 campaigns.



Hundreds who can build great retention strategies.



Far fewer who can combine strategic brilliance, creative instinct, analytical sophistication, leadership, and AI-native thinking into something truly extraordinary.



**That's the person we're looking for.**



If you've spent your career wondering what you could accomplish with real ownership, an ambitious portfolio of brands, a team to lead, and a company willing to invest in excellence...



**This might be the opportunity you've been waiting for.**



We'd love to hear from you.



---

 Marketing | Retention Marketing & Automation | Team Leadership

title: Pre-Litigation Case Manager (Texas Personal Injury) | $11/hr
description:
Read this first



This job is for experienced personal injury case managers only. If you have never owned your own caseload of plaintiff PI files, please do not apply. We do not train on the basics, and applications from people without real case management experience will be deleted without a reply.



We are slow to hire and quick to fire. We take our time picking the right person, and we pay above market to get them. In return we expect full performance from the first week. If the work falls short, or if we find padded hours, hidden mistakes, or a second job you didn't tell us about, the engagement ends.



About us



We are a plaintiff personal injury firm in Houston. We handle catastrophic injury, trucking and commercial vehicle crashes, wrongful death, premises liability and medical malpractice. We carry a few hundred open files and are growing. A former district judge and a former prosecutor run the firm, so we care a lot about honest reporting of time, deadlines and mistakes.



What the job is



You own the pre-litigation file from the day the contract is signed until the case settles or goes to the litigation team. You are the client's main contact, and you know where every one of your files stands without being asked.



Required capabilities



You must already be able to do all of the following on your own, starting in week one:



1. Caseload. Manage 40 or more active pre-lit PI files at once without help from another case manager.

2. Client contact. Call every client on a set schedule, at least every 14 days, and document every attempt in the system the same day.

3. Treatment tracking. Know who is treating, how often, and when care stops. Flag any treatment gap over 14 days to the attorney right away.

4. Records and bills. Request medical records and itemized bills when treatment ends. Follow up with providers every 7 days until the file is complete.

5. Insurance. Open and manage BI, UM/UIM and PIP claims. Get policy limits and keep adjusters away from the client.

6. Liens. Identify and confirm hospital liens, letters of protection, health insurance, Medicare and Medicaid interests before any settlement talk.

7. Property damage. Handle rental, repair and total loss so the client is not left without a car.

8. Demands. Produce at least 2 complete demand packages per week: records, bills, medical summary and damages chart, ready for attorney review.

9. Settlement support. Prepare settlement statements and send provider reduction requests.

10. Case management system. Keep every file current in the system. If it isn't in the system, it didn't happen.



Minimum requirements



At least 2 years as a case manager at a US plaintiff personal injury firm

At least 2 years with each employer in the last 5 years. Short stints will be screened out

Daily experience with PI case management software such as MyCase, Filevine, CasePeer, Needles or SmartAdvocate

Clear spoken and written English for client calls

The habit of telling the attorney bad news early

This must be your only job



What gets you disqualified



Skipping or rushing the screening questions

Answers that read like they were written by AI

No US plaintiff PI case management experience

Holding another job while working for us



Working remote



You need a private workspace and internet strong enough for client calls, with backup internet and backup power. You must be online during Central Time business hours, on camera for team meetings, and quick to respond on chat. Time is logged by task as you go. Firm files stay in firm systems.



Hours and pay



40 hours a week, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time. In Manila that is 10:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. from mid-March to early November, and 11:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. the rest of the year.



Pay is $11 per hour. The rate is set and not open to negotiation. Strong performers are eligible for periodic bonuses.



Paid time off begins to accrue after your first 60 days. You earn 10 PTO days per year, accrued at 10/12 of a day each month. In your application, tell us your preferred payment method.



Screening questions



Answer each one in a few sentences, in your own words. We care more about how you think than about polished writing.



1. A client did six weeks of chiropractic care, then stopped. Forty-seven days later they call to say the pain is worse and they want to go back. What do you do, and in what order? What do you tell the attorney?

2. A case has a Medicaid claim, a hospital lien and a chiropractor treating under a letter of protection. The client wants to know what they'll walk away with. What do you check before giving any number?

3. On day three of a new case, you learn the at-fault driver's adjuster called the client, took a recorded statement and made a settlement offer. What do you do?

4. You have 40 files. Today a client's rental ends, two providers owe records past 30 days, a demand is due to the attorney tomorrow, and a client hasn't been called in 20 days. How do you order that list, and why?

5. While building a demand, you find records showing the client treated for the same body part two years before the wreck. The client never told you. How do you handle it with the client and with the attorney?

6. How many active files do you handle right now by yourself, how often do you call each client, and how many demands do you complete in a typical week?



Begin your application with the words "Case Manager 11" so we know you read the whole post.

title: Executive Administrator for Remote Accounting Firm
description:
Chief of Staff & Executive Administrator



ABOUT SIMPLE FINANCIALS



Simple Financials is a growing bookkeeping, accounting, tax, and CFO advisory firm operated primarily by our outstanding team in the Philippines.

We help small business owners improve how they use QuickBooks Online and provide accurate financial reporting, analytics, and ongoing financial guidance. Our firm continues to grow through new clients, expanded services, strategic partnerships, and potential acquisitions.

We are hiring a Chief of Staff & Executive Administrator to help coordinate the company, strengthen our administrative systems, support our leadership team, and serve as a trusted partner to John, our Founder and CEO.

This is not a traditional executive assistant position. We are looking for an executive-level administrator and developing Chief of Staff who is also willing to perform detailed executive assistant work when needed.

The right person will be comfortable moving between companywide administration, accounting support, hiring, process development, meeting leadership, project coordination, and direct support for the Founder.



THE PURPOSE OF THIS ROLE



Simple Financials has grown to the point where important administrative and leadership responsibilities cannot remain concentrated with only the Founder and Director of Operations.

This person will help create greater accountability, organization, and redundancy throughout the company. They will make sure recurring responsibilities are completed, important projects continue moving, and leadership has accurate information when decisions need to be made.

At the same time, this person will take ownership of many of the responsibilities currently consuming the Founder’s time, including
, scheduling, meeting preparation, communication, and project follow-up.

Success in this role will allow the Founder to focus more of his time on:

- Acquiring other accounting firms

- Strategic partnerships

- Senior-level hiring

- Funding opportunities

- Business development

- New service offerings

- Long-term company strategy



PRIMARY RESPONSIBILITIES



Company Administration and Coordination

- Coordinate recurring administrative responsibilities across the company.

- Maintain PTO records, employee trackers, and administrative calendars.

- Review payroll information and timesheets for completeness and unusual activity.

- Assist employees with payroll and administrative onboarding matters.

- Confirm that background checks, employment documents, and security requirements are completed.

- Ensure team members have proper systems access and two-factor authentication.

- Maintain organized records, checklists, and recurring administrative procedures.

- Identify responsibilities that currently depend on only one employee and establish backup coverage.

- Help leadership ensure important company obligations are completed accurately and on time.

- Facilitate internal meetings when other leadership team members are unavailable.



Accounting, Billing, and Management Support

- Review recurring client billing for accuracy and completeness.

- Help confirm that client pricing matches approved proposals and current scopes of work.

- Monitor outstanding invoices and coordinate collection follow-up.

- Maintain client pricing and monthly billing information.

- Assist with quotes and proposals for prospective clients.

-Maintain management reports related to:

- Staff capacity

- Revenue by client

- Monthly billing

- Client profitability

- Staff profitability

- Staff utilization

- Accounts receivable

- Leadership scorecards

- Identify missing, unusual, or inconsistent financial information and follow up with the appropriate team member.

- Help leadership improve spreadsheets, dashboards, and recurring reporting systems.

- Provide administrative support for accounting projects without being responsible for all technical accounting work.



A strong understanding of accounting and QuickBooks Online is important because this role will regularly work with financial information, accountants, client billing, management reports, and accounting firm processes.



Hiring and Employee Onboarding

- Draft and update job descriptions.

- Coordinate interviews and communicate with candidates.

- Participate in interviews for selected positions.

- Maintain candidate notes, scorecards, and assessment results.

- Coordinate reference checks and background checks.

- Prepare onboarding schedules for new employees.

- Confirm that new hires receive the necessary accounts, equipment, documentation, and training.

- Help onboard new employees into payroll and company administrative systems.

- Follow up with managers to make sure onboarding responsibilities are completed.

- Help create a professional and consistent employee experience from recruiting through onboarding.



Processes, Quality Control, and Security

- Help write, organize, and maintain critical company processes.

- Turn rough notes, meeting transcripts, and recorded instructions into clear procedures.

- Coordinate quarterly quality assurance and quality control reviews.

- Track whether required QA/QC procedures have been completed.

- Identify missing processes, outdated documentation, and single points of failure.

- Maintain an organized company process library.

- Help ensure employees follow required privacy, security, and confidentiality procedures.

- Recommend improvements to recurring administrative and operational systems.



Leadership Meetings and Company Follow-Through

- Help organize leadership and all-hands meetings.

- Prepare agendas, scorecards, reports, and supporting documents.

- Gather department updates before meetings.

- Attend important company meetings and document decisions, assignments, and deadlines.

- Distribute action items and follow up with responsible team members.

- Maintain a central list of major company projects and leadership commitments.

- Identify overdue or stalled projects and escalate them when necessary.

- Provide leadership with concise updates without requiring them to repeatedly request information.

- Help keep meetings focused, organized, and productive.



Executive Support for the Founder

A major part of this role will be creating leverage for John, the Founder and CEO.

Responsibilities will include:

- Reviewing and managing John’s
 account throughout the workday.

- Routing
s and requests to the appropriate departments or team members.

- Identifying urgent, sensitive, or time-sensitive matters requiring John’s attention.

- Drafting responses for
s John needs to answer.

- Responding directly to routine communications when authorized.

- Organizing, prioritizing, and maintaining the inbox.

- Tracking
s that require action or follow-up.

- Giving John short, organized summaries of matters requiring a decision.

- Managing John’s calendar and scheduling internal and external meetings.

- Protecting time for strategic projects and reducing unnecessary meetings.

- Preparing agendas, documents, and background information before meetings.

- Attending John’s important Simple Financials meetings.

- Tracking commitments and projects assigned by John.

- Following up with employees on projects where clients or team members are depending on John.

- Helping manage John’s LinkedIn account and selected social media content.

The goal is for John to manage decisions and strategy rather than manage his inbox, calendar, and routine follow-up.



Strategic and Special Projects

- Support acquisitions, partnerships, software evaluations, and company growth projects.

- Conduct initial research and organize supporting information.

- Coordinate communication between internal and external participants.

- Track deadlines, decisions, and next steps.

- Prepare short summaries and decision documents.

- Help ensure projects continue moving when leadership attention shifts.

- Assist with light sales, marketing, recruiting, and business development activities.

- Represent the Founder in selected internal discussions after earning the necessary trust and authority.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR



The ideal candidate combines accounting knowledge, administrative excellence, leadership potential, and executive judgment.

We will prioritize candidates who have:

- A degree or professional background in accounting.

- Significant experience using QuickBooks Online.

- Experience as an executive administrator, Chief of Staff, executive assistant, operations professional, or project coordinator.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Fast and dependable response times during working hours.

- Strong professional
 communication.

- A polished and professional on-camera presence.

- Exceptional organization and follow-through.

- The ability to communicate confidently with employees, clients, and company leadership.

- The ability to respectfully hold others accountable.

- Sound judgment regarding what should be handled, delegated, escalated, or brought to the Founder’s attention.

- The ability to protect confidential financial, employee, client, and company information.

- A willingness to perform both strategic work and detailed administrative tasks.

A CPA credential is strongly preferred but is not required.

Candidates will complete a QuickBooks Online assessment so we can evaluate their current knowledge. Some QBO and accounting training can be provided, but candidates with strong existing accounting and QBO experience will receive priority.

Less-experienced candidates are also welcome to apply. We may consider promising applicants at a lower starting rate and provide additional paid training.



AI AND TECHNOLOGY REQUIREMENTS



The successful candidate must be an advanced and responsible user of AI and modern productivity tools, including:

- ChatGPT

- Claude

- Perplexity or comparable research tools

- QuickBooks Online

- Google Workspace or Microsoft 365

- Meeting transcription and summarization tools

- Project management and documentation systems

- Advanced spreadsheets

This person should be able to use AI to:

- Draft and summarize
s

- Produce meeting notes and action lists

- Create procedures and job descriptions

- Research candidates, vendors, and opportunities

- Organize information for leadership decisions

- Improve spreadsheets and administrative workflows

- Prepare reports and executive summaries

AI-generated work must always be reviewed for accuracy, professionalism, confidentiality, and sound judgment.



WORK SCHEDULE AND HOME OFFICE REQUIREMENTS



Most working hours must overlap with the U.S. Central Time Zone because this person will manage the Founder’s inbox, attend meetings, and communicate with leadership throughout the U.S. workday.

Applicants must have:

- Reliable high-speed internet

- A dependable computer

- A professional camera and microphone

- A quiet and private workspace

- The ability to participate professionally in confidential client and company meetings



OUR COMPANY CULTURE



Simple Financials is a supportive and growing company. We treat our team members in the Philippines as respected professionals and client-facing experts—not as anonymous outsourced workers.

Your ideas, feedback, and professional judgment will be important to our success.

We want someone who:

- Is positive, kind, and enjoyable to work with

- Holds themselves to a high professional standard

- Is highly self-directed and organized

- Accepts feedback without becoming defensive

- Continually looks for ways to improve

- Takes ownership of responsibilities and outcomes

- Wants to build a long-term career with our company

- Is willing to step into leadership as the company grows

We genuinely care about our team members. If a client is disrespectful to someone on our staff, we will prioritize our employee’s well-being over keeping that client.

Our goal is to create a company where the right people can remain for five, ten, or more years while continuing to grow professionally, personally, and financially.



COMPENSATION AND LONG-TERM ADVANCEMENT



The expected compensation path for a successful candidate is:

- Starting compensation: $7 USD per hour

- After approximately three to six months of successful onboarding: $8 USD per hour

- After approximately one additional year: $9 to $12 USD per hour, depending on performance, accounting knowledge, leadership ability, and overall success in the role

Less-qualified candidates may be offered a lower starting rate with additional paid training.

This position also includes opportunities for annual raises, profit sharing, and expanded leadership responsibilities.

As Simple Financials grows and acquires additional firms, a high-performing candidate may progress into a senior Chief of Staff, executive operations, or company leadership position.

Over the next three to five years, long-term compensation may potentially grow to approximately $30,000 to $40,000 USD annually, depending on the company’s growth, the person’s performance, and the responsibilities they assume.



BENEFITS



Paid Time Off



Vacation leave begins accruing when you start:

- 15 days per year during years one and two

- 18 days per year during years three and four

- 21 days per year after five years

Unused vacation leave may be paid out as cash the following year according to company policy.



Paid Holidays



Simple Financials currently observes the following paid holidays:

- New Year’s Day

- Easter Monday

- Independence Day

- Thanksgiving Day

- Christmas Eve

- Christmas Day

- New Year’s Eve



Health Insurance Reimbursement



Simple Financials provides a monthly reimbursement of up to $30 USD toward qualifying PhilHealth and Social Security System payments.



Profit Sharing



Eligible team members may participate in the company’s profit-sharing program after completing the required onboarding and eligibility period.



Company Retreats



We generally organize two to three in-person retreats or team outings each year to strengthen relationships and give our remote team opportunities to spend time together.



Additional Bonuses



Simple Financials periodically provides additional bonuses related to holidays, birthdays, Mother’s Day, personal milestones, or exceptional performance.



How to Apply



To Apply, please click the following link - 
/o/JB-LTTZCWUN8/landing?u=
Qualified applicants should be prepared to complete:

- An experience questionnaire

- English and aptitude assessments

- A QuickBooks Online assessment

- A recorded video interview

- Interviews with members of our Philippine leadership team

- A final interview with John, the Founder and CEO

title: CONTENT CLIPPER / SHORT-FORM VIDEO EDITOR
description:
$600/MONTH + EXTRA VIDEO BONUSES + PERFORMANCE BONUSES

We are a growing fashion and lifestyle brand looking for a short-form content editor with a strong understanding of **what makes people stop scrolling and keep watching.**



This is NOT a job where we give you timestamps and tell you exactly what to clip.



We have a large library of:



- YouTube/vlog footage

- Lifestyle footage

- Business conversations

- Fashion and product discussions

- Behind-the-scenes footage

- Travel content

- Raw conversations

- B-roll



Your job is to **watch the footage yourself, understand the context, identify the strongest moments, and turn those moments into content people want to watch.**



WHAT YOU'LL CREATE

Content will primarily be used for:

- TikTok

- Instagram Reels

- YouTube Shorts



Most clips will be vertical, although some horizontal content may also be used.



We require a minimum of:

**25 APPROVED CLIPS PER WEEK**



Approximately:

**100 APPROVED CLIPS PER MONTH**



Quality matters just as much as quantity.



Simply exporting a video does not automatically mean it counts toward your weekly total. We are looking for clips that we would genuinely want to post.



WE WANT SOMEONE WITH CONTENT INSTINCTS



You should be able to watch raw footage and recognize:

- A funny moment worth clipping

- A strong business insight

- An interesting story

- A fashion opinion

- A good product explanation

- A behind-the-scenes moment

- Something relatable

- Something people will want to comment on or share



Some videos may only need 15–30 seconds. Others may need 60–120+ seconds to properly tell the story. Your job is to understand the difference.



We do NOT want someone who needs to be told where every clip begins and ends.



EDITING STYLE

We want clean, engaging editing.

You may use:

- B-roll

- Zooms/punch-ins

- Speed changes

- Clean transitions

- Sound effects when appropriate

- Memes/references when appropriate

- Creative pacing



Do not make the videos feel overly edited or corny.



We will generally handle:

- Music

- On-screen hooks

- Captions/subtitles

- Post captions

- Titles

- Descriptions



You should primarily deliver **clean edits using the original audio.**



COMPENSATION

Starting compensation:

**$600 USD/month**

We begin with a **30-day trial period.**



The base expectation is:

**25 approved clips per week.**



You can earn more by creating additional approved content.

For every **5 additional approved clips beyond the weekly minimum**, you earn: +$25**



Example:

25 approved clips = Base compensation 

30 approved clips = +$25  

35 approved clips = +$50  

40 approved clips = +$75  

45 approved clips = +$100



PERFORMANCE BONUSES

If one of your clips performs exceptionally well organically:

**100K views → +$25**

**250K views → +$50**

**1M+ views → +$100**



We count whichever individual platform the video performs best on. Views from different platforms are not combined.



Our goal is simple:

**The better the content you create, the more opportunity you have to earn.**



LONG-TERM OPPORTUNITY

We are looking for long-term relationships. If you're great at finding content and consistently creating strong clips, there is room for:

- Increased compensation

- More responsibility

- More footage

- Additional bonuses

- Long-term work with our team



We may also hire multiple clippers if we find multiple people who are exceptional at this. 

We are producing a lot of content and want to become **impossible to ignore.**



HOW TO APPLY

Please send:

1. 3–5 short-form videos you personally edited.

2. Your best-performing video and how many views it received.

3. Why you believe that video performed well.

4. What editing software you use.

5. A short explanation of how you would approach a 45-minute vlog if we gave you no timestamps.

6. Confirmation that you can consistently deliver 25+ approved clips per week.



Start the subject line of your application with:

**I FOUND THE CLIP** so we know you read this listing thoroughly. 



If you need someone to tell you exactly what moments to edit, this position is not for you.



If you can watch raw footage, find moments other people overlook, and turn them into great content, we want to hear from you.

title: Genius Games Executive Assistant
description:
About Genius Games & Elf Creek Games



Genius Games and Elf Creek Games create and publish board games, puzzles, and educational products for families, hobby gamers, classrooms, and retailers around the world.



Genius Games focuses on science-based games and puzzles that make complex topics engaging and accessible. Elf Creek Games publishes richly themed strategy games and expansions with strong hobby appeal. Together, our teams manage products, Kickstarter campaigns, licensing relationships, inventory, fulfillment, customer support, and retail sales.



We are looking for a reliable, organized, and detail-oriented Executive Assistant to work directly under our current Executive Administrator. This person will help with daily communication, trackers, documents, customer and partner support, and general administrative follow-through.



Our Core Values:

As a member of the team, you are expected to embody the company’s core values:



- Self-directed High Achievement: Take responsibility and initiative without needing step-by-step instructions.

- Always Improving: Keep learning and growing in skill, judgment, and professionalism.

- Own The Outcome: Follow through, take responsibility, and work to make results excellent.

- Feedback Driven: Seek feedback, listen carefully, and apply it to improve your work.

- Candid and Compassionate: Communicate honestly, kindly, and respectfully.



Role Overview

We’re hiring an Executive Assistant to support the current Executive Administrator for Genius Games and Elf Creek Games.



This is a support role, not a leadership role. You will help keep
s organized, follow-ups moving, trackers updated, files easy to find, customer and partner communication handled professionally, and documents prepared for review.



The right person is organized, responsive, careful with details, and comfortable working with
s, spreadsheets, documents, customer messages, and task trackers.



Schedule & Availability

This role requires overlap with U.S. business hours, especially during training and regular team meetings.



- Ability to work meaningful overlap with U.S. Central Time during training

- Availability to attend regular administrative and operations-related meetings when needed

- Ability to monitor and respond to assigned
s in a timely manner

- Ability to complete recurring daily, weekly, and monthly tasks on schedule



What You’ll Do Most

This role will focus mainly on three areas:



A.
 Monitoring & Communication Support



- Monitor assigned inboxes, including 
 
 
 
 and 
 assigned

s using approved templates and company tone

s to the Executive Administrator or the correct team member

s, missing updates, and open questions

- Consolidate data from
s, meetings, spreadsheets, and reports into organized summaries

C. Customer, Partner & Internal Support

Additional Things You May Help With

These tasks may come up as needed, but they are not the main focus of the role:

- Production coordination tasks

- Operations-related admin tasks



What We’re Looking For

Skills can be developed, but accuracy, reliability, organization, and ownership are essential.



You’re a Fit If You:

- Can follow recurring workflows without constant reminders

- Communicate clearly when something is missing, unclear, delayed, or urgent

- Are comfortable with
s, spreadsheets, documents, trackers, folders, and online tools

- Can take meeting notes and turn them into clear action items

- Can draft documents and spreadsheets cleanly for review

- Are proactive about raising issues before they become bigger problems

- Can work independently while keeping the Executive Administrator informed

- Handle customers, partners, and internal communication professionally



This Role Is NOT a Fit If You:

- Are careless with names, dates, links, files, messages, or tracker updates

- Wait until the last minute to flag problems

- Need step-by-step instructions for every recurring task after training

- Struggle to communicate clearly or professionally

- Are uncomfortable working with inboxes, spreadsheets, documents, or trackers

- Have difficulty keeping multiple tasks organized at the same time



Tools You’ll Work With

- Gmail and Google Drive

- Google Calendar

- Google Docs

- Google Sheets / Excel

- Slack or similar communication tools

- Shopify, Amazon, Kickstarter, or pledge manager tools when needed

- AI tools for organizing notes, drafts, summaries, and reports when helpful



What This Role Does NOT Include

- No final executive or operational decision-making without approval

- No accounting or financial decision-making ownership

- No legal advice or contract negotiation responsibilities

- No graphic design or creative asset ownership

- No marketing strategy ownership

- No managerial authority unless specifically assigned



Your First 90 Days



Week 1

- Shadow the Executive Administrator on
s, meetings, follow-ups, documentation, and tracker updates

Month 1

 monitoring, meeting notes, tracker updates, and file organization

s with lighter review

Compensation

The position will include a three-month training and onboarding period, which will be compensated at $3.00 per hour for the first three months given your experience. After this period, compensation will increase to $4.00 USD per hour for the next nine months of working under the current management to advance in the role.



After a year of working with our company, compensation will increase to $5.00 per hour USD, with annual promotions and raises to follow. It can be higher depending on your level of success in the position.

Plus:

- 15 days PTO per year during years 1–2, 18 days during years 2–5, and 21 days after 5+ years

- 6–8 paid holidays, with U.S. holidays observed and flexibility for key Philippine holidays



To Apply

Please click the following link: 
/o/JB-P63B7YBOY/landing?u=
You will be prompted to upload a resume, fill out an Experience Questionnaire, and take a quick assessment. If you pass this first round, we will send a few follow-up assessments.

title: Email Marketing Assistant
description:
#
 Marketing Assistant (Klaviyo) | Multi-Brand Ecommerce | AI-Forward Team



**TYPE OF WORK:** Full Time — Remote



**HOURS PER WEEK:** 40



## JOB OVERVIEW



### Great Marketing Ideas Deserve Flawless Execution.



We're looking for an exceptional *
 Marketing Assistant with strong Klaviyo experience** to join our growing ecommerce marketing team.



If you're the person who catches the broken link nobody else noticed, spots a segmentation mistake before a campaign goes live, and takes genuine pride in building beautiful, high-converting
s, we want to meet you.



This isn't a job where you'll simply copy and paste text into
 templates all day.



You'll help execute retention marketing for multiple fast-growing ecommerce brands, work alongside talented strategists and designers, and learn how to use AI and automation to build a smarter, more efficient marketing operation.



You'll report directly to our **Head of Retention Marketing**, working closely with our
 strategists and creative team.



We're looking for someone who is reliable, proactive, technically capable, and excited to become truly exceptional at what they do.



### About Us



oCommerce is a growing portfolio of ecommerce companies operating across multiple industries.



Our brands include:



- **Agent84** — Fashion-forward athleisure and lifestyle apparel.

- **Skivys** — Women's comfort clothing and loungewear.

- **Blossomdale** — Plants, gardening, and lifestyle products.

- **Shrimpy Business** — A leading online retailer of freshwater aquarium shrimp, fish, plants, and supplies.



And we're continuing to grow.



Each brand has a completely different audience, voice, creative identity, and marketing calendar.



We send multiple
 campaigns every week across our portfolio, and as we launch additional brands, the scale and sophistication of our marketing operation will continue to increase.



We're looking for someone who can help us execute all of this with exceptional accuracy and efficiency.



## WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



### 1. Build and Launch
 Campaigns in Klaviyo



This will be a major part of your role.



Working from briefs created by our marketing strategists, you will:



- Build complete
 campaigns using Klaviyo's
 builder.

- Implement approved copy, graphics, product images, layouts, and calls to action.

- Ensure every
 looks great on desktop and mobile devices.

- Add product links, landing pages, discount codes, and tracking parameters.

- Configure the correct audience segments, exclusions, and sending schedules.

- Create and execute A/B tests when directed.

- Coordinate campaign approvals and schedule
s accurately.

- Maintain organized campaign naming conventions and records.



**Our expectation is simple: every campaign should be built correctly, thoroughly checked, and ready to send on time.**



### 2. Build and Maintain Automated
 Flows



You'll support our Head of Retention Marketing in building, updating, and maintaining Klaviyo automations.



Examples include:



- Welcome and subscriber onboarding flows

- Abandoned cart and checkout recovery

- Browse abandonment

- Post-purchase follow-ups

- Cross-sell and upsell sequences

- Win-back and customer reactivation campaigns

- VIP and loyalty communications

- Product education and replenishment reminders



You'll help implement flow logic, triggers, delays, segmentation, conditional splits, and
 content.



We don't expect you to independently design our entire retention strategy.



But we do expect you to understand how these systems work and become increasingly capable of building sophisticated automations.



### 3. Own
 Quality Assurance



Details matter enormously in this role.



Before a campaign goes live, you'll check:



- Spelling, grammar, and formatting

- Mobile and desktop responsiveness

- Every link, button, and destination page

- Product information, pricing, and discount codes

- Correct segmentation and suppression rules

- Personalization variables and dynamic content

- Send dates, times, and time zones

- Brand voice and visual consistency

- Unsubscribe functionality and other compliance requirements



We believe great
 marketers develop a healthy obsession with getting the details right.



**Our goal is zero preventable
 mistakes.**



### 4. Use AI to Work Smarter



We're building an AI-native marketing department.



That means we expect everyone on our team to embrace AI as an essential part of how they work.



You'll learn to use tools such as ChatGPT and other AI technologies to:



- Help prepare and organize marketing campaigns.

- Check copy for errors and brand consistency.

- Speed up repetitive campaign-building tasks.

- Generate and improve workflow documentation.

- Assist with
 personalization and content variations.

- Analyze campaign performance and identify potential issues.

- Explore opportunities to automate repetitive work.



We're especially excited about candidates who have already experimented with using AI to improve their marketing workflows.



**We don't want you spending two hours manually doing something that could be accomplished accurately in ten minutes with the right AI workflow.**



At the same time, AI-generated work must be reviewed carefully. Accuracy and brand quality always come first.



### 5. Help Track and Improve
 Performance



You'll support our team in monitoring key
 marketing metrics, including:



-
 conversion rates

- Click-through rates

- Revenue per recipient

- Campaign-attributed revenue

- Deliverability, bounce rates, and spam complaints

- Unsubscribe rates

- Automated flow performance



You'll help maintain reports, identify unusual results, and support our strategists in understanding what's working.



You don't need to be an advanced marketing analyst.



But you should be comfortable with numbers and genuinely interested in what makes
 campaigns successful.



### 6. Keep Our Marketing Operation Organized



You'll work across multiple brands, campaigns, and deadlines.



This means keeping campaign calendars updated, organizing assets, tracking approvals, maintaining Klaviyo hygiene, and communicating proactively with your manager.



You'll coordinate with our
 strategists and graphic designer to make sure campaigns move smoothly from concept to launch.



We use project management tools and structured workflows, and we expect you to keep your work organized and transparent.



## WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



### Required Skills and Experience



- At least 1–2 years of hands-on Klaviyo experience, ideally with Shopify ecommerce brands.

- Experience independently building and scheduling
 campaigns.

- Familiarity with Klaviyo segmentation, lists, campaign settings, and automated flows.

- Strong understanding of
 formatting and mobile-responsive layouts.

- Excellent written English, proofreading skills, and attention to detail.

- Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.

- Comfortable working with Google Workspace and project management tools.

- Experience using ChatGPT or other AI tools professionally.

- Ability to follow detailed briefs while identifying mistakes or opportunities for improvement.



### Nice to Have



- Klaviyo SMS marketing experience.

- Basic HTML/CSS knowledge for
 troubleshooting.

- Experience with Canva, Figma, or similar creative tools.

- Familiarity with ecommerce customer journeys and retention marketing.

- Experience creating Klaviyo reports and analyzing performance.

- Experience with AI automation tools such as Make, Zapier, or n8n.



## WHAT WILL MAKE YOU STAND OUT?



**You're incredibly detail-oriented.**



You double-check your work before anyone asks. You don't assume a link works. You test it.



**You're proactive.**



When something is unclear or missing, you communicate early. You don't wait until the deadline to raise a problem.



**You're technically curious.**



You want to understand Klaviyo beyond its basic features. You enjoy discovering better ways to build campaigns and automate repetitive tasks.



**You understand that speed and accuracy go together.**



You work efficiently without sacrificing quality.



**You take ownership.**



When you commit to completing something, your manager can trust that it will get done correctly and on time.



**You want to grow.**



You don't just want another remote job. You want to become an outstanding retention marketing professional and develop valuable skills in AI, ecommerce, and marketing automation.



## WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



In your first 30 days, you'll become familiar with our brands,
 calendars, workflows, and Klaviyo accounts.



Within 60 days, we expect you to independently build and quality-check most assigned campaigns, requiring minimal corrections.



Within 90 days, you should be a dependable part of our marketing operation, helping execute campaigns accurately, maintain automations, and introduce improvements to how we work.



Over time, you'll have opportunities to take on more sophisticated campaign builds, automation projects, and technical responsibilities.



## WHY JOIN US?



**Work with growing ecommerce brands.**



You'll get exposure to multiple industries, customer audiences, and marketing strategies.



**Learn from an experienced team.**



You'll work directly with our Head of Retention Marketing, strategists, and creative professionals.

We're actively building AI-powered processes and want our team members to grow alongside these technologies.



**Make a real impact.**



Your work won't disappear into an endless corporate approval process. You'll see your campaigns reach real customers and contribute to measurable business results.



**Build a long-term career.**



As our portfolio expands, so will the opportunities for talented people who consistently deliver excellent work.



## HOW TO APPLY



We're more interested in what you can do than how impressive your resume sounds. Please apply here: 





### One Last Thing



We're not looking for someone who needs to be reminded to check their work.

Someone who wants to become a Klaviyo expert, master AI-powered marketing workflows, and grow alongside an ambitious ecommerce business.



**If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.**

title: Senior Graphics Designer
description:
# Exceptional Senior Graphic Designer | Fashion, Ecommerce & Creative Advertising



**TYPE OF WORK:** Full Time — Remote



**SALARY:** $1,500–$2,500 USD/month, depending on portfolio, experience, and demonstrated creative excellence



**HOURS PER WEEK:** 40



**SKILL REQUIREMENTS:** Adobe Photoshop | Graphic Design | Art Direction | Fashion & Ecommerce Design | Figma



## JOB OVERVIEW



### We Don't Need Someone Who Can Make Graphics. We Need Someone With Extraordinary Taste.



There are thousands of people who know how to use Photoshop.



Thousands more who can make a decent-looking advertisement, put text over an image, or generate something attractive using AI.



**That's not who we're looking for.**



We're looking for a genuinely exceptional graphic designer.



Someone with an instinctive understanding of composition, typography, color, visual hierarchy, and what makes creative work feel *expensive, original, and unforgettable.*



Someone who has spent years developing their craft.



Someone who doesn't just follow design trends but has the taste and creativity to create something distinctive.



Someone who can look at an average design and immediately see ten ways to make it extraordinary.



**If your portfolio looks like everyone else's, this probably isn't the right opportunity.**



But if you're the kind of designer whose work makes people stop scrolling, we'd love to meet you.



### Who We Are



oCommerce is a growing portfolio of consumer ecommerce brands operating across multiple industries.



Our brands include:



- **Agent84** — Fashion-forward athleisure with a contemporary, cool-girl aesthetic.

- **Skivys** — Women's comfort clothing and loungewear, with an emphasis on effortless style.

- **Blossomdale** — Plants, gardening, and lifestyle products.

- **Shrimpy Business** — A leading online retailer of freshwater aquarium shrimp, fish, plants, and supplies.



And we're continually launching and expanding brands.



We're exceptionally design-oriented.



We believe creative direction, visual identity, and beautiful execution are fundamental to building strong consumer brands.



We don't want our businesses to look like generic ecommerce stores.



And we certainly don't want advertisements or
s that look like they came from a template.



**Every brand should have its own distinct visual world.**



We're looking for a designer who can help us build those worlds.



## YOUR ROLE



You'll be a key creative partner to two of our most important marketing departments:



**1. Paid Advertising Team**



Creating outstanding static advertising assets for platforms such as Meta, Google, and other digital advertising channels.



**2.
 Marketing Team**



Designing beautiful, commercially effective
 creatives, campaign heroes, promotional graphics, and supporting visual assets.



You'll collaborate with our creative leadership, advertising specialists, and retention marketing team to turn marketing concepts into exceptional creative work.



This is a hands-on design position.



We want someone who enjoys actually designing—not just managing freelancers, generating prompts, or directing others to do the creative work.



## WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING



### 1. Create Exceptional Static Advertising Creatives



You'll design original, visually compelling advertising assets for our ecommerce brands.



This includes:



- Conceptualizing original advertising designs rather than relying on standard templates.

- Creating high-quality static ads for Meta, Google, and other paid channels.

- Developing campaign concepts, promotional graphics, product-focused creatives, and branded advertisements.

- Combining photography, typography, graphic elements, and visual storytelling in distinctive ways.

- Producing multiple creative approaches and variations for performance testing.

- Adapting successful concepts across placements, formats, and audiences.

- Collaborating with our ads team to understand performance and continuously improve creative quality.



We care about conversion rates.



But we also care deeply about aesthetics.



**The best advertisements shouldn't look like advertisements. They should look like something people genuinely want to see.**



We want someone who understands how to accomplish both.



### 2. Design Beautiful, High-Converting
 Creatives



You'll work closely with our
 strategists and retention marketing manager to create visually engaging
 campaigns.



Your work will include:



- Designing original
 hero images and campaign graphics.

- Creating beautiful layouts that respect each brand's visual identity.

- Developing promotional artwork, product collages, editorial-style imagery, and creative storytelling elements.

- Using typography, color, spacing, and composition to establish clear visual hierarchy.

- Creating reusable design components without making every campaign look identical.

- Designing for mobile-first readability and effective
 execution.

- Translating marketing briefs into polished visual concepts with minimal creative hand-holding.



We believe
s should be beautiful enough that customers actually enjoy opening them.



For our fashion brands especially, we want creative that feels closer to a great fashion publication than a generic discount
.



### 3. Understand Brand Identity at a Deep Level



This is one of the most important requirements.



You will work across brands with dramatically different audiences, products, and creative identities.



The designer who makes beautiful graphics for a fashion brand might not automatically understand how to create compelling graphics for an aquarium brand.



We need someone who can do both.



You'll need to understand:



- Brand personality and positioning.

- Customer demographics and buying psychology.

- Typography, color, and composition appropriate to each brand.

- The difference between premium, playful, editorial, technical, and lifestyle-focused design.

- How to create emotional consistency across different marketing channels.

- How to interpret and expand brand guidelines without making everything repetitive.



**We should be able to remove the logo from your designs and still recognize which brand they belong to.**



That's the level of brand understanding we're looking for.



### 4. Bring Originality and Creative Thinking



We're not hiring someone simply to execute instructions.



We want someone who contributes ideas.



Someone who can take a brief that says "Promote our new clothing collection" and develop several genuinely interesting creative directions.



Someone who knows when a layout needs more breathing room.



When typography should be the hero.



When photography should do the talking.



When a design needs restraint rather than another graphic element.



And when breaking the established pattern will create something extraordinary.



**Good designers execute. Exceptional designers elevate the entire creative direction.**



We want the second kind.



### 5. Use AI as a Creative Advantage — Not a Replacement for Design Ability



We are an AI-forward company.



We actively encourage our team to use emerging AI technologies to improve creative workflows, increase efficiency, and explore new possibilities.



We'd love someone comfortable using generative AI for:



- Creative exploration and concept development.

- Generating or modifying visual elements.

- Extending and adapting photography.

- Accelerating image editing and production.

- Developing creative variations at scale.

- Learning and maintaining brand-specific AI workflows.

- Automating repetitive production tasks.



But let's be very clear.



**Typing prompts into an AI image generator does not make someone a graphic designer.**



We are not interested in generic AI-generated visuals masquerading as original creative work.



AI-generated assets often lack intentional typography, nuanced composition, brand consistency, and the craftsmanship that separates average design from exceptional work.



We expect you to recognize those shortcomings and correct them.



You must have genuine, independent design ability.



If every AI design tool disappeared tomorrow, you should still be an outstanding designer.



**AI should amplify your talent, not substitute for it.**



### 6. Work at the Speed of Ecommerce



We operate multiple brands with frequent campaigns, promotions, launches, and advertising tests.



You'll need to be comfortable managing competing priorities while maintaining an exceptionally high creative standard.



We value efficiency, organization, and reliability.



But we do not believe speed should come at the expense of good taste.



You'll be expected to:



- Manage briefs and deadlines across multiple brands.

- Deliver organized, editable source files.

- Follow brand guidelines and established design systems.

- Communicate proactively when information or assets are missing.

- Incorporate feedback constructively and efficiently.

- Maintain consistency and quality while producing creative at scale.



## WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



### Non-Negotiable Requirements



**1. An Exceptional Portfolio**



Your portfolio is the single most important part of your application.



We want to see genuinely impressive, original graphic design.



Not just technically correct work.



Not just attractive AI images.



Not just generic Canva templates.



We want to see creativity, sophistication, and exceptional execution.



**2. Experience With Fashion or Other Highly Creative Consumer Brands**



Strong preference will be given to candidates who have worked in:



- Women's fashion and apparel

- Beauty and cosmetics

- Premium lifestyle brands

- Creative-forward consumer products

- Fashion ecommerce and editorial marketing

- Other visually sophisticated DTC brands



We are particularly interested in people who understand contemporary women's fashion aesthetics.



**3. Advanced Graphic Design Skills**



You must demonstrate strong proficiency in professional design tools such as Adobe Photoshop and Illustrator.



Experience with Figma and other modern creative tools is highly desirable.



Your portfolio should demonstrate professional command of typography, photo manipulation, compositing, layout, color, and visual hierarchy.



**4. Excellent Creative Judgment**



You should be able to explain why a design works.



Why you chose a particular typeface.



Why an image was cropped a certain way.



Why one composition feels premium and another feels cheap.



We want thoughtful, intentional design—not random experimentation that occasionally produces a good result.



**5. Brand Adaptability**



You must be able to work across dramatically different brands without making them all look the same.



**6. Strong Communication and Ownership**



Excellent written English, proactive communication, reliability, and the ability to work collaboratively with marketing teams are essential.



## WHAT MAKES SOMEONE TRULY EXCEPTIONAL?



An exceptional designer has taste.



And taste is difficult to teach.



It's the ability to recognize what is beautiful, what feels authentic, what looks dated, and what feels contemporary.



It's knowing when to add something and when to remove it.



It's being able to reference the best creative work in fashion, advertising, editorial design, and consumer branding—then translate that inspiration into something original.



It's being willing to challenge a brief when you know there's a better creative solution.



And it's taking genuine pride in every detail of the finished product.



**We want someone whose designs we look forward to seeing.**



Not someone whose work we have to constantly correct.



## WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE



**First 30 Days**



Understand the creative identity of our brands, learn our workflows, and begin delivering excellent static advertising and
 designs.



**Days 31–60**



Independently produce high-quality creative across multiple brands, contribute original concepts, and demonstrate a strong understanding of our audiences and visual standards.



**Days 61–90**



Become a trusted creative partner to our advertising and retention teams.



Your work should consistently demonstrate outstanding taste, brand accuracy, original thinking, and strong execution.



You should also be identifying opportunities to improve our creative production processes through thoughtful use of AI and automation.



## WHAT WE OFFER



**Premium compensation for exceptional talent.**



We understand that great designers are valuable and we're prepared to pay accordingly.



**Creative ownership.**



We want your ideas, not just your ability to follow instructions.



**A diverse portfolio of brands.**



You'll have the opportunity to create work across fashion, lifestyle, and other ecommerce industries.



**An AI-forward environment.**



We encourage intelligent experimentation with AI tools and want you to help shape the future of creative production.



**A team that genuinely cares about design.**



You won't have to convince us that creative quality matters. We already believe it does.



**An opportunity to do career-defining work.**



As our brands grow, so will the creative possibilities and scope of your work.



## HOW TO APPLY



### Your Portfolio Is Your Application. Please don't send us a generic resume with a list of software programs. We want to see what you can actually create. Apply for this position on this link: 



### Our Selection Process



We will review portfolios carefully and shortlist candidates whose work demonstrates exceptional taste and technical ability.



Shortlisted candidates may be invited to complete a practical design assessment using briefs from two of our brands.



This will help us evaluate creativity, brand adaptability, execution, and original design ability.



We're interested in seeing what you can actually create—not how impressive your resume sounds.



## ONE FINAL THOUGHT



We're not looking for the person who can make the most designs in a day.



We're looking for someone who can make the designs everyone else wishes they'd thought of.



Someone with great taste.



Someone who genuinely loves design.



Someone who notices the little details other people miss.



Someone who understands that a brand's visual identity is one of its most valuable assets.



And someone who wants to use modern technology to become even better at their craft.



**If you're that person, we want to see your work.**



This could be the opportunity to do some of the best creative work of your career.

 and CRM notes

Every lead answered. Clean CRM records. Files reaching leadership complete the first time. Borrowers feel informed. Leadership isn't chasing or fixing anything.

Put the word "Closing" in your application message so we know you read this all the way through.



Then send your resume plus short answers to these three:



Briefly describe your hands-on experience with U.S. loans — mortgage processing, non-QM / private / hard-money lending, or real estate loan documents. Which loan types and systems have you worked with?



Applications without the keyword or the three answers will not be reviewed.

SOP Adherence & Deal Pre-Qualification

Pre-qualify deals against our lending criteria before escalating (private money vs. hard money vs. hybrid)

Apply our quick-screen criteria accurately (LTV, borrower spread, combined leverage, close timeline)

Verify all non-negotiable borrower requirements

Route deals that fall outside our criteria to our referral process per SOP

Communication & Reporting

Communicate professionally and clearly with borrowers throughout the loan process

Proactively surface open loops, urgent items, and potential issues without being asked

Log all borrower conversations and decisions in the CRM accurately and promptly



Important Authority Boundaries



You will prepare, organize, and pre-qualify deals — but you will not approve loans, set terms, or make funding decisions. All approvals and final decisions stay with internal leadership.

Requirements



2+ years experience in real estate transactions, loan processing, or lending support

Strong attention to detail and organization

Excellent written and spoken English

Comfortable communicating with U.S.-based clients

Ability to manage multiple deals at once without dropping follow-ups

Experience using CRMs and pipeline-based systems

Reliable daily availability and consistent EOD reporting



Nice to Have (Not Required)



Private money, hard money, or creative real estate (subject-to, seller finance) experience

Familiarity with real estate investing terminology and underwriting basics (ARV, LTV, HUDs, exit strategy)

Experience pulling comps (e.g., PropStream, Redfin)

GoHighLevel or similar CRM experience



What Success Looks Like



Clean, accurate CRM records with every lead answered

Deals move smoothly with minimal rework

Files reach leadership complete and ready for underwriting

Borrowers feel informed and supported

Leadership does not need to fix or chase files



Growth Path



Strong performers move into expanded responsibility: full pipeline management without daily supervision, loan-file audits, lead generation in investor communities, weekly pipeline and loan-admin reporting, and coordinating document requests with borrowers and title companies.



How to Apply



Please submit your resume along with a brief introduction explaining your relevant experience and why you're an excellent fit for this role. Include the word "Lending" in your application message so we know you read this fully.
