title: Transaction Coordinator – Non-QM Mortgage (DSCR / Bank Statement / Investor Loans) | AI-Forward Team
description:
We're MV Corporate, a U.S.-based real estate, private lending, and investment company. We fund investor loans (DSCR, bank statement, bridge, fix-and-flip) and we run on an AI-powered team. We're hiring a Transaction Coordinator to keep every file moving from contract to clear-to-close. You'll be the person borrowers, brokers, lenders, and title companies count on for a straight answer.



WHY THIS ROLE IS DIFFERENT

We use AI tools every day for inbox triage, condition tracking, document review, and drafting. We are not looking for someone to retype checklists. We want someone who looks at a file, figures out what is actually missing, uses AI to move faster, and then picks up the phone to close the gap. A sharp coordinator who embraces AI will outperform a veteran who resists it.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

- Own non-QM and investor loan files from submission through clear-to-close, handling several files each month

- Track conditions, deadlines, and contract milestones; know what's missing before anyone asks

- Call and
 borrowers, brokers, lenders, title/escrow, insurance, and appraisal contacts

- Review documents for completeness: spot missing pages, signature errors, and mismatched entity details before underwriting does

- Keep GoHighLevel and Google Drive accurate and current

- Use AI tools to draft updates, summarize documents, and automate repeat tasks

- Send a daily end-of-day update: done, pending, needs attention

- Flag at-risk files early, with a recommendation, not just a question



WHAT WE GIVE YOU

- AI tools and workflows already built for the work

- Full SOPs and video walkthroughs

- Your own CRM login and a company

- Training on how we do things, plus real autonomy. We care that files close.



WHAT WE NEED

- 2+ years of U.S. real estate experience, residential mainly

- Background in loan processing at a lending bank, a mortgage office or brokerage, or a real estate firm (bank-level processing experience is a big plus)

- Ability to process several loan files a month with accuracy and speed

- Working knowledge of non-QM, DSCR, or investor loans, and TRID/closing timelines

- Experience with an LOS and a CRM (GoHighLevel is a plus)

- Excellent spoken and written English; this role is on the phone with U.S. borrowers every day

- Comfort using AI tools, and the curiosity to keep learning them

- Organized, decisive, and thick-skinned; you follow up without reminders

- Reliable internet, backup power, and a quiet workspace

- Available during U.S. Central Time business hours



NICE TO HAVE

Entity-borrowing knowledge (LLCs, trusts), title/escrow coordination, private or hard money exposure.



AUTHORITY BOUNDARY

You coordinate and organize. You do not approve loans, quote terms, or give lending advice. Those decisions stay with leadership.



GROWTH

Strong performers move into full pipeline ownership and team-lead roles as we grow.



HOW TO APPLY (follow this exactly)

1. Start your message with the word TRACKER.

2. Tell us where you worked (lending bank, mortgage office, or real estate firm), your years of U.S. residential experience, and roughly how many loan files you process per month.

3. Describe a time you chased a missing condition or document to the finish. What did you do?

Applications missing any of these will not be reviewed.

title: Inventory & Demand Planning Manager | AI-Native | Multi-Brand Ecommerce
description:
# Inventory & Demand Planning Manager | AI-Native | Multi-Brand Ecommerce



**TYPE OF WORK:** Full Time — Remote



**WAGE / SALARY:** $2,000–$3,000 USD/month, depending on experience and demonstrated results



**HOURS PER WEEK:** 40



**SKILL REQUIREMENTS:** Inventory Management | Forecasting | Supply Chain Management



## JOB OVERVIEW



### Our Best Sellers Should Never Be Out of Stock. Your Job Is to Make Sure of It.



Here's something we've learned from running multiple ecommerce businesses:



**When our best-selling products stay in stock, our businesses perform better. Significantly better.**



It sounds obvious.



And yet, across ecommerce, businesses lose enormous amounts of revenue because someone didn't forecast demand properly, didn't place an order early enough, didn't anticipate a marketing campaign, or didn't follow up with a supplier.



We're determined to eliminate that problem.



We're looking for an **exceptional Inventory & Demand Planning Manager** to take ownership of inventory planning, forecasting, replenishment, and supplier coordination across our growing portfolio of ecommerce brands.



This is one of the most financially important operational roles in our company.



We don't need someone who simply monitors stock levels and tells us when something is running low.



**We need someone who makes sure our best sellers never run low in the first place.**



Someone who sees problems months before they happen.



Someone who can recognize tomorrow's best sellers before everyone else does.



Someone who can use data, AI, commercial judgment, and proactive supplier coordination to ensure the right inventory is always available at the right time.



Most importantly, someone who takes complete ownership of the outcome.



### WHO WE ARE



oCommerce is a growing portfolio of consumer ecommerce companies operating across multiple industries.



Our brands include:



- **Agent84** — Fashion-forward athleisure and women's lifestyle apparel.

- **Skivys** — Women's comfort clothing and loungewear.

- **Blossomdale** — Plants, gardening, and lifestyle products.

- **Shrimpy Business** — A leading online retailer of freshwater aquarium shrimp, fish, plants, and supplies.



We also operate and develop additional brands across other consumer categories.



Our businesses sell thousands of product variations, across different categories, suppliers, manufacturing timelines, and customer purchasing patterns.



Some products have fashion-driven demand.



Others are purchased repeatedly throughout the year.



Some are seasonal. Others become unexpectedly popular because of advertising or social media.



Each business presents a different inventory planning challenge.



**Your mission is to build an inventory operation that stays ahead of all of them.**



## WHAT YOU'LL OWN



### 1. Know Every Product — Especially the Winners



Across every brand, you'll continuously analyze our products and classify them into three groups:



**Category A: All-Time Best Sellers**



These are proven products that consistently generate meaningful sales.



Your highest priority is protecting their availability.



You should know their sales velocity, historical demand, supplier lead times, inventory coverage, and exactly when the next order must be placed.



A preventable stockout of a major best seller should never be a surprise.



**Category B: Rising Best Sellers**



These are products whose sales are accelerating and which show the potential to become our next major revenue drivers.



Your job is to identify them early.



Then gradually increase their representation in replenishment orders as demand becomes more established.



This is important: we don't want to wait until a rising product becomes a proven all-time bestseller before increasing our purchasing commitment.



**Category C: Slow-Moving and Underperforming Products**



These are products that consume cash and warehouse space without generating sufficient sales.



You'll identify them, monitor their performance, reduce unnecessary replenishment, and recommend ways to improve inventory efficiency.



**These categories are not permanent.**



A rising bestseller can become a core bestseller.



A former bestseller can decline.



A slow mover can suddenly accelerate.



You'll maintain an accurate, continuously updated classification of our entire product portfolio.



Not once every six months.



Continuously.



### 2. Own Inventory Forecasting and Replenishment



We have already invested in developing automated inventory forecasting and replenishment workflows.



You'll inherit these systems, take ownership of them, validate their accuracy, and make them better.



You'll use historical sales, actual selling velocity, current stock, inbound purchase orders, supplier lead times, safety stock, and anticipated demand to determine:



- What needs to be reordered.

- How much needs to be ordered.

- When orders need to be placed.

- When inventory is expected to arrive.

- Which products are at risk of stocking out.

- Where we may be overstocked.

- How purchasing should be prioritized within available budgets.



You'll forecast at the appropriate SKU and variant level, including style, color, size, and length where relevant.



You must understand the difference between a product selling slowly and a product appearing to sell slowly because it was unavailable for half the month.



**A stockout should not trick your forecasting model into believing demand has disappeared.**



You'll account for seasonality, new launches, changing business performance, promotional periods, and actual sales opportunities.



We expect you to understand forecasting deeply enough to challenge a model when its recommendations don't make commercial sense.



### 3. Work Directly With Our Advertising and Retention Marketing Teams



This is one of the most important parts of the job.



Historical sales data only tells you part of the story.



**You need to understand what our marketing teams are planning to sell tomorrow.**



You'll work proactively with our:



- Paid Advertising Team

- Retention Marketing Team 
 and SMS)

- Brand Managers

- Product and Operations Teams



You'll understand upcoming product launches, promotional calendars, advertising budget increases, featured products,
 campaigns, and expected demand spikes.



Imagine our advertising team plans to aggressively scale spending on a particular product next month.



You notice that our existing stock will only cover three weeks of normal demand.



A typical inventory coordinator might notice the problem once inventory starts running low.



**An exceptional inventory manager identifies the conflict immediately, calculates the risk, speaks with the advertising team, and coordinates with suppliers to find a solution before the campaign launches.**



That's the standard we're looking for.



We don't want inventory planning operating independently from marketing.



We want marketing and inventory working together to maximize revenue.



### 4. Own Supplier and Factory Coordination



Forecasting means nothing if the products don't arrive.



You will communicate directly with our factories, manufacturers, suppliers, and other relevant partners.



Your responsibilities include:



- Preparing and coordinating replenishment purchase orders.

- Understanding production timelines, minimum order quantities, and supplier capacity.

- Confirming manufacturing and delivery schedules.

- Following up proactively on production progress.

- Coordinating with logistics and warehouse teams.

- Tracking incoming shipments and expected arrival dates.

- Identifying delays early and implementing recovery plans.

- Maintaining accurate purchase order and inbound inventory records.

- Negotiating improved lead times, terms, and purchasing arrangements where possible.



You must understand the full journey of a product, from purchase order to available inventory.



**An order being placed does not mean your job is finished.**



Your responsibility continues until the inventory is actually available for customers to purchase.



If a factory misses a deadline, we should hear about the proposed solution from you—not discover the problem when the product goes out of stock.



### 5. Become an AI-Native Inventory Manager



AI is central to how we want this department to operate.



We're not looking for someone who occasionally asks ChatGPT to help with a spreadsheet formula.



We're looking for someone who understands how AI can fundamentally improve demand forecasting, inventory monitoring, supplier coordination, and operational decision-making.



You'll be expected to use AI and automation to:



- Analyze large volumes of SKU-level sales data.

- Identify emerging best sellers and declining products.

- Maintain and improve automated demand forecasts.

- Detect unusual changes in sales velocity.

- Flag potential stockouts before they become urgent.

- Incorporate marketing plans into inventory projections.

- Generate replenishment recommendations.

- Monitor supplier delays and outstanding purchase orders.

- Build dashboards and exception-based alerts.

- Automate repetitive reporting and follow-up processes.



We're especially interested in people who have experience with ChatGPT, Claude, AI automation platforms, scripting, or advanced spreadsheet workflows.



**We want you to build a system that watches our inventory continuously—not one that depends on someone remembering to open a spreadsheet.**



But we're equally clear about something else:



AI doesn't replace judgment.



You are accountable for validating the data, understanding the assumptions, checking the recommendations, and making sound decisions.



An AI-generated forecast is not a substitute for knowing your business.



### 6. Protect Revenue Without Wasting Cash



Keeping products in stock is only half the equation.



The other half is avoiding unnecessary inventory.



Every dollar tied up in slow-moving stock is a dollar we cannot invest elsewhere.



You'll need to understand the relationship between inventory availability, purchasing budgets, sales velocity, product margins, and working capital.



Your goal is to:



**Maximize availability of products customers want while minimizing capital tied up in products they don't.**



That means making intelligent trade-offs.



It means knowing when to order aggressively and when to be conservative.



It means understanding how product demand changes over time.



And it means having the confidence to recommend against unnecessary purchases, even when a supplier is offering attractive terms.



We expect strong financial judgment—not simply maintaining large amounts of stock.



### 7. Take Complete Ownership — Without Constant Leadership Supervision



This may be our most important requirement.



We operate multiple businesses.



Our leadership team cannot spend its time chasing suppliers, checking spreadsheets, answering routine inventory questions, or reminding people to place purchase orders.



**That's why we're hiring you.**



We're looking for a person who takes a problem and owns it until it is solved.



If you identify a potential stockout, we don't want a message saying:



"We might run out of this product. What should I do?"



We want something like:



"This bestseller has approximately 35 days of inventory remaining. Our supplier's normal lead time is 60 days, and the advertising team plans to increase promotion next month. I've confirmed an expedited production option, calculated the incremental cost, and recommend proceeding with an additional order. Here are the numbers and the decision I need approved."



That's ownership.



You should independently investigate problems, communicate with the necessary teams, evaluate alternatives, and bring leadership clear recommendations when approvals are necessary.



**Our leadership team should spend less time managing inventory because you're here—not more.**



## HOW WE'LL MEASURE YOUR SUCCESS



We care about outcomes, not how many spreadsheets you maintain.



Your performance will be evaluated based on:



**1. Best Seller Availability**



Are our most important products consistently in stock? Are preventable stockouts declining?



**2. Rising Best Seller Identification**



Are we identifying new winning products early enough and increasing replenishment appropriately?



**3. Forecast Accuracy**



Are your forecasts improving over time? Are purchasing recommendations supported by reliable data?



**4. Inventory Efficiency**



Are we maintaining appropriate stock coverage without excessive overstock or unnecessary capital commitments?



**5. Supplier Reliability**



Are purchase orders placed on time, production schedules monitored, and delays resolved proactively?



**6. Marketing Alignment**



Are upcoming campaigns and advertising plans accurately reflected in purchasing decisions?



**7. Ownership and Independence**



Are problems being solved without repeated leadership intervention? Are decisions presented clearly, with evidence and recommendations?



Ultimately, **we want to see more sales protected, fewer preventable stockouts, smarter purchasing, and less management overhead.**



## WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR



### Non-Negotiable Requirements



**At least 3–5 years of meaningful inventory planning, demand forecasting, or purchasing experience**, preferably in direct-to-consumer ecommerce.



We strongly prefer candidates who have personally owned replenishment decisions rather than simply maintaining inventory records.



You should demonstrate:



- Advanced Excel or Google Sheets capabilities, including complex formulas, lookups, pivot tables, forecasting models, and scenario analysis.

- Hands-on experience with Shopify or comparable ecommerce inventory systems.

- Strong understanding of sales velocity, reorder points, safety stock, inventory coverage, and supplier lead times.

- Proven experience communicating with manufacturers or suppliers and managing purchase orders.

- Ability to handle multiple brands, suppliers, and product categories simultaneously.

- Strong commercial judgment regarding inventory purchasing and cash flow.

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- High levels of independence, attention to detail, organization, and accountability.

- Genuine experience using AI tools to improve analytical or operational workflows.



### Especially Valuable Experience



- Inventory planning for fashion brands with multiple sizes, colors, and variants.

- Managing inventory across several ecommerce businesses.

- Developing stockout-adjusted demand forecasts.

- Seasonal merchandise planning and promotional demand forecasting.

- Working with overseas manufacturers and international shipping timelines.

- Building inventory dashboards and automated monitoring systems.

- Experience with Asana, inventory planning software, ERP systems, Make, Zapier, n8n, or scripting.



## THIS ROLE IS NOT FOR YOU IF...



You need someone else to tell you what to reorder every month.



You believe inventory management is primarily about updating spreadsheets.



You wait until inventory runs low before contacting suppliers.



You are uncomfortable challenging forecasts or making data-driven recommendations.



You have only worked on order processing, inventory data entry, or shipment tracking without owning demand planning.



You need continuous guidance or approvals for routine operational decisions.



Or you think AI is just a convenient tool for answering occasional questions.



**We want an exceptional operator who is analytical, commercially intelligent, technologically capable, and relentlessly proactive.**



## YOUR FIRST 90 DAYS



**First 30 Days — Learn the Business and Find the Risks**



Understand our brands, inventory systems, products, suppliers, and existing forecasting automations.



Validate the current classification of best sellers, rising best sellers, and underperformers.



Identify immediate stockout risks and purchasing opportunities.



Establish accurate inventory visibility and a prioritized action plan.



**Days 31–60 — Take Ownership**



Independently manage our replenishment planning process.



Establish regular coordination with marketing teams.



Take responsibility for supplier communication, purchase order tracking, and forecasting accuracy.



Begin improving our automated forecasting and inventory monitoring workflows.



**Days 61–90 — Make Inventory a Competitive Advantage**



Demonstrate improved visibility, proactive purchasing, and reduced inventory risk.



Show that major replenishment decisions are being made before stock becomes critical.



Deliver a clear, reliable reporting system that leadership can trust.



Most importantly, demonstrate that the business no longer needs senior leadership to personally keep inventory planning on track.



## WHAT WE OFFER



**Competitive compensation for proven talent.**



We are prepared to pay a premium for someone who can demonstrate exceptional forecasting, operational judgment, and ownership.



**Real responsibility.**



You'll have meaningful influence over inventory purchasing, working capital, supplier relationships, and revenue protection across multiple businesses.



**An AI-forward environment.**



We're investing heavily in automation and modern operational systems. You'll be encouraged to improve how the business operates.



**A growing portfolio of brands.**



You'll gain experience across multiple ecommerce categories, supply chains, and business models.



**The opportunity to build something exceptional.**



This is not a maintenance role. You'll be responsible for improving a financially critical business function and helping it scale as we grow.



## HOW TO APPLY



We're not interested in generic resumes filled with phrases like "detail-oriented" and "excellent problem solver." **We want proof.** Please apply on this link here: 



### Our Selection Process



We will shortlist applicants based on demonstrated experience, analytical judgment, and evidence of genuine ownership. We will be doing atleast two rounds of interviews through this hiring process.



## ONE FINAL THOUGHT



A great inventory manager does more than prevent operational problems.



They protect revenue.



They free up capital.



They help marketing teams grow faster.



They identify opportunities before competitors do.



And they build systems that allow the entire business to operate more effectively.



**We don't want someone who tells us what's out of stock.**



**We want someone who makes sure our winning products are in stock before anyone even thinks to ask.**



If that's the kind of responsibility that excites you, we'd love to meet you.

title: Phone Sales – Insurance Appointment Setter/ Outbound Calls $560-790
description:
**Salary:** $3–$4 USD/hour (Based on Experience & Performance)

**Job Type:** Full-Time / Part-Time

**Location:** Remote – Philippines

**Schedule:** US Business Hours

**English:** Excellent Spoken English Required

**Spanish:** A Plus, Not Required



### Job Description



We are a US-based life insurance agency looking for reliable, motivated Virtual Assistants to help connect potential customers with our licensed insurance agents.



We use **ReadyMode, an automated dialing system**, that automatically connects you with live prospects. You will not need to manually dial numbers or find your own leads.



Your job is simple: speak with prospects, follow our script, ask basic qualifying questions, and transfer interested prospects to our licensed agents or schedule appointments.



We provide the leads, dialer, scripts, and training.



### Responsibilities



- Handle live calls automatically connected through ReadyMode.

- Follow provided scripts and ask basic qualifying questions.

- Identify interested prospects and transfer them to licensed agents.

- Schedule appointments or callbacks when necessary.

- Handle basic objections professionally.

- Update call dispositions and customer notes.

title: GoHighLevel AI Bot Specialist (Snapshot + Conversation AI + Client Support)
description:
GOHIGHLEVEL AI BOT SPECIALIST - Snapshot + Conversation AI Owner (Full-Time, Remote, Long-Term)



READ FIRST: I only consider a FRESH Loom recorded for THIS job. No old or reused videos. Start the video by saying SHIP, answer the questions below OUT LOUD, and show one real build on your screen. Recycled or written-only applications are not reviewed.



ABOUT US

CloseLeadPro gives health and wellness creators a complete automated sales system - their website, their AI employee, their follow-up - built on GoHighLevel. We run around 170 client sub-accounts from one master snapshot. Every client gets the same two Conversation AI bots: one that sells, and one that looks after customers after they buy.



That AI employee is the product. It is the reason clients pay us and the reason they leave. Right now the founder is the only person improving it, and that is the single biggest bottleneck in this company. This role exists to take it off him.



THE JOB IN ONE SENTENCE

You own our AI employee and our master snapshot. You make the bot measurably better every week, you prove that it got better, and you can explain what you built to the client whose business depends on it.



THE WEEKLY LOOP - THIS IS THE REAL JOB

1. Read real client conversations. Find where the bot answered badly, stalled, invented something, or lost the sale.

2. Work out WHY. Not "the AI is weird" - which instruction caused it.

3. Propose the smallest change that fixes it without breaking anything else.

4. Get it approved, test it, then roll it out properly.

5. Report what changed and whether the complaints went down.



If you have only ever written prompts and never gone back to see how they performed in the real world, this is not your role.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN

- The master snapshot: workflows, pipelines, funnels, custom values, custom fields. It stays clean and it stays current.

- Both Conversation AI bots - the sales bot and the customer service bot. Prompt structure, instructions, knowledge, testing.

- The custom value architecture. Our bot content lives in custom values, not hardcoded in each account, so one correct change reaches every client.

- Rolling changes out properly: custom values first, then every affected account, and always the master snapshot. A fix that only lands in one place is not a fix.

- Deploying and QA-ing new client sub-accounts from the snapshot.

- Regression testing. We keep a list of the ways the bot has failed before. Nothing goes live until it passes that list.



YOU WILL ALSO TALK TO CLIENTS - PLEASE READ THIS PART CAREFULLY

We have around 100 clients. You are not their daily support person, but you will get on calls with them, and this part of the job is not optional.



- When an account is built, you check it is set up correctly, then you get on a call and walk the client through it.

- When we release a new automation or a new feature, you present it to clients and explain, in plain words, what it does for their business.

- When something has gone wrong, you explain it calmly and clearly, without hiding behind technical language.



Our clients are not technical. Most of them are women in their 40s and 50s running their own business. They do not want to hear about workflows and custom values. They want to know what changed, why it helps them, and what they need to do.



If you are brilliant with systems but go quiet on a call, please do not apply for this one. We need both, and we will test both.



HOW WE WORK

- You propose, I approve, then it goes live. Every addition or removal to a bot prompt is shown to me before you make it and again after. This is not a trust issue - a single bad prompt change reaches 170 client accounts and every one of their customers.

- I tell you the outcome I want. You come back with it working.

- You document what you build. A short Loom and a short written SOP, every time.

- We do not over-engineer. The simplest version that works, wins.



YOUR ONE NUMBER

Bot complaints per week, going down. That is how we know you are winning.



WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- Real, demonstrable GoHighLevel experience. Snapshots, sub-accounts, workflows versus campaigns, custom values, SaaS mode, Conversation AI. Certificates are not enough - show me builds.

- Hands-on work with LLM prompts in a product that real customers used. Tell me what broke and what you changed.

- You can read a bad AI output and reason backwards to the instruction that caused it.

- Strong spoken English and real confidence on video. You will be on calls with North American business owners every week, presenting your own work.

- You can explain a technical thing to a non-technical person without making them feel stupid.

- Comfortable with APIs, webhooks and JSON. You can read documentation and integrate without hand-holding.

- Some JavaScript or Python for the places no-code runs out.

- Careful by nature. You test before you ship, and you tell us when you are unsure.

- Self-directed. You unblock yourself.



NICE TO HAVE

- n8n, Make or Zapier.

- Courses, memberships or community portals in GoHighLevel.

- Experience with a fleet of client accounts rather than one business.

- Customer success or account management experience alongside the technical work.



SCHEDULE

- Full-time, 8 working hours a day, Monday to Friday, 40 hours a week.

- Shift: 10:00 PM to 7:00 AM Philippine time, which is 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM Eastern.

- Breaks: one 1-hour unpaid break, or two 30-minute breaks.

- This is a full-time role. You will not be holding another job or other clients during these hours. I will ask you about this directly, and I would much rather hear it now.



ANSWER THESE IN YOUR LOOM

1. Describe a GoHighLevel snapshot you built and deployed across several sub-accounts. What was in it, and what broke when you deployed it?

2. What is the difference between a workflow and a campaign in GoHighLevel, and when do you use custom values?

3. Tell me about a bot or AI prompt you built that failed with a real user. What did it do wrong, and what did you change?

4. How often were you on calls with clients in your last role, and what were those calls about?

5. What else are you working on right now, and what would you end to take this role?



THEN DO THESE TWO THINGS, LIVE IN THE VIDEO



First. Talk me through how you would train a Conversation AI to be a good sales agent. How do you structure its instructions, how do you stop it making things up, and how do you make it better once it is live and talking to real people?



Take your time with this one. It is the most important thing I will listen to.



Second. Pretend I am your client. I am 52, I run my own health business, and I am not technical at all. You have just finished setting up an automation that follows up with everyone who comments on my Instagram posts. Explain to me, out loud, what you built and why it helps me. Two minutes, in plain English.



I am listening to how you think, and to how you sound when you have to explain your work to the person paying for it.



TO APPLY

Record a FRESH 4 to 5 minute Loom made only for this job. Say SHIP, answer the 5 questions out loud, walk me through one real GoHighLevel or AI build on your screen, then do both of the exercises above. Paste the Loom link in your application.

title: Senior Unity Game Developer – AI-Powered (Codex / Claude Code)
description:

We are not looking for a beginner, someone who needs extensive training, or a developer who requires constant step-by-step instructions.

- Maintain clean, organized code and use GitHub branches and pull requests.

- Proactively identify opportunities for improvements without waiting for detailed instructions.

- Take ownership of development tasks from start to finish.



Required Qualifications



Unity Development



Strong experience with Unity and C#.



Experience working on existing, complex Unity projects.



Solid understanding of game architecture, gameplay programming, debugging, and optimization.



Comfortable working with Git and GitHub.



Ability to understand unfamiliar codebases quickly.



AI Development Experience — Extremely Important



Extensive hands-on experience with OpenAI Codex, Claude Code, or comparable agentic AI coding tools.



Comfortable using AI agents for large programming tasks, debugging, refactoring, and implementing complete features.



Able to manage lengthy AI development sessions involving multiple files and complex systems.



Familiar with AI usage limits, context management, development workflows, and optimizing AI-assisted productivity.



Must have reliable access to high-volume AI coding capabilities or be willing to establish an appropriate professional setup.



Capable of reviewing, correcting, and testing AI-generated code rather than blindly trusting its output.



Independent Problem-Solving



Highly self-motivated and capable of working without constant supervision.



Comfortable researching and solving technical problems independently.



Able to read documentation and understand existing systems without requiring extensive onboarding.



Strong debugging and troubleshooting abilities.



Excellent organizational skills.



Capable of communicating progress clearly and reporting completed work.



Preferred Experience



The following are advantages:



Multiplayer game development.



Dedicated server architecture and networking.



Survival games, shooters, or open-world games.



Enemy AI, animation systems, and combat mechanics.



Unity performance optimization.



Experience maintaining large Unity projects with multiple interconnected systems.



What Makes This Position Different?



We strongly encourage the use of AI in our development workflow.



We believe tools like Codex and Claude Code can significantly accelerate software development when used by experienced developers.



We want someone who already understands this technology and knows how to maximize its potential.



You will have substantial independence in how you approach development tasks.



We provide the project, existing documentation, and overall objectives. You take ownership of researching, implementing, testing, and delivering solutions.



We value completed, working features and reliable engineering over hours spent manually writing code.



This is an opportunity to contribute meaningfully to an active game development project with long-term potential.



Employment



Remote position.



Long-term opportunity.



Flexible working hours with regular progress communication.



Compensation based on experience and demonstrated ability.



Initial paid technical evaluation before a long-term agreement.



How to Apply



Please answer ALL of the following questions:



How many years have you been developing games with Unity? Please provide examples of projects you have worked on.



Which AI coding tools do you currently use? Codex, Claude Code, Cursor, or something else? Describe your experience with them.



What AI subscription or usage plan do you currently have? Approximately how much AI-assisted development can you perform daily before encountering usage limits?



Have you used AI coding agents to complete entire development features or large programming tasks? Please provide a specific example.



If we gave you GitHub access to an unfamiliar Unity game containing hundreds or thousands of scripts and extensive documentation, how would you approach getting started?



Are you comfortable working independently, researching solutions, and making technical decisions without receiving step-by-step instructions?



Please provide your GitHub profile, portfolio, or examples of Unity games you have developed.

Important: Please begin your application with the words "AI UNITY DEVELOPER" so we know you have read the entire posting.



We are looking for someone who can become a dependable, long-term contributor to our game development team.

title: Client Services & Production Manager
description:
About Creation Station Printing

Creation Station Printing is a print and promotional products company based in Austin, Texas, with locations in Houston and Dallas. For about 10 years we have produced business cards, flyers, banners, signs, apparel and branded promo items for businesses, from local companies to corporate accounts.



We print in-house and through a network of trusted trade printers and suppliers. Customers order through our online store, by quote and through direct ordering connections, so every order has to land on time, whoever makes it.



The role

You own every order from the moment a customer approves a quote until it is delivered, on time and as promised.



Half the job is leading customer service. You are the person customers trust for order status, realistic timelines and fast fixes. The other half is outsourcing and production coordination. You buy from our vendor network, pass approved artwork from our art team to whoever is printing it, keep every job moving on the production calendar, and catch delays before they reach the customer.



Customer service leadership (about 50%)

You are the main contact for our business customers on every open order, and you lead the customer service team.



Own open orders. Answer customers on status, changes and delivery dates.

Set accurate expectations. At quote and at order, give turnaround and ship dates that production and vendors can actually meet.

Warn before customers ask. When a job slips, tell the customer before the due date, with a new date and a plan.

Quote with judgment. Review and send quotes. When a request is vague or incomplete, pick the right product and options and ask the right questions.

Fix problems fully. Handle misprints, damaged shipments, reprints, refunds and partial refunds, then fix the cause.

Serve corporate accounts. Handle purchase order numbers, approval steps and recurring orders for business customers.

Lead the team. Set daily priorities, keep response times fast in the shared inbox and help desk, coach new staff, and keep our how-to guides current.

Outsourcing and production coordination (about 50%)

You d
 where each job gets made, buy it at the right cost, and keep it moving until it ships.



Outsourcing and purchasing

Pick the right vendor. Choose the right trade printer or supplier for each outsourced job, on price, quality, turnaround and shipping, using our vendor list.

Get custom pricing. Request quotes from vendors for jobs our website or vendor sites can't price directly.

Place and confirm orders. Place purchase orders, pass along the print-ready files from our art team, and confirm ship dates.

Chase early. Track every outsourced job to delivery, and follow up with vendors before deadlines, not after.

Check what arrives. Inspect outsourced work on arrival, and handle vendor errors, reprints and credits.

Protect the margin. Buy at or under the cost used in the quote.

Protect confidentiality. Vendor requests carry job specs only, never customer details, and white-label orders ship blind.

Own the vendor list. Keep vendor contacts, pricing and strengths up to date.

Production calendar and order flow

Every order moves through the same stages. Our art team owns the artwork and proofs. You keep each order on the production calendar with a current stage, next step and due date, and move it along as it progresses:



Artwork and proof (art team)

Customer approval

Production, in-house or at a vendor

Finishing and quality check

Shipping, delivery or pickup

Pass artwork between teams. Take approved, print-ready art from the art team and hand it to whoever is printing it, in-house or at a vendor. When a printer flags a problem, such as art too blurry for the ordered size, send it back to the art team with what is needed. You don't design or fix artwork.

Sweep daily. Find anything stuck, late or missing a date, and fix it that day.

Run rush orders. Prioritize rush jobs and balance the in-house production team's workload.

Coordinate delivery. Arrange shipping, local delivery and pickup across Austin, Houston and Dallas.

Run the daily huddle. Meet with production and customer service every day to set priorities.

What success looks like

Success means orders arrive when we said they would, and customers never hear about a problem from anyone but you. The targets below are suggested starting points; adjust them before posting.



What you bring



Must have

3 or more years in print production coordination, print buying or brokering, or promotional products customer service

Working knowledge of print: digital and offset printing, large format and signs, promotional products and apparel

Enough print-file know-how to spot and relay problems, such as art too low in resolution for the print size; you won't design or fix artwork

Experience buying from trade printers or suppliers and holding them to deadlines

Clear, fast writing: most customer and vendor contact is by
 and chat

Strong organization: you track dozens of open jobs at once without dropping one

Comfort with web-based tools: order systems, a CRM or help desk, Google Workspace



Nice to have

Experience with trade printers and wholesale suppliers

Promotional products sourcing through ASI or SAGE

HubSpot, WooCommerce or QuickBooks

Experience leading or training a small customer service team

Experience with corporate purchasing: purchase orders, approvals and recurring orders

title: Social Media Posting VA – Remote iPhone – 7 Days/Week
description:
I’m looking for a reliable and detail-oriented Virtual Assistant to post and distribute social media content every day.



This is a long-term, part-time position requiring consistent availability seven days per week. You will generally work for approximately 1–2 hours per day, although the first few days may take longer while you learn the system.



All videos, captions, hooks, and posting instructions will be provided. You will not create content from scratch. Your job is to prepare each video as instructed, post it correctly, confirm that it went live, and update our tracking sheet.



IMPORTANT: HOW THE REMOTE PHONE SYSTEM WORKS



This is not a normal social media scheduling position.



You will not post from your own phone or personal social media accounts. Instead, you will control a real iPhone remotely through a private dashboard on your computer.



The iPhone physically stays with our team. When you click, swipe, type, download a video, open an app, or publish a post through the dashboard, those actions happen on the real iPhone in real time.



It is similar to TeamViewer, AnyDesk, Chrome Remote Desktop, or screen mirroring, except you can directly control the phone.



You do not need to be a programmer. However, you must:



• Understand how to navigate an iPhone

• Be comfortable learning new software

• Follow somewhat technical instructions

• Be patient when the remote phone takes a 
nt to respond

• Handle small app or navigation issues without needing every click explained

• Communicate immediately if something is not working



Experience with remote-desktop software, screen mirroring, remote phones, or device-control tools is helpful but not required.



DAILY WORKFLOW



Every day, you will normally be responsible for:



• Posting 1 main video across multiple social media platforms

• Posting approximately 3 Instagram Trial Reels

• Warming up Instagram and TikTok before and after posting

• Confirming that every post went live

• Updating the Google Sheets tracker



The main video will normally be posted to:



• Instagram

• TikTok

• YouTube Shorts

• Snapchat

• Threads

•
 when instructed



Your normal workflow will include:



1. Access the remote iPhone through the provided dashboard.

2. Open the Posting Queue in Google Sheets.

3. Download the assigned video from Google Drive.

4. Import the video into the Edits app.

5. Generate and format the subtitles.

6. Confirm that the text hook, subtitles, and video layout look correct.

7. Export or save the video using the required settings.

8. Complete the Instagram warm-up process.

9. Post the main video to Instagram.

10. Complete the Instagram warm-up process again.

11. Complete the TikTok warm-up process.

14. Post the video to the remaining required platforms.

17. Mark the main video as posted.

18. Post approximately 3 Trial Reels to Instagram.

19. Confirm that each Trial Reel was published correctly.

20. Mark the correct Trial Reels as posted in the tracker.



You will be given a separate warm-up tool and instructions. Warming up means naturally interacting with content on Instagram and TikTok before and after posting. This is a required part of the job and cannot be skipped.



WHAT YOU WILL NOT DO



You will not be responsible for:



• Filming videos

• Developing video ideas

• Writing scripts

• Writing captions from scratch

• Performing advanced video editing

• Posting from your own phone



Everything needed for each post will already be prepared.



REVIEW THE ACTUAL POSTING GUIDE



The following guide shows the posting process, including the remote iPhone, Google Drive, Edits, social media apps, Trial Reels, and tracking sheet:







Please review the guide before applying. It will show you what the actual daily job looks like.



If you have read this full description, begin your application with the words REMOTE IPHONE. After reviewing the guide, explain which part of the process you think requires the most attention.



REQUIREMENTS



You must:



• Be available consistently seven days per week

• Have your own computer

• Have stable internet access every day

• Be comfortable controlling an iPhone remotely

• Understand how to navigate iPhone applications

• Have experience posting on social media

• Follow instructions exactly

Approximately 50 Mbps download and 10 Mbps upload is recommended, although a stable connection matters more than extremely fast internet.



PAY



Starting pay is $100 USD per month.

There will be a small paid test before the final hiring decision. The test will confirm that you can control the remote iPhone, follow the guide, prepare and post content correctly, verify your work, and update the tracker.

title: Litigation Paralegal (Texas Personal Injury, Filed Cases)
description:
Read this first



This is not an entry-level job. If you have never worked filed litigation files from petition through trial prep, please do not apply. We will not train you on the basics, and applications from people without real litigation experience will be deleted without a reply.



We are slow to hire and quick to fire. We take our time choosing the right person. Once you are on the team, we expect you to perform from week one. If the work falls short, or if we find padded hours, missed deadlines that were hidden, or a second job you didn't disclose, the engagement ends.



About us



We are a plaintiff personal injury firm in Houston. Our cases include catastrophic injury, trucking and commercial vehicle crashes, wrongful death, premises liability and medical malpractice. We carry a few hundred open files and are growing. A former district judge and a former prosecutor run the firm, so we care a lot about honest reporting of time, deadlines and mistakes.



What you will own



You run large, complex litigation files and work directly with the attorneys. You will have more independence than a standard paralegal, and you are expected to know where every one of your cases stands without being asked. The work includes:



Discovery on a large scale: drafting and answering written discovery, organizing large productions, Bates labeling, and building and maintaining privilege logs

Records and damages: records requests, business records affidavits, Section 18.001 affidavits, and catching counter-affidavits the day they arrive

Experts: retaining experts, chasing reports and CVs, and getting designations filed on time

Depositions: notices, subpoenas, exhibit sets, outline support, and coordination with opposing counsel, court reporters and clients, often several in the same week

Deadlines: building the calendar from the docket control order and tracking every deadline on every file

Mediation and trial: mediation packets, exhibit and witness lists, trial notebooks, and pretrial filings

Mentoring: reviewing the work of junior paralegals and legal assistants, and catching problems before they reach the attorney



Who should apply



Three or more years as a litigation paralegal on filed cases. Plaintiff personal injury is strongly preferred

Working knowledge of Texas civil procedure, or proof that you learn a new state's rules fast

Experience with heavy discovery, privilege logs, and deposition and trial prep, not just intake or pre-suit work

Daily use of case management software across a large caseload

The habit of telling the attorney bad news early



This must be your only job. Tell us in your application if you currently work for anyone else.



Working remote



You need a private workspace and internet strong enough for depositions and client calls, with backup internet and backup power. You must be online during Central Time business hours, on camera for team meetings, and quick to respond on chat. Time is logged by task as you go. Firm files stay in firm systems.



Hours and pay



40 hours a week, 9:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m. Central Time. In Manila that is 10:00 p.m. to 6:00 a.m. from mid-March to early November, and 11:00 p.m. to 7:00 a.m. the rest of the year.



Pay is $9 to $18 per hour, depending on experience. People who perform above average and add real value are eligible for periodic bonuses. Put your full ask in your application: rate, PTO, holidays, allowances and preferred payment method.



Screening questions



Answer each one in a few sentences, in your own words. Applications that skip these, or that read like they were written by AI, will not be considered. We care more about how you think than about polished writing.



1. A docket control order arrives with a trial setting eight months out. What goes on the calendar first, and how do you work backward from trial?

2. A defendant was served 24 days ago and there is no answer on file. What do you check, and what do you tell the attorney?

3. The defense serves a counter-affidavit to your client's Section 18.001 affidavit. What do you do that day, and what does it change about the case?

4. You are producing 4,000 pages of records and some of them are attorney-client communications. Walk us through how you build the privilege log.

5. Expert designations are due Friday. The expert hasn't sent a CV or report, and the last provider's records haven't come in. What do you do, and in what order?

6. A junior paralegal sends you discovery responses to review and they are wrong in several places. How do you handle it?

7. It is Monday. Discovery responses are due today, a deposition is tomorrow and the exhibits aren't final, a client is upset on the phone, and the attorney wants an amended petition by Wednesday. How do you order that list, and why?

8. You realize a deadline on one of your files passed last week. What do you do in the next hour?



Begin your application with the words "Litigation Paralegal" so we know you read the whole post.

title: HOSPITALITY TRAINING & DEVELOPMENT COORDINATOR
description:
# 🚨 NOW HIRING: HOSPITALITY TRAINING & DEVELOPMENT COORDINATOR 🚨



**REMOTE POSITION | IMMEDIATE START | $3.50/HR + PERFORMANCE-BASED INCREASES**



🌴 **Industry:** Restaurant • Bar • Lounge • Hospitality • Caribbean Tourism & Entertainment



**WE DON'T NEED SOMEONE WHO JUST CREATES TRAINING DOCUMENTS. WE NEED SOMEONE WHO CAN ACTUALLY TEACH, INSPIRE, DEVELOP, AND TRANSFORM A TEAM!**



KAM Experience, a vibrant restaurant, bar, lounge, and entertainment destination located in St. Thomas, U.S. Virgin Islands, is seeking an **EXPERIENCED, ENERGETIC, HANDS-ON HOSPITALITY TRAINING & DEVELOPMENT COORDINATOR** to join our remote team.



We are looking for someone who understands the restaurant, bar, and hospitality industry and knows how to turn inexperienced employees into confident, knowledgeable, professional hospitality team members.



**OUR GOAL IS SIMPLE:**



🎯 Turn BEGINNERS into CONFIDENT PROFESSIONALS!



🎯 Turn GOOD SERVICE into EXCEPTIONAL EXPERIENCES!



🎯 Turn EVERY CUSTOMER INTERACTION into an opportunity to build lasting relationships!



🎯 Create a team that is EXCITED, KNOWLEDGEABLE, CONSISTENT, and PROUD of the service they deliver!



We need someone who can **START IMMEDIATELY, connect with our team remotely, and deliver measurable improvements in skills, service, confidence, and performance.**



### 🍹 BAR & BEVERAGE TRAINING



We want someone who can teach our team everything from basic bartending fundamentals to exciting, creative beverage presentations.



Responsibilities include:



- **Bartending Fundamentals:** Teach beginners how to identify spirits, understand liquor categories, use bar tools, measure ingredients, and prepare drinks correctly.

- **Cocktail Preparation:** Demonstrate how to make classic cocktails, tropical drinks, Caribbean-inspired beverages, signature creations, and nonalcoholic options.

- **Pouring Techniques:** Teach proper measurements, free-pouring techniques, use of jiggers, consistency, and responsible alcohol service.

- **Creative Bartending:** Demonstrate shaking, stirring, layering, garnishing, presentation techniques, and engaging bar skills that enhance the customer experience.

- **Drink Presentation:** Teach the team how to create beautiful, visually appealing beverages that customers are excited to photograph, share, and order again.

- **Inventory & Beverage Controls:** Train staff on stock counts, portion control, waste reduction, proper storage, restocking, and accurate inventory reporting.

- **Bar Organization:** Teach proper setup, cleaning, sanitation, opening and closing procedures, and efficient workflow.

- **Upselling & Recommendations:** Teach bartenders how to recommend beverages, introduce specials, increase sales, and build customer relationships.



**WE WANT A BAR TEAM THAT DOES MORE THAN POUR DRINKS. WE WANT THEM TO CREATE AN EXPERIENCE!**



### 🍽️ RESTAURANT & HOSPITALITY SERVICE TRAINING



Hospitality is about much more than delivering food and drinks.



We want our guests to feel welcomed, appreciated, respected, and excited to return.



You will train our team on:



- **First Impressions:** How to greet guests warmly, confidently, and professionally.

- **Guest Engagement:** How to approach tables, introduce themselves, explain menus, and make meaningful connections.

- **Service Excellence:** Proper order-taking, food presentation, table service, timing, attentiveness, and follow-up.

- **Menu Knowledge:** How to confidently explain dishes, ingredients, preparation methods, specials, and beverage pairings.

- **Handling Complaints:** How to remain calm, listen, apologize appropriately, resolve concerns within company policy, and escalate situations when necessary.

- **Difficult Situations:** How to handle unhappy guests, incorrect orders, service delays, misunderstandings, and unexpected challenges.

- **Customer Retention:** How to remember guest preferences, personalize service, encourage repeat visits, and create memorable experiences.

- **Sales & Hospitality:** How to recommend additional menu items, promote events, and increase sales without making customers feel pressured.

- **Cultural Awareness:** How to provide exceptional service to a diverse mix of Caribbean residents, international tourists, and guests from different cultural backgrounds.

- **Professionalism & Teamwork:** Communication, appearance, attitude, accountability, collaboration, and maintaining a positive work environment.



### 🎥 REMOTE TRAINING — THIS IS WHERE YOU MUST SHINE!



**THIS IS NOT A POSITION FOR SOMEONE WHO ONLY WRITES MANUALS, CHECKLISTS, OR TRAINING PLANS.**



We need someone who can bring training to life!



Because you will be working remotely, you must be comfortable teaching, demonstrating, coaching, and interacting with our team through technology.



**YOU WILL BE EXPECTED TO:**



✅ Create clear, engaging, step-by-step training videos demonstrating actual skills and procedures.



✅ Be comfortable appearing on camera and demonstrating bartending techniques, beverage preparation, service scenarios, and practical hospitality skills.



✅ Conduct live video training sessions and interactive coaching with our staff.



✅ Demonstrate techniques using your own equipment or appropriate training resources when necessary.



✅ Create beginner-friendly lessons that employees with little or no experience can understand and apply.



✅ Develop creative role-playing scenarios, quizzes, practical demonstrations, and interactive learning activities.



✅ Review videos submitted by our employees showing their completed training exercises.



✅ Provide constructive feedback, corrections, encouragement, and additional coaching.



✅ Assess employee progress and identify individuals who need additional training.



✅ Coordinate with management to ensure training standards are being implemented consistently.



✅ Develop a practical, organized training library that current and future employees can access.



**WE DON'T WANT TRAINING THAT ENDS WHEN THE VIDEO CALL IS OVER. WE WANT SKILLS THAT STAY WITH OUR TEAM!**



### 🌟 MAKE TRAINING EXCITING!



We want someone who can bring creativity, energy, personality, and enthusiasm into the learning experience.



Imagine:



🍹 **Mixology Mondays:** Learn a new cocktail, pouring technique, or presentation skill.



🎭 **Service Scenario Challenges:** Practice responding to real customer situations with confidence.



🔥 **Bartender Skills Challenges:** Perfect a pour, create an impressive garnish, or demonstrate a new technique.



🌴 **Caribbean Hospitality Spotlight:** Learn how to create memorable experiences for visitors and local guests.



🏆 **Team Skill Showcases:** Employees demonstrate what they have learned through short videos and live challenges.



💡 **Hospitality Excellence Sessions:** Develop confidence, communication skills, professionalism, and guest relationships.



These are examples, not limitations. We want someone who brings original ideas and makes learning something our team genuinely looks forward to!



### 💻 REQUIRED EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS



✅ **PROVEN experience in hospitality training, restaurant operations, bartending, food and beverage service, or team development.**



✅ Strong practical bartending and beverage preparation knowledge.



✅ Experience teaching employees with little or no prior industry experience.



✅ Excellent English communication skills — must speak clearly, confidently, and professionally.



✅ Comfortable appearing on camera, recording instructional videos, and leading live virtual training.



✅ Strong understanding of customer service, guest relations, complaint resolution, and hospitality standards.



✅ Knowledge of restaurant and bar inventory procedures, beverage controls, and operational efficiency.



✅ Ability to create engaging training content, practical demonstrations, and employee assessments.



✅ Familiarity with Caribbean hospitality, tropical beverages, multicultural service, or tourism is a strong advantage.



✅ Ability to work independently, communicate consistently, and deliver measurable results without constant supervision.



✅ Must be available to coordinate with our U.S. Virgin Islands business hours.



**WE ARE LOOKING FOR A TRAINER WHO KNOWS HOW TO DO THE WORK, NOT JUST EXPLAIN THE THEORY!**



### 📊 HOW WE MEASURE SUCCESS



Your value will be determined by the actual improvements you help create.



We want to see:



- Employees successfully preparing drinks according to established recipes and standards.

- Improved pouring accuracy, consistency, and beverage presentation.

- Stronger guest communication and customer service skills.

- Employees confidently handling questions, complaints, and everyday service situations.

- Improved inventory accuracy, portion control, and reduced waste.

- Increased staff confidence, knowledge, engagement, and professionalism.

- Completed practical training sessions with documented employee progress.

- Training resources that can be reused to onboard future employees.



**YOUR SUCCESS IS NOT HOW MANY TRAINING DOCUMENTS YOU CREATE. YOUR SUCCESS IS HOW WELL OUR EMPLOYEES PERFORM BECAUSE OF YOUR TRAINING!**



### 💰 COMPENSATION & GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES



**Starting Rate: $3.50 USD per hour**



**FIRST 7 DAYS — PAID TRIAL PERIOD**



Demonstrate your teaching ability, practical skills, communication, creativity, and ability to connect with our team remotely.



We want to see actual training demonstrations, employee engagement, and measurable contributions.



**30-DAY PERFORMANCE REVIEW**



Your first opportunity for a compensation increase based on the quality of your training, employee development, consistency, and demonstrated results.



**60-DAY PERFORMANCE REVIEW**



A second opportunity for increased compensation based on measurable improvements in staff performance, training effectiveness, and overall contributions.



**LONG-TERM GROWTH POTENTIAL**



As your contributions strengthen our team and improve the customer experience, additional compensation growth and responsibilities may be considered.



*Compensation increases are performance-based and are not automatically guaranteed.*



### 📩 HOW TO APPLY



**PLEASE SUBMIT THE FOLLOWING:**



1. Your resume highlighting relevant hospitality, restaurant, bartending, or training experience.

2. A summary of your experience training employees, particularly beginners.

3. Examples of training programs, instructional materials, or employee development initiatives you have successfully implemented.

4. **A LINK TO YOUR BEST 30–60 SECOND TRAINING VIDEO** demonstrating your ability to teach a practical hospitality or bartending skill. You must appear on camera, explain the process clearly, and demonstrate the skill. **THIS IS REQUIRED.**

5. A brief explanation of how you would successfully train a beginner bartender remotely.

6. The video conferencing, recording, editing, and training platforms you are comfortable using.

7. Your earliest available start date.



**⚠️ APPLICATIONS WITHOUT A PRACTICAL VIDEO DEMONSTRATION WILL NOT BE CONSIDERED.**



We want to SEE how you teach, HEAR how you communicate, and EXPERIENCE the energy you bring to training!



**IMPORTANT:**



We are not hiring someone to simply create documents, rewrite procedures, or tell employees what they should already know.



We need an experienced professional who can **DEMONSTRATE, TEACH, COACH, CORRECT, ENCOURAGE, AND DEVELOP OUR TEAM.**



If you have never trained employees, lack practical hospitality knowledge, or are uncomfortable teaching live on camera, this is not the position for you.



But if you have the skills, personality, patience, passion, and experience to transform a team and make learning exciting, **WE WANT TO HEAR FROM YOU!**



🌴 **KAM EXPERIENCE**



📍 Historic Waterfront District • St. Thomas, U.S. Virgin Islands



🌐 



**🚀 ARE YOU READY TO DEVELOP THE NEXT GENERATION OF HOSPITALITY PROFESSIONALS?**



**SHOW US WHAT YOU CAN DO. INSPIRE OUR TEAM. MAKE AN IMPACT. APPLY NOW!**

title: Quality Assurance Representative
description:
Quality Assurance Representative



SecureSpace Self Storage



MISSION STATEMENT



SecureSpace Self Storage is one of the fastest-growing Self Storage platforms in the USA, with assets located primarily in high-density, urban markets. With a focus on exceptional customer service and upgraded security features, SecureSpace provides a high-quality experience that our customers can count on in any store they visit.



SCOPE OF POSITION



The Quality Assurance Representative at SecureSpace plays a crucial role in maintaining and improving the quality of customer interactions across our inbound and outbound phone teams. This position is responsible for reviewing and evaluating customer calls to ensure representatives consistently meet company standards for professionalism, accuracy, customer service, sales performance, and adherence to established policies and procedures.



The representative will conduct regular call audits, provide detailed and constructive feedback, identify opportunities for improvement, and work closely with leadership to support ongoing employee development. This role requires strong attention to detail, excellent communication skills, and the ability to evaluate customer interactions fairly and consistently.



The Quality Assurance Representative will perform all responsibilities remotely, working independently while collaborating with the Customer Success leadership team. This position thrives in a fast-paced, technology-driven environment and is ideal for a motivated individual who is passionate about improving customer experiences, maintaining operational standards, and supporting the continued growth and success of the team.



SKILLS & EXPERIENCE:



2–5 years of customer service, call center, or quality assurance experience.



High school diploma or equivalent; college education is a plus.



Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to provide clear, professional, and constructive feedback.



Strong attention to detail and the ability to identify inconsistencies, performance concerns, and opportunities for improvement.



Strong organizational and time management skills, with the ability to meet daily and monthly auditing quotas.



Ability to evaluate employee performance objectively and consistently while maintaining professionalism and confidentiality.



Familiarity with inbound customer service and outbound sales processes, including customer retention, objection handling, and sales techniques.



Comfortable navigating multiple systems, reviewing call recordings, documenting findings, and maintaining accurate performance records.



Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to recognize performance trends and recommend improvements.



Self-motivated and independent, with a proactive attitude, strong work ethic, and willingness to learn and adapt to changing procedures.



RESPONSIBILITIES: include (but are not limited to):



Conduct daily quality assurance audits of inbound customer service and outbound sales calls to ensure compliance with SecureSpace policies, procedures, and customer service expectations.



Evaluate customer interactions based on established quality standards, including professionalism, communication, account verification, accuracy of information, troubleshooting, and overall call handling.



Review outbound sales calls to assess representatives' ability to identify customer needs, communicate facility features and benefits, overcome objections, create urgency, and effectively secure rentals.



Review inbound customer service calls to ensure representatives are accurately assisting customers with payments, billing inquiries, account concerns, rental agreements, move-outs, and other storage-related services.



Monitor compliance with company procedures, including customer verification, account security, documentation requirements, proper call dispositions, and appropriate escalation processes.



Maintain accurate and detailed audit records, ensuring evaluations are completed consistently and within established daily, weekly, and monthly quotas.



Provide clear, constructive, and actionable feedback to representatives and leadership to support employee development and improved call performance.



Identify recurring performance concerns, training opportunities, and procedural inconsistencies, communicating findings to the appropriate supervisors and management team.



Collaborate with Customer Success Supervisors, Team Leads, and management to support coaching initiatives, refresher training, and performance improvement plans.



Monitor quality assurance trends and prepare performance summaries highlighting individual and team strengths, areas for improvement, and overall progress.

Manage daily responsibilities independently while maintaining productivity, meeting assigned deadlines, and promoting teamwork in a remote environment.



Complete additional duties as assigned.



REPORTS TO:



Customer Success Manager



PHYSICAL REQUIREMENTS:



Qualified individuals must be able to perform the position's essential duties with or without accommodation. A qualified person with a disability may request a modification or adjustment to the job or work environment to meet the physical requirements of the position. GSA/SecureSpace will attempt to satisfy requests if the accommodations needed are reasonable and no undue hardship would result.



Ability to perform essential job functions while seated for extended periods, including working on a computer, reviewing call recordings, and completing quality assurance evaluations, as well as sit, walk, stand, bend, squat, climb, kneel, and twist intermittently or continuously.



Capability to read documents, review detailed reports, listen to recorded phone calls, and focus on computer screens, with or without corrective lenses or other accommodations as may be required.



Ability to arrange the workspace efficiently for productivity, accommodating any individual needs for ergonomic considerations.



Willingness to transition between various tasks and responsibilities while maintaining work efficiency, accuracy, and effectiveness.

title: Senior Video Editor (Part-Time, Long Term): Weekly Engineering Explainer Show
description:
Zero Industries is an Australian engineering firm based in Hobart, Tasmania. We classify hazardous areas: the places in a factory, grain plant or mine where a flammable gas or a combustible dust could catch fire or explode.



Every week our Managing Director, Travis Stewart, records Source of Release, a 10 to 15 minute explainer for plant managers and engineers. One presenter, one camera, no guests. Each episode takes one change to a technical standard, or one real event, and explains what it means on an operating plant. The video goes on YouTube, the audio goes to our podcast, and short clips go to LinkedIn and YouTube Shorts.



We want one excellent editor to cut it every week, part-time and long term. We pay well above the usual rate here, because we want the best editor we can find, not the cheapest.



THE WORK

- Edit a 10 to 15 minute talking-head episode from one raw take each week, so it comes across as calm, clear and professional. Think of the restrained style of Patrick Boyle's YouTube channel, not a fast-paced vlog.

- Hide every cut. The presenter is filmed on one camera, so we use a gentle punch-in at each cut and full-screen diagrams as cutaways. No jump cuts.

- Cut filler words and false starts cleanly. Never mute words in the middle of a sentence.

- Place the charts, diagrams and on-screen source lines we supply as image files, at the points we list. We make the graphics; you place and time them.

- Make a caption file (SRT) for the full episode, and three short vertical clips (30 to 60 seconds) with captions on screen.

- Now and then, edit a short film of our Lego hazardous-area models, filmed by our team. Paid on top, at the same rate.

- Send the first cut within one working day of receiving the footage. Hobart is 3 hours ahead of Manila, so footage sent in our morning can come back the same day.



WHAT YOU NEED

- Strong written and spoken English. The presenter explains technical standards, and you need to follow the argument well enough to know where a sentence can be cut and where it can't. You don't need engineering knowledge: we supply a list of technical terms, and we check every cut against the script.

- At least three years editing long-form educational or explainer videos for YouTube channels with a real audience. Show us at least one full-length video (8 minutes or more); reels and shorts alone won't do.

- Your own editing software (Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro) and a computer that handles 1080p and 4K footage.

- Clean sound work: steady levels, light noise reduction, no clicks at cuts.

- No AI-generated footage, images, voices or avatars, ever. Ordinary tools such as auto-transcription and noise reduction are fine; tell us which ones you use.

- You do the editing yourself. We're hiring a person, not an agency or a team.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Pay well above the usual rate for this work, for an editor whose work is excellent.

- Steady weekly work, long term, paid on time every month.

- A clear brief every week, the graphics made for you, and one round of notes.



HOW WE'LL CHOOSE

We'll shortlist three applicants and pay each a fixed fee to edit the same test episode from the same brief. You're paid for the test whether or not we choose you. The editor whose test is best starts on a weekly part-time arrangement from episode 2.



HOW TO APPLY

Applications that don't follow these steps won't be read.

1. Make your subject line: Source of Release editor, followed by your first name.

2. Send links to two or three long-form talking-head or educational videos you edited, at least one of them 8 minutes or longer (YouTube or Google Drive is fine). For each one, name the channel and say what you did on it.

3. Tell us which editing program you use, your usual turnaround for a 10-minute talking-head video, who does the editing (it must be you), and your monthly rate for this part-time weekly work, in USD or PHP.

4. Answer these four questions in your own words:

   a. In one of the videos you linked, give the timestamp of one cut you're proud of, and say in one sentence how you hid it.

   b. The presenter says: "So, um, metal dust is now conductive, full stop. So, so dust gets grouped by how it behaves." Write those two sentences the way you would leave them after editing.

   c. A sentence has been cut in the middle and the presenter's head jumps in the frame. Name two ways to hide the jump without re-recording.

   d. Watch the first two minutes of any Patrick Boyle video on YouTube. Name one thing in the editing you would keep for our show, and one thing you would leave out, and say why.



Thank you. We read every application that follows the steps.

title: Senior B2B Marketer (Part-Time, Long Term): Engineering Firm, Relationships and LinkedIn
description:
Zero Industries is an Australian engineering firm based in Hobart, Tasmania. We classify hazardous areas: the places in a factory, grain plant or mine where a flammable gas or a combustible dust could catch fire or explode.



Most of our work comes through relationships: engineering firms and electrical contractors who bring us in on their sites, and plant managers who come back to us. We don't do cold outreach. We want one excellent marketer, part-time and long term, to keep those relationships warm and turn them into meetings and quotes. We pay well above the usual rate here, because we want the best marketer we can find, not the cheapest.



THE WORK

- Run our weekly contact schedule. Our partners, past clients and open opportunities each get something useful from us, on time: a short technical note, an invitation, a follow-up. We write the useful material; you make sure it reaches the right person at the right time.

- Work our trigger list: dated reasons a past client may need us again, such as a classification due for its review. Turn each one into a timely, helpful message.

- Send scheduling, follow-up and value messages under your own name from a Zero Industries
 address, using wording we agree. Our Managing Director, Travis Stewart, handles the conversations and every quote.

- Book calls and meetings for Travis, and keep our CRM (Odoo) up to date after every contact.

- Review Travis's LinkedIn each week: suggest improvements, engage with people who already engage with us, and flag the conversations worth his reply. Travis writes and posts his own posts.

- Get our weekly video show and articles out on time: YouTube, Spotify, our website and the company LinkedIn page.

- Report each month: contacts made, meetings booked, quotes requested, and what's working.



WHAT YOU NEED

- At least three years in B2B marketing or business development for a professional services, engineering or industrial firm, ideally with clients in Australia, the US or the UK.

- Excellent written English. You'll write to engineers and plant managers: plain, helpful and never pushy.

- Experience keeping a CRM accurate (Odoo, HubSpot, Salesforce or similar), and with LinkedIn.

- At least half your hours inside Hobart business hours (6 am to 2 pm Manila time), so meetings get booked while our clients are at work.

- No cold lists, no spam, no automated mass messaging, and no AI-written messages sent unchecked. We build relationships one person at a time.

- You do the work yourself. We're hiring a person, not an agency or a team.



WHAT WE OFFER

- Pay well above the usual rate for this work, for a marketer whose work is excellent.

- Steady weekly work, long term, paid on time every month.

- Real expertise to work with: we write the technical material; you make it reach the right people.



HOW WE'LL CHOOSE

We'll shortlist three applicants and pay each a fixed fee for the same small test: review our Managing Director's LinkedIn profile and suggest five specific improvements; write a short follow-up to an engineering partner using a technical note we supply; and plan one week of contacts from a sample list. You're paid for the test whether or not we choose you.



HOW TO APPLY

Applications that don't follow these steps won't be read.

1. Make your subject line: Zero Industries marketer, followed by your first name.

2. Describe two pieces of B2B relationship or business development work you did: for whom, what you did, and the result in numbers.

3. Tell us which CRM and tools you use, which hours you can work in Manila time, who does the work (it must be you), and your monthly rate for about 20 hours a week, in USD or PHP.

4. Answer these three questions in your own words:

   a. Look at Travis Stewart's LinkedIn profile (Zero Industries). Name the first thing you would change, and why.

   b. An engineering firm sent us two jobs last year and none this year. Write the first message you would send them, in 80 words or fewer.

   c. In one or two sentences: what's the difference between a lead and a relationship?



Thank you. We read every application that follows the steps.
