title: Finance and Reporting Assistant — NetSuite and UK Accounting
description:
Finance and Reporting Assistant — NetSuite and UK Accounting



Remote | 30–40 hours per week | Monday to Friday



About us

Majority is a UK consumer electronics business selling through retail partners and Amazon across the UK, Europe and the US.



We’re looking for an experienced finance professional to work closely with our Finance Director, existing bookkeeper and logistics team. You’ll focus on accounting, reporting and reconciliations, with some related stock and logistics administration.



You’ll gain experience across an international product business, seeing how finance connects with purchasing, inventory, supplier relationships and retail and Amazon sales.



What you will do



- Prepare financial reports and analysis using NetSuite and Excel.

- Support month-end accounting, including journals, accruals, prepayments and balance-sheet reconciliations.

- Prepare UK VAT returns and supporting records, submitting returns following our Finance Director’s review and approval.

- Reconcile supplier statements, bank accounts, rebates and internal finance schedules, investigating differences and resolving queries.

- Support stock and landed-cost reconciliations, including checking goods received, stock movements and shipment discrepancies.

- Maintain accurate reporting schedules and help improve existing processes.

Our Finance Director retains final approval of financial reporting, VAT returns and payments.



What you will bring



- Hands-on NetSuite experience is essential, including accounting, financial reporting and reconciliations.

- Strong UK accounting and VAT knowledge, with practical experience supporting month-end and preparing VAT returns.

- Excellent Excel skills, including lookup formulas, SUMIFS, pivot tables and reconciling transaction datasets.

- Clear written and spoken English, attention to detail and confidence investigating discrepancies.



Experience in e-commerce, retail, wholesale or another business handling physical stock would be particularly useful. Familiarity with Amazon transactions, commercial rebates or NetSuite saved searches would also be valuable.



Working hours



30–40 hours per week, agreed before starting. You must be available 09:00–11:00 UK time each working day, with remaining hours agreed with our Finance Director. This overlap must accommodate GMT and BST.



How to apply



Apply with the subject “Finance Reporting — your name”, attach your CV and briefly answer:



1. What accounting and reporting work have you personally performed in NetSuite, and what UK accounting and VAT experience do you have?

2. Describe a reconciliation discrepancy you resolved and the Excel tools you used.

Shortlisted applicants will be invited to a video interview and practical skills discussion.

Availability to work the full U.S. Eastern Time schedule listed below

title: Short-Form Video Editor & Content Strategist
description:
About the Role



I’m looking for a highly experienced Senior Short-Form Video Editor & Content Strategist to join my content creation business on a full-time, long-term basis.



I am a medical doctor and content creator producing educational, skincare, beauty and lifestyle content across TikTok and Instagram.



This is not a junior editing role. I am looking for someone with significant professional short-form editing experience, exceptional creative judgement and a strong understanding of what drives performance across TikTok, Instagram and the wider social media landscape.



The role combines senior-level short-form video editing, creative direction, content ideation and social media trend awareness.



A core part of this position will be proactively helping to develop and evolve the editing style of the content. The successful candidate should not simply replicate the existing editing style. They should continuously assess how short-form content is changing and use those insights to introduce new editing techniques, formats and creative approaches that make the content more dynamic, current and engaging.



The role also includes proactive content ideation. I am looking for someone who is genuinely immersed in social media and naturally identifies emerging audios, trends, formats, memes, conversations and cultural moments that could be developed into relevant content ideas.



This is a permanent, full-time position within a fast-paced content business where daily posting is a core priority. Reliability, flexibility, creative initiative, responsiveness and consistently meeting deadlines are essential.



Core Responsibilities



Senior Short-Form Editing & Creative Direction



* Edit high-performing short-form content for TikTok and Instagram, across both organic content and paid brand partnerships

* Optimise content for viewer retention, watch time, engagement and overall platform performance

* Use strong creative judgement to strengthen hooks, pacing, structure, storytelling and overall execution

* Proactively identify opportunities within content to improve performance rather than relying on detailed instructions for every creative decision

* Understand the differences between what performs on TikTok and Instagram and adapt editing styles, pacing, formats and creative choices accordingly

* Identify opportunities to strengthen content through relevant visual assets, memes, cultural references, trends, audio and platform-native creative techniques

* Maintain an exceptionally high standard of quality, accuracy and attention to detail

* Take ownership of edits from raw footage through to final approval



Evolving the Editing Style



A major responsibility of this role is to actively help shape and evolve the creative editing direction of the content.



The successful candidate will be expected to:



* Continuously assess how high-performing short-form content is evolving across TikTok and Instagram

* Proactively introduce new editing styles, techniques and creative approaches that can make the content more dynamic and engaging

* Identify elements of the existing editing style that could be refreshed, improved or replaced

* Suggest and experiment with new approaches to hooks, pacing, visual storytelling, text treatments, graphics, audio and overall content structure

* Recognise emerging editing trends early and assess whether they are genuinely relevant to the creator’s content and audience

* Help ensure the content remains current, competitive and platform-native, rather than relying on an editing formula that becomes dated over time

* Balance creative evolution with consistency so that the content continues to feel recognisably aligned with the creator’s personal brand



The expectation is not simply to follow an established editing template. The editor should bring the experience and creative judgement required to help determine what the editing style should become next.



Content Ideation & Trend Spotting



This role extends beyond editing and includes an important content ideation component.



The successful candidate will be expected to:



* Proactively bring forward content ideas rather than waiting solely for content to be assigned

* Regularly identify trending audios, formats, memes, conversations, cultural moments and emerging social media trends that could be relevant to the creator’s content

* Suggest specific ways those trends could be adapted into original TikTok or Instagram content

* Identify emerging or high-performing content formats and suggest how they could be applied to educational, skincare, beauty, lifestyle or personality-led content

* Bring forward ideas for new hooks, video structures, recurring formats and creative concepts

* Proactively share useful creative references and examples

* Understand the difference between blindly following a trend and identifying trends that can be adapted naturally and strategically to the creator’s audience and personal brand

* Remain sufficiently immersed in TikTok, Instagram and wider social media culture to identify opportunities while they are relevant, rather than once a trend has already passed



For example, if an audio, meme or format begins trending and there is a strong way to adapt it to the creator’s content, the expectation is that the editor would identify that opportunity and proactively suggest the content idea.



Picture Carousels & Canva



* Create high-quality picture carousel content for TikTok and Instagram using Canva

* Turn supplied copy, information and concepts into polished, engaging and platform-appropriate carousel content

* Contribute creative ideas around carousel formats, layouts, hooks and visual treatments

* Maintain a strong and consistent visual identity

* Source relevant imagery, graphics, screenshots and visual references where required

* Keep up to date with evolving carousel styles and formats across TikTok and Instagram

* Help evolve carousel design alongside the broader creative direction of the social channels



Paid Brand Partnerships



* Edit paid brand partnerships to a consistently high standard while maintaining the creator’s organic content style

* Understand and accurately execute campaign briefs and brand requirements

* Balance mandatory brand messaging with the need for content to remain engaging and native to the platform

* Identify creative ways to integrate brand requirements without making the content feel unnecessarily commercial

* Handle brand revisions accurately and efficiently



Seniority & Experience



This is explicitly a senior-level position.



Applicants should have significant professional experience editing short-form social media content and be able to demonstrate a strong portfolio of high-quality work.



The successful candidate must already have the technical foundations expected of an experienced professional editor. This role is focused on a higher level of contribution: creative judgement, strategic thinking, platform knowledge, content performance, creative direction and proactive ideation.



Applicants should be able to demonstrate:



* Significant professional short-form video editing experience

* A strong portfolio of TikTok, Instagram Reels or comparable vertical content

* Experience editing content designed to achieve strong social media performance

* Advanced proficiency in CapCut and/or Adobe Premiere Pro

* Strong proficiency in Canva

* Excellent knowledge of TikTok and Instagram

* A sophisticated understanding of viewer psychology, retention, hooks and short-form storytelling

* Strong awareness of social media culture, emerging trends and platform behaviour

* The ability to distinguish between a fleeting trend and a genuinely valuable creative opportunity

* Strong independent creative judgement

* The confidence to suggest improvements or challenge an existing creative approach where appropriate

* The ability to take ownership of an edit without requiring detailed step-by-step direction

* Strong English comprehension and excellent attention to detail

* Clear and proactive communication

* Strong organisation and time-management skills

* The ability to manage multiple priorities within a fast-moving content environment



What I’m Looking For



The ideal editor is someone who:



* Takes genuine pride in producing exceptionally high-quality work

* Is highly experienced and confident in their creative judgement

* Understands what makes content perform across both TikTok and Instagram and can adapt editing styles, pacing and formats accordingly

* Understands the psychology behind high-performing short-form content

* Knows how to strengthen hooks and improve viewer retention through editing

* Can identify moments where pacing, captions, visuals, memes, cultural references or structure can be improved to maximise performance

* Keeps up to date with TikTok and Instagram trends, formats, platform updates and changes in audience behaviour

* Understands how to incorporate relevant trends naturally into content where appropriate to maximise engagement and performance

* Proactively helps evolve the editing style rather than simply reproducing the existing one

* Is excited by the opportunity to develop new and more dynamic creative approaches as social media evolves

* Regularly brings forward content ideas, trending audios, formats and creative references without needing to be asked

* Thinks beyond the individual edit and contributes to the broader creative direction and performance of the content

* Can follow a creator’s style while also bringing strong creative ideas and suggestions

* Understands when innovation will strengthen a piece of content and when a simpler approach is more effective

* Learns from feedback and consistently applies it to future work

* Communicates clearly and proactively

* Is highly dependable and consistent

* Takes ownership of deliverables and deadlines

* Does not need to be repeatedly chased or micromanaged

* Is comfortable operating at the pace required by a creator publishing content daily



This role supports a creator who is looking to post daily content. Reliability and meeting deadlines are therefore essential.



Turnaround Expectations



This is a fast-paced full-time role, and applicants must be comfortable working to consistently short turnaround times.



First Draft Turnaround



Once raw footage has been received, a fully edited first draft must be delivered within approximately 4–6 hours, depending on the length and complexity of the video.



For particularly complex or editing-intensive videos, turnaround may extend to up to 12 hours.



The expectation is that newly received footage is prioritised and editing begins promptly. This is not a role operating on a traditional freelance editing turnaround of 24–48 hours.



Applicants should only apply if they are genuinely comfortable maintaining this level of turnaround consistently.



Revisions



* Straightforward revisions must be actioned urgently upon receipt of feedback

* More substantial revisions must also be prioritised and completed as quickly as possible

* The editor must remain highly responsive to feedback and revision requests

* Previous feedback must be retained and applied to future edits to minimise unnecessary repeat revision rounds



Flexibility & Availability



This is a full-time role with flexible working hours.



There are no fixed or pre-agreed daily working hours. Instead, the successful candidate must be flexible around the requirements of a fast-moving content schedule.



* The successful candidate must have the flexibility to adapt their working pattern around when footage, feedback and content requirements arise

* Capacity to edit content consistently throughout the week is essential

* Weekend availability is a non-negotiable requirement of the role

* Urgent edits may occasionally require a faster turnaround

* The editor must be highly responsive and able to adapt where necessary to meet content and campaign deadlines

* Any known periods of unavailability must be communicated in advance



Communication, Reliability & Ownership



The successful candidate must:



* Communicate clearly and proactively

* Be highly responsive to new content, feedback and changing priorities

* Keep the creator/team updated on the status of edits where necessary

* Flag potential issues or delays before they affect a deadline

* Take ownership of assigned work rather than requiring repeated follow-up

* Manage priorities independently

* Maintain high standards even when working to fast turnaround times

* Be dependable and consistent



Typical Deliverables



Typical workload includes:



* Approximately 7 short-form videos per week

* Picture carousel content for TikTok and Instagram as required

* A mix of organic content and paid brand partnerships

* Videos generally between 30–90 seconds

* Revisions and alternative versions where required

* Proactive content ideas, trend recommendations and creative references



Workload may fluctuate depending on the content calendar, brand campaigns and wider business requirements.



Confidentiality & Content Ownership



The editor may have access to unreleased content, brand campaign information and other confidential business material.



All footage, content, campaign materials and other confidential information must be treated accordingly and may not be shared, uploaded or repurposed externally without permission.



All final content, project files and creative assets produced as part of the role will remain the property of the business.



Role Details



Position: Senior Short-Form Video Editor & Content Strategist

Employment: Full-time, permanent / long-term

Location: Remote

Hours: Full-time with flexible working hours based around content requirements and deadlines

Weekend availability: Required and non-negotiable

Start Date: As soon as possible



Application Requirements



Please include:



* A portfolio of short-form content within the following niches ONLY 



skincare, 

beauty,

Haircare

 lifestyle



* At least 7–10 examples of TikTok, Instagram Reels or comparable short-form content that you have personally edited

* Examples that demonstrate a range of editing styles, formats and creative approaches where possible

* Examples of TikTok or Instagram picture carousels you have created



Please *only* apply if you have experience editing high-performing short-form content within the above niches, are comfortable contributing proactively to content ideation and creative direction, and can consistently work to the fast turnaround times outlined above.



Applications will be immediately disqualified if you are unable to demonstrate previous video editing experience within the beauty/skincare/haircare/lifestyle niche

title: Full-Stack Digital Marketing Specialist (Social, Content, Ads & Lead Generation) — US Brands
description:
Full-Stack Digital Marketing Specialist (Social, Content, Ads & Lead Generation) — US Brands



About Us



We're a group of US-based businesses — a construction/renovation company (MVK Construction), a countertop and stone brand (Copperhead Stone), and a growing coffee e-commerce brand (Midday Drip).



We're looking for a versatile, results-driven digital marketer to manage social media, content creation, paid advertising, and lead generation across our brands.



What You'll Do



Content Creation — Create engaging graphics using Canva, short-form videos/reels using CapCut, and captions for Instagram,
, and TikTok.



Content Calendar & Posting — Plan and consistently publish content across all three brands.



Audience Growth & Engagement — Grow followers, respond to comments and DMs, engage in relevant
 groups, and build brand awareness.



Paid Advertising — Set up, manage, and optimize
/Instagram (Meta) ads and basic Google Ads to generate leads and sales. Track performance, cost per lead, and return on ad spend.



E-commerce Support — Support our Midday Drip Shopify store through product promotions, social media campaigns, and simple
 marketing.



Local Lead Generation & Listings — Maintain and optimize Google Business Profile, Houzz, Angi, and Nextdoor to attract local customers.



Outbound Lead Generation & Outreach — Research and identify potential customers, contractors, builders, and business partners for MVK Construction and Copperhead Stone. Conduct light outreach through
s, social media messages, and occasional calls to introduce our services and follow up with prospects.



Weekly Qualified Leads — Provide a list of qualified potential customers every week, including relevant contact information, project needs, and outreach status, so our team can call them, provide quotations, and convert them into paying customers.



Weekly Reporting — Submit a short weekly report covering content published, engagement, advertising performance, outreach activities, qualified leads generated, and overall results.



You're a Great Fit If You Have



2+ years of experience in social media management or digital marketing, preferably working with US small businesses.



Strong Canva graphic design and video editing skills (CapCut or similar).



Hands-on experience with Meta Business Suite and Ads Manager.



Experience with Google Ads and Shopify is a strong plus.



Experience marketing construction, renovation, home improvement, countertop, or coffee/e-commerce businesses is a plus.



Experience in lead generation, prospect research, and
 outreach.



Excellent written English and an understanding of US audiences.



A portfolio or examples of social media accounts you've managed or grown, preferably with measurable results.



Strong organizational skills, reliability, and initiative.



Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and focus on measurable results.



Job Details



Schedule: Start part-time at 20 hours per week, with the potential to transition to full-time (40 hours per week) based on performance and business needs.



Working Hours: Must have some overlap with US Central Time.



Hourly Rate: $5.50–$6.00/hour, depending on experience.



Payment: Weekly via Wise.



Time Tracking: OLJ Timeproof.



Opportunity: Long-term role with potential for increased hours and responsibilities.



How to Apply



Start your application with the word FUNNEL so we know you've read the entire posting.



Share your portfolio or links to 2–3 social media accounts you've managed or grown, including results or metrics if available.



List the tools you use for graphic design, video editing, social media scheduling, advertising, and lead generation.



In 3–4 sentences, explain how you would market a local countertop or construction business differently from an online coffee brand.



Briefly explain your experience generating leads for US businesses, including how you find and qualify potential customers.



Provide your monthly rate for both part-time (20 hours/week) and full-time (40 hours/week) and your earliest available start date.



We're looking for someone who can do more than just post content — we want a marketer who can help grow our audience, generate qualified leads, and contribute to real business results.

About the role:



Rapid Hockey is looking for a freelance technical apparel designer to build the patterns, 3D samples, and tech packs behind our custom team uniforms. This is an ongoing, project-based role: each time we develop a new style, you'll be our first call.



Rapid Hockey (also known as Rapid Athletic) makes fully custom hockey uniforms, including jerseys, socks, and related apparel, for teams and programs. We're building out our product documentation so any qualified factory can produce our garments to the same standard. Your work will become the master blueprint for every style we make.



What you'll do:



You'll take each style from concept or existing sample to a factory-ready package.

1. Pattern making. Create production patterns for new styles, and reverse engineer patterns from our existing garments where we don't have files. Grade patterns across our full youth through adult size range.

2. 3D development in CLO 3D. Build each style as a 3D garment to check fit, proportions, and decoration placement before we cut a physical sample.

3. Tech packs. Produce complete tech packs for each base style: bill of materials, fabric and trim specs, construction and stitching details, graded measurement charts, and decoration specs for sublimation and tackle twill.

4. Factory handoff support. Answer factory questions, review samples against spec, and update files when we make changes.



To start, we'll document our two or three best-selling styles out of about 10 base styles, then work through the rest over time.



What we're looking for:

Required

• 3+ years of technical design or pattern making experience in apparel

• Strong working knowledge of CLO 3D, with a portfolio showing 3D garments you built

• Experience creating full tech packs that factories have produced from

• Pattern grading across a wide size range

• Ability to reverse engineer patterns and specs from finished garments

• Clear written English and reliable communication across time zones

Nice to have

• Experience with team sports or athletic uniforms, especially hockey jerseys and socks

• Knowledge of sublimation, tackle twill, and performance knit fabrics

• Experience working directly with overseas factories

• Familiarity with Techpacker or similar tech pack software



Engagement and how to apply:

• Type: Freelance, ongoing, project-based

• Location: Remote

• Pay: $4/hour

• Ownership: All patterns, CLO files, and tech packs created are owned by Rapid Hockey and delivered in editable source formats



To apply, send:

1. Your portfolio, including at least one CLO 3D garment and one complete tech pack

2. Confirmation that $4/hour works for you, and your typical hours per style

3. A short note on any team sports or athletic apparel you've worked on

title: Prior Authorization Specialist
description:
Position Summary

We're looking for someone who combines exceptional organization with exceptional people skills. You'll be responsible for keeping insurance authorizations moving, tracking down critical documentation, and building strong relationships with the physician offices and referral partners we work with every day. Success in this role means taking ownership, anticipating problems, and following through until the job gets done. 



Core Responsibilities

Insurance Authorizations & Tracking

-Prepare and submit initial and ongoing insurance authorization requests, ensuring all required documentation is complete and accurate.

-Monitor pending authorizations, check for approvals, and proactively follow up with insurance companies.

-Maintain accurate authorization records, including approved dates, units, and supporting documentation.

-Identify upcoming authorization expirations and help prevent interruptions in patient care.

-Escalate complex authorization issues, denials, or discrepancies to the Insurance Specialist.



Physician Office & Referral Partner Communication

-Contact physician offices and referring clinics by phone, fax, and
 to obtain signed plans of care and other required documentation.

-Develop strong, lasting relationships with physician offices and referral partners, becoming a trusted, dependable contact who makes it easy for their teams to work with TeamUp Therapy. 

-Follow up persistently and respectfully on outstanding requests, ensuring nothing falls through the cracks.

-Maintain organized records of outreach attempts, responses, and next steps.



Documentation, Audits & Organization

-Upload and organize authorization approvals, signed plans of care, and other insurance documents in our electronic medical record system.

-Maintain and update authorization tracking spreadsheets and patient hold records.

-Conduct routine authorization audits to identify missing documentation, upcoming deadlines, or potential issues.

-Communicate proactively with the Insurance Specialist and clinical team regarding authorization status, delays, and outstanding needs.



Additional Administrative Support

-Cross-train on key intake and scheduling responsibilities to provide backup coverage when needed.

-Help identify opportunities to improve workflows, efficiency, and the overall patient experience.



Must-Have Skills & Experience

-Excellent English communication skills, both written and verbal, with confidence and professionalism on phone calls.

-Exceptional organizational skills, attention to detail, and ability to manage multiple priorities.

-Strong relationship-building skills, with a warm, personable, and persistent communication style.

-Ability to work independently, take initiative, and consistently follow through on tasks.

-Strong computer skills and comfort using Google Sheets, Docs, and other web-based platforms.

-Willingness to learn new systems, adapt to changing processes, and take on additional responsibilities.

-Experience working remotely with a reliable internet connection and professional work environment.



Preferred Qualifications

-Previous experience managing U.S. healthcare prior authorizations is strongly preferred, particularly in pediatric speech, occupational, or physical therapy. 

-Familiarity with electronic medical records, insurance portals, or healthcare practice management software.

-Experience communicating with physician offices, referral partners, or insurance companies.

-Spanish fluency is a plus.



Schedule & Work Environment

-Weekly Hours: 40 hours/week (full-time)

-Work Hours: 9am- 5pm ET, Monday–Friday

-Location: Remote

-Training: Initial onboarding, SOP-based training, and ongoing support from our Insurance Specialist and administrative team



Compensation & Classification

-Type: Independent Contractor

-Hourly Rate: $7.00 USD per hour

-Performance Bonuses: Eligible for quarterly performance bonuses based on individual performance and contributions to team goals



Success Metrics

-Authorization requests are submitted accurately and on time, minimizing interruptions in patient care.

-Outstanding signed plans of care and required documentation are obtained through consistent, proactive follow-up.

-Referral partners and physician offices experience warm, responsive, and professional communication.

-Authorization records, tracking systems, and patient hold lists remain accurate and up to date.

-The broader administrative team receives reliable backup support when needed.



About TeamUp Therapy

TeamUp Therapy is a pediatric telehealth practice providing speech and occupational therapy to families across Georgia. We believe in removing barriers to care—making therapy ultra-convenient, family-centered, and accessible without unnecessary wait times.



Our mission is to help every child reach their full potential through compassionate, high-quality care.



Our team is guided by three core values: Solve Problems, Communicate Clearly, and Empower Families. We're a collaborative, growing organization that values initiative, accountability, and people who genuinely care about making a difference.



Introduction Video (2–3 Minutes)

Please record a short video introducing yourself and answering the following questions:

-Tell us a little about yourself and your professional background.

-What experience do you have with U.S. healthcare, insurance authorizations, or medical administration?

-Why are you interested in joining TeamUp Therapy as our Prior Authorization Specialist?

-We're looking forward to getting to know you! No professional editing or special production is necessary. Please just make sure your audio is clear and that we can see and hear you comfortably.



You can upload either a Google Drive sharing link or a YouTube link. Please submit it through this Google Form: https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSe1V4fwel5Ev8CsQOP7_Uh5Rs5nFV3NL4huo2-8CZg7zRpEfQ/viewform?usp=sharing&ouid=113651035607991832792

title: Cold Caller / Appointment Setter – US IT/MSP Market (Night Shift)
description:
Location: Fully Remote (Philippines)

Schedule: Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–6:00 PM US Eastern Time. This is a night shift in Manila: 11:00 PM–7:00 AM from November to March, and 10:00 PM–6:00 AM from March to November (US daylight saving time).

Compensation: $850 USD/month base + $25 USD per qualified appointment that shows + $100 USD per client that signs



About T3 Tech Partners



T3 Tech Partners is the team Managed Service Providers (MSPs) rely on when challenges go beyond Tier 2 or their internal expertise. We operate as a Fractional Tier 3 partner: MSPs get access to senior-level engineers when they need them, without the cost of hiring one full time. We deliver advanced Systems Administration, Infrastructure, Networking, Cloud, and Security expertise to MSPs supporting diverse client environments.



Our engineers are trusted technical partners. They lead implementations, resolve complex escalations, and work directly with MSP clients to deliver real-world solutions. Our outbound team is the first voice those partners hear, and that first impression matters.



Role Overview



We are looking for an experienced Cold Caller / Appointment Setter to drive outbound prospecting into MSPs and IT firms across the United States. You will own the top of the funnel: working through prospect lists we provide, making high-volume outbound calls, handling objections in real time, and booking qualified discovery meetings for our leadership team.



This is a voice-first role. You will speak every day with US-based business owners, IT directors, and MSP principals, so clear, confident, natural-sounding English is essential. You’ll need to hold a real business conversation with senior decision-makers without relying on a script.



Key Responsibilities



Outbound Calling & Prospecting



Make 80–100 outbound dials per day (after a two-week ramp-up) to MSPs, IT service firms, and internal IT departments across US time zones.

Open conversations confidently with owners, principals, and IT decision-makers.

Qualify prospects against our ideal-client profile (company size, service mix, gaps in Tier 3 coverage).

Handle gatekeepers professionally and consistently reach the decision-maker.

Book qualified discovery calls directly onto the sales calendar.



Objection Handling & Conversation Quality



Respond to objections in real time without reading from a script.

Adapt tone and pacing to the person on the other end of the line.

Explain our value clearly to a technical audience without overstating technical claims.

Recognize when to disqualify a prospect quickly and move on.



Follow-Up & Pipeline Management



Run structured follow-up sequences by phone,
, and LinkedIn.

Log every call, outcome, and next step in Go High Level the same day.

Keep prospect lists clean, correcting bad data as you find it.

Nurture “not right now” prospects on a set callback schedule.



Reporting & Continuous Improvement



Report daily and weekly on dials, connects, conversations, and appointments set.

Join call reviews and act on coaching feedback.

Test and report on messaging, opening lines, and list segments.

Flag recurring objections and market feedback to leadership.

Availability

Working hours are 10:00 AM–6:00 PM US Eastern Time, Monday through Friday.

This is a night shift in the Philippines. Please apply only if you have worked a graveyard schedule before and can sustain it long term.

Some flexibility may be needed during active campaigns or event-driven outreach.

This role is not on-call, but consistent attendance during US business hours is essential.

What We Provide

Targeted prospect lists of US-based MSPs and IT firms, so your time goes into calling, not researching

A Go High Level account with built-in dialer, phone number, CRM, and direct booking to the sales calendar

Training on our services and ideal-client profile, plus ongoing call coaching

A two-week ramp-up period: your daily target is 50–60 dials while you learn our services and messaging, then moves to the full 80–100

Qualifications



Required



2+ years of outbound cold calling, appointment setting, or SDR experience in the US market.

Clear, confident spoken and written English that US business owners understand easily, with natural pacing and strong phone presence.

Proven ability to hold unscripted business conversations with senior decision-makers.

A track record of hitting dial, conversation, and appointment targets.

Comfortable working in a CRM and dialer platform. Go High Level experience is a strong plus (we provide the account).

Reliable high-speed internet, a quiet dedicated workspace, a backup power source, and a quality noise-cancelling headset.

Comfortable with rejection and high call volume; self-directed with minimal supervision.



Preferred



Outbound experience selling into MSPs, IT services, or B2B technology.

Familiarity with Microsoft 365, cloud, or managed IT terminology.

Hands-on Go High Level experience (calling, pipelines, calendar booking, follow-up workflows).

Experience researching prospects (Apollo, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator) to personalize outreach.

Compensation

Base: $850 USD per month, paid twice monthly.

Appointment commission: $25 USD for every qualified appointment that takes place.

Conversion bonus: $100 USD for every prospect who signs on for services after a meeting you booked.

No minimum threshold. Commission is paid from your first qualified appointment.

Engagement type: Independent contractor. Payment method: bank transfer via Gusto HR system



What counts as a qualified appointment



The meeting must actually take place, and the person on the call must be a decision-maker or decision-influencer: an owner, principal, partner, CEO, CTO, IT director, IT manager, service manager, or operations manager. A help desk technician, receptionist, or office administrator does not count, even if they agreed to the meeting. Our sales team confirms each attendee’s role after the meeting, and you’ll see the result in Go High Level.



Reschedules don’t affect commission. If the meeting eventually happens with a qualifying contact, you are paid. Appointments that never take place are not paid.



Conversion bonus



If a prospect you booked signs a services agreement with T3 Tech Partners within 90 days of the meeting taking place, you receive an extra $100 USD, paid on signature. There is no cap.



What this adds up to



At a normal pace of 15 to 20 held appointments per month, base plus commission comes to $1,225–$1,350. Two signed clients in a month brings that to $1,425–$1,550.



How to Apply – Audio Sample Required



Applications without an audio sample will not be reviewed. It’s the first thing we check.



This role is judged on how you sound on the phone, so please record a 60–90 second voice sample yourself, in your own voice, in one take. Cover:



Your name and where you’re based.

A brief summary of your outbound calling experience and the markets you’ve called into.

A mock cold call opener: you’ve just reached the owner of a US-based MSP who wasn’t expecting your call. Deliver your first 20–30 seconds exactly as you would on a real dial.

How you’d respond if that owner said, “We already have an internal engineer for that.”



How to send it



Record with any free tool, then paste the shareable link into the job post chat here on OnlineJobs.ph. Options that work well:



Vocaroo (
): records in your browser, no account needed, instant link

Voice Spice (
): browser-based recorder with a shareable link

Clyp (
): free hosting with a direct link

Google Drive or Dropbox: record on your phone, upload, and share



Make sure anyone with the link can listen. We can’t chase permission requests, and locked links count as no submission.



In your chat message, please include:



The word Tier3 as the first word of your message (so we know you read the full post)

Your audio link

Your resume or a link to it

The number of outbound dials you typically made per day in your last role

Confirmation that you can work 10:00 AM–6:00 PM US Eastern Time, and whether you’ve worked a night shift before



We review every application that includes an audio sample. Strong candidates will be invited to a short live phone screen, where, once again, how you sound matters most.

title: Content Clipper / Editor - Short-Form Social Media
description:
Do you want to work on content that reaches millions of people while being part of a fast-growing transformation and sound healing brand built around community?



Our content averages roughly **50–150 million views per month**, and we're looking for a highly skilled **Short-Form Content Clipper** to join our team full time.



We're expanding our long-form content production and need someone who can turn hours of footage into compelling, high-retention short-form videos for Instagram,
, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.



**This is NOT a traditional video editing role.**



We're looking for someone who understands **viral content, the psychology of hooks, storytelling, pacing, and audience retention.**



The most important skill is knowing **what to clip, where to start, what to cut out, and exactly when to end.**



## About Us



Harmony is a fast-growing transformation, music, and sound healing company founded by musician and intuitive guide Banah Winn.



We create Golden Ratio Frequencies, guided experiences, educational content, live events, and an online community dedicated to helping people create meaningful change in their lives.



Our content reaches **50–150 million views per month**, and we're expanding into more long-form videos, live teachings, interviews, music performances, and behind-the-scenes documentaries.



We have an established creative team and a deep understanding of what performs on social media. We're looking for someone who can help us turn our growing library of long-form content into a consistent stream of powerful short-form videos.



## About the Role



Your main responsibility will be to **review long-form footage, independently identify the strongest moments, and turn them into engaging short-form clips.**



You won't always be given timestamps or instructions telling you what to cut. You'll need the judgment to recognize which moments have the highest potential to perform on social media.



Sometimes the best hook is buried in the middle of a conversation. Sometimes removing 20 seconds makes the entire clip more compelling. Sometimes a moment needs to breathe.



**Your ability to make these decisions is the core skill we're hiring for.**



## What You'll Be Clipping



We produce a variety of long-form content, including:



- **Vlogs & Behind-the-Scenes:** Interesting, funny, authentic, and emotional moments that tell a story.

- **Live Teaching & Authority Videos:** Powerful insights, explanations, and breakthroughs from webinars, live calls, and educational sessions.

- **Interviews & Conversations:** Surprising answers, compelling stories, memorable exchanges, and interesting perspectives.

- **Live Music & Performances:** Beautiful, moving, and engaging moments from live musical sessions.

- **Long-Form Talking Videos:** Strong teachings, memorable statements, and valuable explanations.

- **Guest Teachers & Community Calls:** Engaging moments from other guides, teachers, and community members.



Each format requires a different approach to selecting clips, storytelling, and pacing.



## What We're Looking For



- **Excellent understanding of viral hooks:** You know what stops someone from scrolling and how to capture attention in the first few seconds.

- **Strong editorial judgment:** You can identify the most compelling moments and know exactly where to start, what to remove, and when to end a clip.

- **Understanding of retention and pacing:** You recognize when content drags, when to make cuts, and when to let a moment breathe.

- **Excellent English comprehension:** You understand natural conversation, humor, emotion, nuance, and context well enough to recognize powerful moments.

- **Short-form storytelling:** You can turn longer conversations into standalone clips with a clear, engaging structure.

- **Knowledge of viral formats:** You actively study successful social media content and understand what makes different styles perform.

- **Strong editing fundamentals:** Clean cuts, natural dialogue, good audio, and proper vertical formatting.

- **Independence and efficiency:** You can review large amounts of footage, select clips, and deliver them quickly without constant direction.

- **Reliability and communication:** You consistently meet deadlines, communicate clearly, and work effectively within a team.



### Bonus Skills



- On-screen captions and text overlays

- Simple graphics and supporting visuals

- Experience growing social media accounts organically

- Proven clips with significant organic views

- Experience with music, podcasts, interviews, or documentary-style content



## Editing Style



Our style is generally **simple, clean, and native to social media.**



We're not looking for complicated effects, flashy transitions, or heavy motion graphics.



Initially, your focus will be on selecting great moments, making clean cuts, tightening pacing, and creating clips that keep people watching.



On-screen captions and text overlays are not required for every clip initially, but we'd ideally like someone who knows how to add them.



We care much more about **content selection and retention than complicated editing.**



## Speed & Volume



As our long-form production expands, we'll have a significant amount of footage to review.



We need someone who can work efficiently, identify the strongest moments, and consistently deliver high-quality clips.



This is intended to be a **full-time position** with consistent ongoing work and opportunities to grow with the company.



## Pay



**$8/hour**



## To Apply



Please send:



- **3–5 examples of your best short-form clips created from longer content**

- **The number of views each clip received and the platform it was posted on** (Instagram, TikTok,
, or YouTube Shorts)

- Links to the published clips so we can review them

- Your experience clipping long-form content

- Your typical turnaround time

- Your current availability

- Your earliest start date



**Please do not send only cinematic edits, music videos, motion graphics, or scripted talking-head videos.**



We want to see examples that demonstrate your ability to **find compelling moments in longer footage and turn them into engaging short-form content.**

title: Senior SEO & AI Search Manager – Local SEO, WordPress & Lead Generation
description:
Senior SEO & AI Search Manager – Local SEO, WordPress & Lead Generation



About Us

We are a U.S.-based digital marketing agency that helps businesses grow through SEO, websites, paid advertising, and lead generation. 



We manage SEO campaigns across multiple client websites and are looking for an experienced, hands-on SEO manager who can lead strategy and make sure the work gets done.



About the Role

This is a working manager role. You’ll plan and manage SEO campaigns, review and improve implementation, and work with writers, developers, and other team members. You should be comfortable working directly in WordPress and using search and analytics data to d
 what to do next.



Key Responsibilities

SEO planning and campaign management

- Manage SEO campaigns across multiple client accounts.

- Conduct website audits

- Turn audits, search data, and business goals into prioritized monthly work plans.

- Coordinate developers; review work for quality and follow-through.

- Track tasks and campaign progress in our project management system.

- Improve our SEO processes and documentation as you identify opportunities.



Local SEO

- Improve local visibility for clients serving specific cities, regions, or states.

- Optimize Google Business Profiles and advise on categories, services, content, and profile improvements.

- Plan and optimize location, service-area, and community-type pages.

- Review local listings and citations for accuracy and consistency.

- Develop practical recommendations to improve map visibility and qualified inquiries.

- Research & identify sites to link to clients sites and obtain links.



On-page SEO and content

- Optimize service pages, location pages, and educational content for search intent and conversions.

- Create content briefs and review work from writers.

- Improve page structure, headings, internal links, calls to action, and metadata.

- Find content gaps and opportunities based on keyword research, Search Console data, and competitor analysis.

- Help ensure content is useful to decision-makers, not just optimized around keywords.



Technical SEO and WordPress

- Run technical audits and identify issues affecting crawling, indexing, site structure, or performance.

- Implement appropriate fixes in WordPress or provide clear requirements to a developer.

- Work with common WordPress themes and page builders.

- Review redirects, canonicals, noindex settings, sitemaps, schema markup, and Core Web Vitals.

- Explain technical issues clearly and prioritize fixes based on their likely impact.



AI search visibility

- Help improve clients’ discoverability in AI-assisted search experiences, including Google AI Overviews and tools such as ChatGPT and Perplexity.

- Identify useful content, entity, schema, and reputation improvements that support visibility.

- Track available evidence of AI-related referrals, mentions, and search visibility, and report on limitations in the data.



Reporting and communication

- Monitor rankings, organic traffic, Google Business Profile performance, and lead activity.

- Use Google Search Console and GA4 to investigate changes and identify opportunities.

- Prepare clear monthly updates with results, completed work, next priorities, and any issues that need attention.

- Communicate professionally in written English with our U.S.-based team and, when needed, clients.



Required Qualifications

- At least 5 years of hands-on SEO experience, including managing multiple websites or campaigns.

- Strong local SEO experience for U.S. businesses.

- Demonstrated ability to connect SEO work to leads or other business outcomes.

- Strong technical SEO and on-page optimization skills.

- Extensive experience with WordPress.

- Working knowledge of Google Search Console, GA4, Semrush or Ahrefs, BrightLocal, and Screaming Frog.

- Experience with Google Business Profile optimization and local landing pages.

- Strong written English, organization, follow-through, and attention to detail.

- Able to explain what you did on a campaign and how you measured the results.

-Must be able to work during US work hours 8-5 CST.



Preferred Qualifications

- Experience leading or reviewing the work of content writers and web developers.

- Familiarity with schema markup, conversion optimization, and AI search visibility.



What Success Looks Like

In your first 6–12 months, you will:

- Keep SEO work moving across multiple client accounts with clear priorities and follow-through.

- Improve the quality and consistency of technical, local, and on-page SEO implementation.

- Help clients earn more visibility for relevant local and service searches.

- Improve organic lead quality and help us understand which work contributes to qualified inquiries.

- Strengthen our SEO workflows, reporting, and team coordination.



How to Apply

Please include:

- Your resume and a short introduction.

- A summary of your local SEO and campaign management experience.

- Examples from three SEO campaigns, ideally completed or actively managed within the last 12 months. 

- For each example, explain your role, the starting challenge, the work completed, the time period, and the measurable results.

- Redacted reports, screenshots, or case studies that support your examples. Please identify which work was yours and which was completed by others.

- The SEO tools and WordPress platforms you use regularly.



To show you read the full post, begin your application with the words “SEO Manager” and briefly describe one SEO result you’re proud of.

title: Outbound Sales & Appointment Setter | Cleaning Services | Base + Commission
description:
Greater Phoenix Cleaning

Remote | Philippines | Part-time: 20 hours per week

$4–$6 USD per hour base pay + performance bonuses and commissions

Schedule: Agreed weekday shifts during Phoenix, Arizona business hours. This requires evening/overnight availability in the Philippines. Exact shifts agreed before hiring.



TURN CONVERSATIONS INTO CONTRACT OPPORTUNITIES



You enjoy starting conversations, asking the right questions, and earning the next meeting. You can hear “we already have a cleaner,” stay curious, and find out whether there is a real opportunity. You follow through when others forget.



Greater Phoenix Cleaning is hiring an outbound sales professional to help grow our residential and commercial cleaning business across Greater Phoenix. You will build your own pipeline, book qualified commercial walkthroughs, and develop relationships that lead to repeat business.



Bring initiative, confidence, and a serious appetite to improve. We bring hands-on sales coaching, feedback, and room to grow.



YOUR MISSION



Book at least three qualified commercial cleaning walkthrough appointments per week after onboarding, while building a pipeline of future recurring accounts and referral partnerships.



A qualified walkthrough means a business in our service area has a relevant cleaning need, the decision-maker or authorized contact agrees to a specific appointment, and our team receives accurate contact details and useful notes. Confirm appointments, help reschedule cancellations, and track which meetings actually happen.



WHAT YOU WILL OWN



- Find prospects through free sources such as public business directories, company websites, professional networks, and permitted social media outreach.

- Call business owners, office managers, property managers, and other decision-makers. Learn how they handle cleaning, whether they are satisfied, and whether a free commercial cleaning evaluation would be useful.

- Book walkthroughs and hand off clear notes so our local team can evaluate the property, prepare a quote, and pursue the contract.

- Build relationships with contractors and developers for post-construction cleaning, real estate agents for referrals, and Airbnb hosts and short-term rental managers for recurring turnovers.

- Nurture interested prospects through relevant follow-ups. Keep the CRM current, with a next action and follow-up date for every active opportunity.

- Report conversations, appointments booked and held, and pipeline progress. Suggest improvements and test approved outreach ideas. Respect opt-outs and each platform’s rules.



Commercial walkthroughs are the first priority. Partnership outreach will be planned around that goal within your 20-hour week.



YOU WILL FIT HERE IF YOU



- Have successful outbound calling, appointment-setting, or lead-generation experience with U.S. prospects and can explain your results.

- Have worked with home service businesses or can demonstrate a strong understanding of how they win customers and build trust.

- Speak clear, fluent English that U.S. prospects can easily understand, listen carefully, and write professional follow-ups.

- Build rapport, handle objections, and negotiate next steps confidently without pressuring people or promising unauthorized pricing.

- Enjoy sales, take ownership, handle rejection professionally, and apply coaching to your next conversation.

- Bring strong research, organization, and business communication skills developed through education, training, or relevant experience.

- Have a reliable computer, internet connection, headset, quiet calling environment, and availability for the agreed schedule.



Experience with cleaning services, B2B sales, real estate, construction, short-term rentals, CRM systems, or social media lead generation is a strong advantage.



PAY AND GROWTH



- $4–$6 USD per hour for all hours worked, based on demonstrated skills and experience. Proven social media lead-generation ability will also be considered in the starting rate.

- 20 hours per week initially, with opportunities to increase hours as performance and business needs support it.

- Quarterly hourly raises, with increase amounts tied to performance.

- Additional bonuses and commissions for hitting and exceeding targets; the incentive structure will be agreed in writing before you start.

- Paid training, hands-on sales coaching, and opportunities for greater responsibility.



HOW TO APPLY — ANSWER ALL THREE QUESTIONS



Apply through OnlineJobs.ph with the subject “GPC — Pipeline Builder.” Include your relevant work history or résumé and answer each question separately. Aim for 100–150 words per answer. Use your own experience, omit confidential client details, and identify estimates honestly.



1. What outbound results have you personally produced?

Describe your most relevant role, the service you sold, the prospects you contacted, and a specific month or campaign. Include your approximate weekly hours, outreach volume, appointments booked, appointments held, and resulting sales if known. Separate your individual contribution from the team’s results.



2. How have you turned an objection into a useful next step?

Describe a real conversation where a prospect said “we already have someone,” “send me information,” or “your price is too high.” What did you say next, what did you learn, and what happened after your follow-up? Use wording as close to the actual conversation as you can remember.



3. How have you built and nurtured a pipeline without paid leads?

Walk us through a real example: where you found prospects, how you identified the right contact, how you organized follow-ups, and what results you achieved. Explain one improvement you made when the initial approach did not work. If you have always received lead lists, say so and describe the closest relevant experience.



Applications must answer all three questions to be considered for an interview. Specific examples matter more than a polished introduction. Shortlisted candidates will be invited to a paid sales roleplay using a fictional prospect.

Department: Security Monitoring Operations

Reports To: Operations Supervisor

Work Schedule: To Be Determined



About Monitour AI



Monitour AI is an innovative security technology company specializing in AI-powered remote video monitoring and real-time threat detection. We combine advanced artificial intelligence with trained human operators to provide proactive security solutions for commercial properties, businesses, and other facilities.



Our monitoring team operates 24/7, identifying potential security threats, responding to i
, and helping protect our clients' properties.



We are looking for a responsible, detail-oriented, and motivated Assistant Supervisor to support our monitoring operations and help maintain a high standard of performance across our team.



Position Overview



The Assistant Supervisor will work closely with the Operations Supervisor to assist with daily operations, operator management, payroll preparation, reporting, scheduling, and overall team performance.



This is a hybrid leadership and operational role. In addition to administrative and supervisory responsibilities, the Assistant Supervisor will continue performing regular Security Monitoring Operator duties as needed.



The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, communicates effectively, and can confidently take on additional responsibilities when the Supervisor is unavailable.



Key Responsibilities



1. Supervisory & Operator Management



Assist the Supervisor in overseeing daily monitoring operations and ensuring all shifts run smoothly.



Monitor operator attendance, punctuality, productivity, and overall performance.



Help coordinate operator schedules, shift assignments, breaks, and coverage.



Assist with managing operator leave requests, absences, and shift changes.



Ensure operators follow established company procedures, i
 response protocols, and reporting standards.



Provide guidance, support, and feedback to operators when needed.



Help train and onboard new operators.



Escalate performance concerns, operational issues, or policy violations to the Supervisor.



Assume additional supervisory responsibilities when the Supervisor is unavailable.



2. Payroll & Administrative Support



Assist with preparing and reviewing operator payroll records.



Track employee working hours, attendance, overtime, leave, and holiday shifts.



Verify timesheets and identify discrepancies before payroll submission.



Maintain accurate employee attendance and scheduling records.



Assist the Supervisor with administrative tasks, documentation, and recordkeeping.



Ensure payroll-related information is accurate, organized, and submitted on time.



3. Daily Reports & Quality Control



Assist with preparing and reviewing daily monitoring reports.



Ensure all operators complete accurate and timely shift reports.



Review i
 logs for completeness, accuracy, and proper documentation.



Identify missing information, reporting errors, or inconsistencies.



Help prepare summaries of significant i
, operator performance, and operational concerns.



Track recurring issues and recommend improvements to monitoring procedures.



Ensure important i
 and operational updates are communicated to management.



4. Security Monitoring Operator Duties



Actively monitor assigned security cameras and AI-generated alerts.



Review and verify potential security i
.



Respond to trespassing, loitering, suspicious activity, and other security events according to company protocols.



Utilize remote deterrence tools, including audio warnings and other available security systems.



Contact law enforcement or emergency services when required by established procedures.



Accurately document i
, actions taken, and outcomes.



Maintain situational awareness and respond promptly to alerts.



Provide monitoring coverage during scheduled shifts or staffing shortages.



5. Operational Improvement & Communication



Assist in identifying opportunities to improve team efficiency and monitoring performance.



Help ensure operators meet company performance expectations and response-time standards.



Communicate technical issues, camera outages, and system problems to the appropriate team members.



Support the implementation of new procedures, training materials, and operational improvements.



Maintain clear and professional communication between operators, supervisors, and management.



Qualifications & Requirements



Required Qualifications



Previous experience in security monitoring, operations, administration, or team leadership.



Strong organizational and time-management skills.



Excellent written and verbal English communication skills.



Ability to multitask and prioritize responsibilities in a fast-paced environment.



Strong attention to detail, especially when reviewing reports, payroll, and attendance records.



Proficiency with Google Sheets, Microsoft Excel, and other basic office applications.



Ability to maintain confidentiality when handling employee and company information.



Dependable, professional, and capable of working independently.



Willingness to perform both administrative and hands-on monitoring responsibilities.



Preferred Qualifications



Previous experience as a Security Monitoring Operator or Team Lead.



Experience managing employee schedules, attendance, or payroll records.



Familiarity with CCTV systems, remote monitoring platforms, or i
 management software.



Experience reviewing employee performance and preparing operational reports.



Previous supervisory or assistant supervisory experience.



Ideal Candidate



We are looking for someone who demonstrates:



Leadership: Can guide operators, address issues professionally, and set a positive example.



Accountability: Takes ownership of assigned responsibilities and consistently follows through.



Attention to Detail: Ensures payroll records, reports, and operational documentation are accurate.



Initiative: Identifies problems and takes appropriate action without requiring constant supervision.



Communication: Clearly communicates with team members and management.



Reliability: Can be trusted to support operations and take charge when necessary.



Adaptability: Is comfortable balancing administrative duties with active monitoring responsibilities.



Performance Expectations



Success in this position will be measured by:



Accuracy and timely preparation of payroll and attendance records.



Completeness and quality of daily monitoring reports.



Operator attendance, scheduling coordination, and shift coverage.



Compliance with company monitoring and i
 response protocols.



Timely identification and escalation of operational issues.



Ability to support and improve overall operator performance.



Reliability in completing assigned supervisory and monitoring duties.



Why Join Monitour AI?



Monitour AI is a growing company at the intersection of artificial intelligence, security, and technology. This position offers an opportunity to develop leadership and operational management skills while contributing directly to the growth of our monitoring team.



The Assistant Supervisor will play an important role in supporting our operations and will have opportunities to take on greater responsibilities as the company expands.



How to Apply



Interested candidates should submit their resume along with a brief description of their relevant experience, particularly in security monitoring, team management, scheduling, payroll, or administrative operations.

title: Creative Brand Strategist and Graphic Designer
description:
40-Hour Project | Immediate Hiring | Deadline: November 23, 2026



Hi! I'm looking for a talented and creative graphic designer to help develop a cohesive visual identity for AIM Atlanta,  an Atlanta-based social events and lifestyle brand.



We bring people together through curated social experiences, networking events, recreational activities, and community gatherings. One of our signature experiences is Pickleball & Mingle.



I'm looking for someone who can create branding that feels modern, elevated, sophisticated, playful, and memorable.



I value originality, thoughtful design, and someone who can bring creative ideas to the table.



 Project Deliverables

- **Logo:** Original, creative logo design

- **Brand Kit:** Color palette, typography, and visual guidelines

- **Website:** One-page landing page design

- **Slide Deck:** Branded presentation template

- **Reel Covers:** Reusable Instagram Reel cover templates

- **Carousels:** Reusable Instagram carousel templates

- **Social Posts:** Reusable branded post templates



All deliverables must include editable source files.



Creative Direction



I'm looking for branding that feels more like a **lifestyle brand than a traditional event-planning company**.



I prefer creative, concept-driven designs rather than literal interpretations of the business. I'm not looking for generic templates or obvious event-related symbols.



**Absolutely no AI-generated logos.** All logo concepts must be original and manually designed. Generative AI should not be used to create the final designs.



How to Apply



I appreciate your time and want to keep the application process simple!



Since I'll be reviewing applications quickly, please keep your response **short and focused**.



Please include:



1. **Three examples of your most relevant work**, preferably branding, logos, or websites for lifestyle, hospitality, entertainment, social events, or community brands.

2. **ONE image, single-page PDF, or direct link** displaying all three examples together. I want to see your work immediately without navigating multiple links or folders.

3. **Your hourly rate and total cost for 40 hours.**

4. **Confirmation that you create original logos without generative AI.**

5. **Confirmation that you can complete all deliverables by November 23.**



There's no need to send your entire portfolio or a lengthy introduction. I'd much rather see a few carefully selected examples that demonstrate your creativity and design style.



**Please follow these application instructions so I can review your work efficiently and fairly.**



### Project Timeline



**Hiring:** Immediate  

**First Interviews:** Tuesday, November 10, 2026  

**Project Duration:** 40 hours total  

**Final Deliverables Due:** Monday, November 23, 2026  

**Potential:** Additional projects and ongoing work



This is a fast-moving project, so I'm looking for someone who is available to begin immediately, communicates clearly, and can meet deadlines without compromising quality.



I'm excited to connect with a designer who can help bring this vision to life!



Looking forward to seeing your work!

title: Buyer Specialist – Wholesale Real Estate (Remote)
description:
Pay: Competitive base plus performance bonuses and deal commissions



Schedule: 40 hrs/weekly. Hours must overlap with U.S. business hours, with flexibility within that.



About Us

We’re a U.S.-based real estate investment company specialising in direct-to-agent wholesaling. We’re growing fast and need a buyer specialist who knows how to find serious investors and keep them coming back. You’ll be the main point of contact for our cash buyer network. What You’ll Do

3. Send the right deals to the right buyers: Match each property to buyer criteria, send deal packages, and follow up until we have offers.

4. Screen for serious buyers: Confirm proof of funds, qualify buyers, and help move deals to assignment and closing.

5. Stay organised: track KPIs (calls, new buyers, offers, closings) and make sure every lead has a clear next step.



What You Bring: 

1. Proven experience working with real estate investors in wholesaling, dispositions, or cash buyer outreach (required)

2. Clear, confident spoken English and a professional phone presence

4. Strong communication skills and comfort making a high volume of calls and texts

5. CRM experience (GoHighLevel preferred)

6. Organised, detail-orientated, and self-managed

7. Reliable, fast internet and a quiet workspace



What’s in it for you?

1. Long-term role with real growth potential

2. Uncapped upside through bonuses and commissions on closed deals

3. A direct line to the decision-maker and a chance to shape the acquisitions process





How to Apply

Send us a message with:

1. A short summary of your real estate experience (markets worked, deals sold, buyer lists built, call volume if you know it)

2. CRM tools you’ve used, especially GoHighLevel

3. Your available hours and time zone

4. A screenshot of your internet speed test

5. A 30-60 second voice recording introducing yourself and your real estate background



Applications without a voice recording will not be reviewed.
