title: Full Time: Video Editor and Graphic Designer
description:
Full-time applicants only!

IMPORTANT: If you currently have another job, freelance work, or any ongoing project on the side, please do not apply.



Join Our Team as a Video Editor – Bring Stories to Life with Us!



Are you an expert in video editing/Graphic Designing with a passion for creating dynamic, impactful content? Do you have the skills to bring stories to life with your editing style, and are you looking for an opportunity to work in a fast-paced, creative environment? At Uniworld Omniport, we're on the hunt for a dynamic and driven Video Editor to join our growing team.



The ideal candidate is someone with a successful track record of building social content for a brand and has experience in successfully growing a brand’s social media presence. If you have a proven ability to craft compelling narratives through video and are up-to-date with the latest editing techniques, we’d love to hear from you!



About Us

Founded in 2006, Uniworld Omniport is a direct-to-consumer (DTC) e-commerce company that owns and operates two industry-leading brands: BBO Poker Tables and Game Theory Tables. Based at the Speedway in North East Las Vegas, our global presence connects team members from around the world, united by our mission to "create unforgettable memories between friends and family." At the core of our internal culture are trust and accountability, values that are evident in the actions of our team members.



Why This Role Matters:

This isn’t measured just by the quality of the content you create, but by the impact it has on our brand and audience. As a Video Editor at BBO Poker Tables and Game Theory Tables, you’ll contribute to the bigger picture—driving customer engagement, enhancing our brand image, and fostering team collaboration. You’ll be at the forefront of creating videos that not only capture attention but also deliver tangible results.



The Perfect Video Editor We Need:

- Expertise in Key Software: Highly proficient in Adobe After Effects and/or Adobe Premiere with a solid understanding of Adobe Photoshop.

- Content Creation Mastery: Proven ability to create dynamic, high-quality videos that resonate with audiences and align with our brand image.

- Engagement-Driven: Focused on achieving and maintaining high levels of engagement across all platforms—social media, websites, and more. You’ll help elevate our content performance to the next level.

- KPI-Oriented: You’re results-driven and have experience managing performance metrics, consistently meeting or exceeding KPIs related to content engagement, social media performance, and website traffic.

- Collaborative Spirit: Able to seamlessly work with various team members to deliver content that aligns with a unified brand message and resonates with our target audience.

- Continuous Growth: Eager to learn and develop new skills, improving efficiency and mastering new tools and techniques.



What You’ll Deliver:

- Consistently produce captivating videos that resonate with our audience and align with our brand’s vision.

- Drive higher levels of interaction across social media and digital platforms, helping to boost views, shares, and brand awareness.

- Bring fresh ideas and creative solutions to the table, enhancing teamwork and contributing to a stronger, more unified creative process.



Why Work With Us?

- Creative Environment: You’ll have the opportunity to work on a variety of exciting projects that allow you to showcase your creativity and skills.

- Growth Opportunities: We believe in fostering personal and professional growth, offering training and development to help you expand your skill set.

- Supportive Team: Join a talented, collaborative team that values creativity and innovation.

- Flexible Work Environment: We offer flexible work options to support work-life balance.

- Competitive Pay & Benefits: We offer a competitive salary and comprehensive benefits package.



Deliverables

How Success is Measured in This Role:

In this role, success is defined by your ability to create powerful, visually engaging content that drives results and strengthens our brand. Here's what success looks like:

- Bring Still Images to Life: Use Adobe After Effects, Photoshop, and Illustrator to transform static images into dynamic, attention-grabbing animated ads.

- Video Editing & Motion Graphics: Take raw video footage and craft compelling narratives that speak to our audience. Combine video editing with motion graphics to produce engaging social media content and advertisements.

- Motion Graphics Design Expertise: Create stunning motion graphics that enhance video content, using your design skills to add visual appeal and depth to advertisements, social media posts, and promotional videos.

- Animate Static Assets: Transform still images and logos into dynamic animated visuals, elevating the storytelling experience and ensuring content stands out across multiple platforms.

- Graphic Design Mastery: Create visually compelling static graphics, including social media posts, website assets, and
 templates that align with our brand’s voice and aesthetic.

- Design Integration: Combine graphic design with video editing to create cohesive content, ensuring that all visual elements complement each other and enhance the storytelling experience.

- Adapt Content for Multiple Platforms: Re-edit video content into different aspect ratios for various platforms, ensuring optimal presentation and engagement.

- Collaborate with the Team: Work closely with the creative team and stakeholders to ensure your video content aligns with the brand strategy and meets project goals.

- Create Visual Masterpieces: Resize, cut out, and composite images to create eye-catching graphics that complement your video content.

- Maintain Quality: Ensure that all animations and video content are on-brand, visually appealing, and adhere to the highest standards.

- Meet Deadlines & Deliver on Expectations: Take ownership of project timelines and ensure your content is delivered on time, meeting or exceeding expectations.



What You’ll Deliver:

- Consistently produce captivating videos & graphics that resonate with our audience and align with our brand’s vision.

- Drive higher levels of interaction across social media and digital platforms, helping to boost views, shares, and brand awareness.

- Bring fresh ideas and creative solutions to the table, enhancing teamwork and contributing to a stronger, more unified creative process.



Ready to join the Team?

title: Digital Marketing | SEO,
description:
Beacon of Health is a growing telehealth practice seeking an experienced Healthcare SEO and Digital Marketing Specialist to strengthen our online presence, improve Google rankings, increase patient inquiries, and generate consistent appointment bookings.



We are looking for someone who understands healthcare marketing and can develop and execute a strategy that produces measurable results.



Key Responsibilities



1. Google SEO & Website Optimization



• Improve our website’s ranking on Google and other search engines.

• Research and implement high-converting healthcare keywords.

• Optimize our Wix website, including page titles, meta descriptions, headings, images, and service pages.

• Improve Google Search Console indexing and resolve technical SEO issues.

• Develop local and state-specific SEO strategies for our licensed service areas.

• Improve website speed, mobile experience, and appointment conversion rates.



2. Google Business Profile Optimization



• Optimize our Google Business Profile for better visibility.

• Improve our appearance in relevant Google searches and Maps where eligible.

• Develop strategies to increase authentic patient reviews.

• Keep our services, business information, and profile content updated.



3. AI Search Visibility



• Improve Beacon of Health’s visibility in ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Google AI Overviews, and other AI-powered search platforms.

• Implement structured data and other appropriate technical SEO improvements.

• Develop authoritative, medically accurate content that AI search engines can discover and reference.



4. Content Creation & Social Media



• Create professional healthcare content for Instagram,
, TikTok, and Google.

• Develop educational videos, reels, graphics, blogs, and promotional campaigns.

• Increase engagement, followers, website visits, and appointment bookings.

• Maintain consistent branding across platforms.



5. Google Ads & Patient Acquisition



• Develop and manage Google Search advertising campaigns.

• Optimize advertising to attract patients actively searching for telehealth services.

• Track appointment bookings, conversion rates, and cost per acquired patient.

• Ensure all advertising follows applicable healthcare advertising and platform policies.



Qualifications



• Proven experience with healthcare SEO and digital marketing.

• Experience optimizing Wix websites.

• Strong knowledge of Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4, Google Ads, and Google Business Profile.

• Experience with AI search optimization (GEO/AEO).

• Understanding of HIPAA, healthcare advertising restrictions, and patient privacy.

• Ability to demonstrate past results from increasing search visibility and appointment bookings.



What Success Looks Like



• Higher rankings for relevant healthcare keywords.

• Increased organic website traffic.

• More qualified patient inquiries.

• More completed appointment bookings.

• Improved visibility across Google and AI search platforms.

• Clear monthly reports showing measurable growth.



To Apply:



Please provide examples of healthcare websites you have optimized, measurable results from previous projects, your proposed 90-day strategy, monthly pricing, and how you plan to turn website traffic into actual patient bookings.



We are seeking a proactive professional who can independently identify opportunities, execute improvements, and guide the growth of our practice.

title: Customer Success Representative
description:

This position involves actively engaging with customers to understand their requirements and challenges while leveraging cutting-edge technology to enhance customer experiences across all facility locations nationwide. The representative will perform all responsibilities from home, allowing flexibility while staying connected with customers and the team. This role thrives in a fast-paced and diverse environment, requiring a proactive and motivated individual excited about contributing to customer satisfaction and success in a technology-driven landscape.

· Friendly and focused on service, able to anticipate and meet customer’s needs.

· Capability to read documents and focus on computer screens, with or without corrective lenses as may be required.



· Ability to arrange the workspace efficiently for productivity, accommodating any individual needs for ergonomic considerations.
